artists.b: Anu Põder (1947–2013) kasutas oma loomingus kõikvõimalikke materjale, sageli selliseid, millel pole traditsioonilise skulptuuriga midagi pistmist. Ta mõtles materjalis ja materjali kaudu: materjali tähenduslikkus nii isiklikus kui ka üldisemas mõttes on tema loomingu mõistmise üks võtmeid. Anu Põdra loomingut võib vaadata kui filosoofilist autobiograafiat, millest aimub konkreetset, vahetut, intiimset kogemust. Ta astus Eesti kunstiellu 1970. aastate teisel poolel, olles mõjutatud pop-kunsti arsenalist ning samas avatud sürrealistlikele mõtteseostele. Põderi aktiivsus kunstnikuna oli äärmiselt kõrge üle kolmekümne loominguaasta. Ta oli kauaaegne õppejõud kunstiakadeemias ning Tallinna Kunstikoolis. Lisaks pälvis ta Eesti Kunstnike Liidu noortekoondise preemia (1979), Eesti Kunstnike Liidu preemia (1990), Riia skulptuurikvadriennaali preemia (2000) ja Kristjan Raua preemia (2008). Põder lõpetas 1969. aastal Tartu Kunstikooli ja 1976. aastal ERKI skulptuuri erialal.
artists.ben:
Anu Põder (1947–2013) was an Estonian sculptor and installation artist. Throughout her career, she experimented with new abstract forms and a variety of materials from plaster and wood, charcoal and textile, to light, scent and taste. Põder's work was inspired by her own experience as well as her surroundings and environment in the city and in countryside, at home and at work. Põder's pieces were time and site specific and created to be exhibited as such – the presence of the artwork relied on a performative effect, meaning the artworks disintegrate over time.

Põder's work can be viewed in two chapters: the first, facing inward, looking at a young woman's journey to motherhood and being a middle aged woman at the very end of the Soviet period; the second chapter sees the artist slowly turning her gaze outward and commenting on social processes in the newly independent Estonia. Põder's early work did not fall in line with the principles of the so-called bronze age, when Estonian sculptors were casting an extraordinary number of monuments and portrait statues – she did not work with bronze, but followed the formal experimentation direction prevalent at the time, guiding her from Surrealism to depictions of pop culture and everyday life.

Already during her studies, Põder began depicting people as dolls, created by using wire structures, plaster, cotton and textile. In the second half of the 1980s she added plastic to her selection of materials – one of the earliest examples of that decade by Põder is “Big doll which was made to sit” (1982). Additionally, in the 1980s Põder created a number of abstract sculptures made of burlap, plastic, paint, tar, textile filling and metal, such as “Composition with a net”, “Composition with strings”, “Composition with red gloves” (all 1983) and “Very old memories” (1985). The sharp tips in these compositions seem to symbolise a defensive position that protects what is held dear from the robustness of the outside. In the second half of the 1980s Põder began experimenting with pinkish plastic sheets, used in medicine at the time. These plastic sheets were sewn together to create compositions of female torsos, such as “On one foot from Lasnamäe” and “With a brass wind instrument from Lasnamäe” (1988) as well as her most know works “Figure which was made to walk” and “Man’s head with a flag” (both 1984).

In the 1990s Anu Põder completed her series of dolls, including works like “Rolled-up figure” (1992), “Coiled” (1993), “Composition with a hanging head” (1994) and “Light Stuffed Figure” (2001). Põder's work went through a.

Laura Põld (1984) is an artist whose work deals with the history of materials and objects as well as the environment, exploring ways of organizing space and basic cross-species needs, such as security, habitat, and community. Põld’s installations seek a dialogue with their location and its historical and political context. Her works are created by combining textile, wood, found objects, ceramics, and video.

(2016), the artist opened up the veils of her poetic perception, allowing visitors to be simultaneously in a pine forest, on a dock, by salt water, in the mountains, and in a castle courtyard. Mixing different temporal and spatial experiences from Estonia, Austria, and Japan, she exhibited raku-fired ceramics, marble-effect installations, and painted sculptures whose patterned surfaces revealed shifts in perspective. In her later work, Põld has focused on the choice of materials and their historical context, using traditional craft techniques such as ceramics and embroidery, which are of interest to the artist as repositories of memory and experience.

Laura Põld’s exhibitions in recent years have focused mainly on the relationship between man and nature, and on environmental issues. As part of the Estonia 100 art project

(2018), Põld integrated an alternative environment into the permanent exhibition of the Kunda Cement Museum, examining the history of the town of Kunda, its manufacturing industry and its natural resources. She experimented with natural clay pottery techniques, creating monumental objects that incorporated both the town’s historical markers and found fossils. The desire to juxtapose man-made landscape elements with natural materials continued in the exhibition.

artists.b: Eesti maalikunstnik, pedagoog ja ühiskonnategelane Enn PÕLDROOS (1933, Tallinn) on viljelenud peamiselt figuraalkompositsiooni ja portreed (teda on nimetatud ka inimeste ja inimsuhete maalijaks). Lülitus kohe pärast õpingute lõpetamist kunstiellu ja püüdis väljendada enda ja oma põlvkonnakaaslaste uudseid seisukohti ning vastanduda senisele lihtsameelselt idealiseerivale või liialdatud suurejoonelisele tegelikkusekujutusele nähtuste olemuse kunstilise üldistusega. Põldroos äratas tähelepanu mõnevõrra rohmaka käsitluslaadiga; paljudes maalides avaldub 1960. aastate nn. karm stiil, millele on iseloomulikud lihtne vorm, selge terav kontuur ja napp värvivalik. Kümnendi vältel kujunevad välja Põldroosi loomingu eriomased jooned: silueti ja detaili rõhutamine, dissoneerival vastandusel (nt. mehaaniline-orgaaniline, geomeetriline-maaliline) rajanev kompositsioon, olukordade konfliktsuse ja dramaatilisuse esiletoomine. Loonud ka poeetilistel sümbolkujunditel põhinevaid eksistentsialistlikke teoseid. 1960. aastate lõpus kunstniku loomelaad muutub ning see avaldub hoogsas ekspressiivses pintslikäsitluses ja erksas koloriidis. Uue värvikäsitluse otsingud avalduvad eeskätt portreedes, milles rõhutab kujutatava rikast vaimuelu ja sisemist energiat; mõningatesse teostesse tekib groteski-varjund.
artists.ben: The Estonian painter, pedagogue and public figure Enn PÕLDROOS (1933, Tallinn) has cultivated mainly figural composition and portraiture (he has also been called a painter of people and human relationships). He entered the art scene immediately after completing his studies and sought to express the novel views of himself and his generation's contemporaries, opposing the hitherto naively idealising or exaggeratedly grandiose depiction of reality with an artistic generalisation of the essence of phenomena. Põldroos attracted attention with his somewhat rough manner of treatment; many of his paintings display the so-called severe style [karm stiil] of the 1960s, characterised by simple form, clear sharp contour and a sparse choice of colour. Over the course of the decade the distinctive features of Põldroos's work took shape: emphasis on silhouette and detail, composition based on dissonant contrasts (e.g. mechanical–organic, geometric–painterly), and the highlighting of conflict and drama in situations. He has also created existentialist works based on poetic symbolic imagery. At the end of the 1960s the artist's creative manner changed, manifesting itself in a vigorous, expressive brush treatment and a vivid colour scheme. The search for a new approach to colour is expressed above all in portraits, in which he emphasises the rich inner life and inner energy of the person depicted; some works acquire a touch of the grotesque.

artists.b: Alustas vabagraafika ja abstraktse maaliloominguga ("Kaarjas pingestatus" 1963). Oli rühmituse "Visarid" (1967-72) asutaja ja liidreid, lõi sel ajal pop- ja op-kunsti mõjulisi maale ("Kurbus" 1968), tegeles kineetilise kunsti ("Ringlemine IV" 1966), assamblaaþi ("Kandam" 1967), ready-mad'i ("Vaikus" 1968) ja kollaaþiga ("Meelerahu" 1968). Huvitus psühhedeelsest kunstist. hilisema, metsotintotehnikas graafika teemad seonduvad soome-ugri mütoloogiaga (sari "Kodalased" 1973-75), väljendavad eestlaste rahvusliku iseolemise püüdlusi (sari "Kalivägi" 1978-84), inimese ja maailmakõiksuse suhteid (sari "Taevas ja Maa" 1987-91) ja elu igavikulisust (sari "Kirgastumine" 1991-95). Aastast 1993 teinud ruumilisi objekte ("Mõtteseisund" 1998) ning maale, mille eesmärk on luua kolmemõõtmelisuse ("Kaugustesse" 1998) ja võimatute maailmade ("Astmed" 1999) pettekujutlus. Kujundanud raamatuid, teinud eksliibriseid. Uurinud aastast 1978 EKA üliõpilastega sugulashõimude rahvakunsti, kivilabürinte ja Karjala kaljujooniseid ning asutanud nendel uurimisreisidel osalenutest rühmitise "Ydi" (1998). Avaldanud oma loomingu ja uurimistöö teemalisi kirjutisi ("Kakskümmend soome-ugri uurimisreisi" 1999, "Hiiumaa rahvapärane ehituskunst" 2004).
artists.ben: He began with free graphic art and abstract painting ("Kaarjas pingestatus" 1963). He was a founder and one of the leaders of the group "Visarid" (1967-72), creating during that time paintings influenced by pop art and op art ("Kurbus" 1968), and worked with kinetic art ("Ringlemine IV" 1966), assemblage ("Kandam" 1967), ready-made ("Vaikus" 1968) and collage ("Meelerahu" 1968). He was interested in psychedelic art. The themes of his later graphic art, made in mezzotint technique, are connected with Finno-Ugric mythology (series "Kodalased" 1973-75), express the aspirations of Estonians' national self-existence (series "Kalivägi" 1978-84), the relations between man and the universe (series "Taevas ja Maa" 1987-91), and the eternity of life (series "Kirgastumine" 1991-95). From 1993 he has made spatial objects ("Mõtteseisund" 1998) as well as paintings, the aim of which is to create the illusion of three-dimensionality ("Kaugustesse" 1998) and of impossible worlds ("Astmed" 1999). He has designed books and made ex libris. From 1978 he has, together with EKA students, studied the folk art of kindred peoples, stone labyrinths and Karelian rock carvings, and founded, from among the participants of these research trips, the group "Ydi" (1998). He has published writings on his creative and research work ("Kakskümmend soome-ugri uurimisreisi" 1999, "Hiiumaa rahvapärane ehituskunst" 2004).

artists.b: Töötas õpetajana Põltsamaal ning Tartus kutse- ja keskkoolides, oli 1943–1944 Pallase ja 1944–1951 Tartu Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi dekaan 1951–1957 töötas ERKI-s ja aastast 1957 asus tööle Tartu ülikooli.
artists.ben: Worked as a teacher in Põltsamaa and in vocational and secondary schools in Tartu, was dean of Pallas in 1943–1944 and of the Tartu State Art Institute in 1944–1951, worked at ERKI in 1951–1957 and from 1957 took up work at the University of Tartu.

artists.b: Ede Raadik (s. 1989) on Tallinna kunstnik, kes kaitses 2015. aastal magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafikaosakonnas. Enamasti töötab ta kontseptualistlikule kunstile omases seeriaformaadis. Selaljuures kasutab ta fotograafiat selleks, et näitlikustada, kuidas me sageli (väär)tõlgendame visuaalset informatsiooni. Mahukas seerias.
artists.ben: Ede Raadik (b. 1989) is a Tallinn-based artist who defended her master's degree in 2015 in the Graphic Art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. She mostly works in the series format typical of conceptualist art. In doing so she uses photography to demonstrate how we often (mis)interpret visual information. In the extensive series.

artists.b: Rein Raamat (s. 1931) on Eesti joonisfilmirežissöör, kunstnik ja stsenarist. Ta on esimene rahvusvaheliselt edukas eesti animaator ning koos Elbert Tuganoviga viidatakse Rein Raamatule sageli kui Eesti animatsiooni isale. Joonisfilmi ja animatsioonikunsti vallas alustas Raamat tegevust juba varastel 1970. aastatel; ta on ka enam kui 20 dokumentaalfilmi autor.
artists.wdesc: Estonian animation film director, artist and screenwriter (born 1931)
artists.ben: Rein Raamat (b. 1931) is an Estonian animated film director, artist and screenwriter. He is the first internationally successful Estonian animator, and together with Elbert Tuganov, Rein Raamat is often referred to as the father of Estonian animation. Raamat began his work in animated film and the art of animation as early as the early 1970s; he is also the author of more than 20 documentary films.

artists.b: Haridus: 2000–2003 Tallinna Pedagoogikaülikool, film ja video; 1993 Tallinna Sidekool, fotograafia.
artists.ben: Education: 2000–2003 Tallinn Pedagogical University, film and video; 1993 Tallinn School of Communications, photography.

artists.b: Sündinud 24.11.1968. Haridus: Õppinud Viljandi 5. Keskkoolis.
artists.ben: Born 24.11.1968. Education: Studied at Viljandi Secondary School No. 5.

artists.b: RANDEL, Felix (1901, Valga – 1977, Tallinn). Eesti maalikunstnik ja karikaturist, kes on viljelenud ekspressionismimõjulist vabagraafikat, intensiivsete värvidega kubistlikus stiilis maneristlikku figuurimaali ja hiljem ka realistlikus laadis maali. Karikatuuriloomingust on silmapaistvaimad kultuuriinimeste tabavalt karakteriseeritud saržid. Kunstihariduse omandas Randel Penza ning Pallase kunstikoolides; töötas J. Tombi nimelise Kultuuripalee peakunstnikuna, ajakirja Pikker karikaturistina ja Tarbekunsti Keskuse kujundustööde ateljee juhatajana. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

artists.wdesc: German engraver, steel engraver, illustrator and architectural draftsman
German engraver, steel engraver, illustrator and draftsman
Estonian textile artist, writer and university teacher (born 1943)

artists.b: Sündinud 22.10.1865, Viru-Jaagupi; surnud 19.05.1943.
artists.ben: Born 22.10.1865, Viru-Jaagupi; died 19.05.1943.

artists.b: Aastal 1902 õpetaja Wieckmanni eestvõttel ja Konsistooriumi loal vahetati kappaltar (B. Notke, 1483) kui luterlikku kirikusse sobimatu katolikuaegne ese uue altariseina vastu välja. 1929 oli koguduse nõukogu nõus olnud kappaltarit Muuseumiühingule kinkima, aga seoses kiriku renoveerimistöödega 1933, hakati taotlema selle tagasisaamist. Muuseumiühing ei nõustunud, vaatamata eksperthinnangutele, mis pidasid hoiupaika Toomkirikus altarile sobimatuks. Alles 18. detsembril 1942 taaspühitseti kappaltar omal kohal. (allikas:Kultuurimälestiste riiklik register)
artists.ben: In 1902, at the initiative of teacher Wieckmann and with the Consistory's permission, the winged altarpiece (B. Notke, 1483), as a Catholic-era object unsuitable for a Lutheran church, was exchanged for a new altar wall. In 1929 the congregation's council had agreed to donate the winged altarpiece to the Museum Society, but in connection with the church's renovation works in 1933, efforts began to reclaim it. The Museum Society did not agree, despite expert assessments that considered the storage place in the Cathedral unsuitable for the altarpiece. Only on 18 December 1942 was the winged altarpiece reconsecrated in its own place. (source: National Register of Cultural Monuments)

artists.b: Sündis Lätis Lugaži (Luke) vallas talus, õppis Valga linnakoolis ja Penza kunstikool. Osales Vabadussõjas. Töötas joonistusõpetajana 1920-25 Tartus, 1925-29 Tallinnas. Oli 1923 Eesti Kunstnike Rühma asutajaid. Tegi Vabadussõja mälestusmärkide kavandeid, skulptorina oli edukas ja andekas iseõppija.va.
artists.ben: Born on a farm in Lugaži (Luke) parish in Latvia, studied at Valga Town School and Penza Art School. Took part in the War of Independence. Worked as a drawing teacher 1920-25 in Tartu, 1925-29 in Tallinn. Was one of the founders of the Estonian Artists' Group in 1923. Made designs for War of Independence memorials, as a sculptor was a successful and talented autodidact.

artists.b: Oskar RAUNAM (1914, Paide – 1992, Tallinn) oli eesti maalikunstnik ja pedagoog, kes on loonud realistlikke maastiku-, lille- ja portreemaale ning figuraalkompositsioone; lisaks sellele avaldanud mitmeid õpikuid, nt „Akvarellimaal“ (1952) ja „Joonistamise ja maalimise õpik“ (1961, 1963). Kunstihariduse omandas Raunam dekoratsioonimaalierialal Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis, joonistus- ja joonestusõpetaja erialal Tallinna Pedagoogiumis ning maalierialal Johannes Greenbergi juhendamisel Riigi Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis. Töötas ERKIs joonistus- ja maaliõppejõuna, õppe- ja teadusprorektorina ning üldmaalikateedri juhatajana. /tekst Liisi Aibel, 2013/.
artists.ben: Oskar RAUNAM (1914, Paide – 1992, Tallinn) was an Estonian painter and pedagogue who created realistic landscape, flower and portrait paintings as well as figural compositions; he also published several textbooks, e.g. "Akvarellimaal" (1952) and "Joonistamise ja maalimise õpik" (1961, 1963). Raunam obtained his art education in the decoration painting speciality at the State School of Applied Arts, in the drawing and draughting teacher speciality at the Tallinn Pedagogium, and in the painting speciality under the guidance of Johannes Greenberg at the State Higher Art School. He worked at ERKI as a teacher of drawing and painting, as vice-rector for study and research, and as head of the general painting department. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/.

artists.b: Aira Rautso (s. 1954) on eesti maalikunstnik ja kunstiõpetaja. Ta lõpetas Tallinna Ülikooli 1978. aastal ning on alates 1980. aastast töötanud kunstiõpetajana Jõhvi Kunstikoolis. Aira Rautso on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige alates 2008. aastast. Ta on osalenud arvukatel isiku- ja grupinäitustel Eestis ning välismaal, sealhulgas Skandinaavias ja Saksamaal.
artists.ben: Aira Rautso (b. 1954) is an Estonian painter and art teacher. She graduated from Tallinn University in 1978 and has worked since 1980 as an art teacher at the Jõhvi Art School. Aira Rautso has been a member of the Estonian Painters' Association since 2008. She has participated in numerous solo and group exhibitions in Estonia and abroad, including in Scandinavia and Germany.

artists.b: Loomingus (raamatukujundused, auaadressid, plakatid, eksliibrised, tarbegraafika) on määrav osa kunstilisel kirjal. Edendanud srifti, eriti gooti kirja ja antiikvat, muuseas lõi ruunikirja alusel algupärase hübriidkirja.
artists.ben: In his work (book design, ceremonial addresses, posters, ex-libris, applied graphics) an essential part is played by artistic lettering. He advanced typography, especially Gothic script and antiqua, and among other things created an original hybrid script based on runic writing.

artists.b: Sündis tolliametniku peres, 1897 asus perekond elama Tallinna, 1914-1915 reisiti Prantsusmaal, Hispaanias ja Skandinaavias. 1915-1919 töötas Reindorff Petrogradis ja Moskvas väärtpaberitrükikojas. 1920 opteerus Eesti Vabariiki. 1920-1943 oli Riigi Kunsttööstuskooli õppejõud, algul õpetaja, alates 1922 graafika õppetöökoja juhataja ja 1936 graafika osakonna juhataja. Rajas kooli graafikaklassi, litograafia- (1920) ning trüki- ja tsinkograafiatöökoja (1923). 1922-1932 tegi konsultandina koostööd Riigi Trükikojaga, samuti töötas koos reklaamibüroodega Ilo, Ole ja Gravis. 1932 oli Rakenduskunsti ühingu RaKÜ asutajaliige. 1950-1958 ERKI (EKA) õppejõud (1951 professor)
artists.wdesc: Estonian and Soviet artist and graphic designer (1889–1974)
grp: school:Saint Petersburg Stieglitz State Academy of Art and Design
artists.ben: Born into the family of a customs official, in 1897 the family moved to Tallinn; in 1914-1915 he travelled in France, Spain and Scandinavia. In 1915-1919 Reindorff worked at a securities printing house in Petrograd and Moscow. In 1920 he opted for the Republic of Estonia. In 1920-1943 he was a lecturer at the State School of Applied Art, initially a teacher, from 1922 head of the printmaking workshop, and in 1936 head of the printmaking department. He founded the school's printmaking class, the lithography workshop (1920) and the printing and zincography workshop (1923). In 1922-1932 he worked as a consultant in cooperation with the State Printing House, and also worked with the advertising agencies Ilo, Ole and Gravis. In 1932 he was a founding member of the Applied Art Society RaKÜ. In 1950-1958 he was a lecturer at ERKI (EKA) (professor in 1951)

artists.b: Näitustel osaleb aastast 2003. On teinud viis isiknäitust ja osalenud grupi- ja ühis- näitustel ning projektides Eestis ja välismaal. Tööd on eksponeeritud mitmetes kodudes ja kontorites, samuti Tartu Teaduspargis ja Tartu Ülikoolis. Kuulub Eesti Maalikunstnike Liitu.
artists.ben: Has participated in exhibitions since 2003. Has held five solo exhibitions and taken part in group and joint exhibitions and projects in Estonia and abroad. Works have been displayed in various homes and offices, as well as in Tartu Science Park and the University of Tartu. Member of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Lilli-Krõõt Repnau (s. 1982) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafikaosakonna aastal 2005 ja magistriõpingud animatsiooni valdkonnas aastal 2015. Lisaks on ta end õpingute käigus täiendanud Šveitsis, Lutserni Ülikooli Kunsti- ja Disainikolledži videoosakonnas. Aastal 2010 tunnustati Lilli-Krõõt Repnau graafikaloomingut Edmund Valtmani stipendiumiga. Ta on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse liige.
artists.ben: Lilli-Krõõt Repnau (b. 1982) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Graphic Art, in 2005, and completed her master's studies in the field of animation in 2015. She has also furthered her studies in Switzerland, at the video department of the Lucerne University of Art and Design. In 2010 Lilli-Krõõt Repnau's graphic art was recognised with the Edmund Valtman Scholarship. She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Association of Printmakers.

artists.b: Linda Rida loomingule on iseloomulik maaliline pehmus ja tundlik käsitluslaad. Ühenduses värvirõõmsa, elava, tundeerksa käsitlusega kõneleb see elujaatavast looduse ja ümbruse kunstilisest vastuvõtust, mis väärib rõhutavat väljatõstmist eriti praeguses karmis tõelisuses.
artists.ben: Linda Rida's work is characterised by a painterly softness and a sensitive manner of handling. Combined with a colour-joyful, lively, emotionally sensitive treatment, this speaks of a life-affirming artistic reception of nature and surroundings, which deserves particular emphasis especially in the present harsh reality.

artists.b: Lõpetas 1922 Pärnu tütarlastegümnaasiumi ja 1924 Stettini (Szczecini) kodumajanduskooli ning töötas Tartus majapidamisõpetajana. 1934. aastal lõpetas ta Tartu Ülikooli kunstiajaloolasena ning 1943. aastal kunstikooli Pallas skulptuuriosakonna, kus õppis Anton Starkopfi juhendamisel. Kunstinäitustel hakkas esinema juba 1938. aastal.
artists.ben: He/she graduated from the Pärnu Girls' Gymnasium in 1922 and from the Stettin (Szczecin) home economics school in 1924, and worked as a home economics teacher in Tartu. In 1934 he/she graduated from the University of Tartu as an art historian, and in 1943 from the sculpture department of the Pallas art school, where he/she studied under the guidance of Anton Starkopf. He/she began exhibiting at art exhibitions already in 1938.

artists.b: Tuntud eelkõige portretistina. Tema portreedele on omane 1960. aastatele iseloomulik jõuline tahuline vorm, mis aastakümne lõpus muutus lüürilisemaks ja natuurijärgivamaks, seda eelkõige naisi portreteerivates skulptuurides. Ta on loonud ka figuuriplastikat, peamiselt naisakte, samuti Tartu Ülikooliga seotud teadlaste portreereljeefe ülikooli hoonetes ning Eesti kultuuritegelaste mälestusmärke.
artists.ben: Known primarily as a portraitist. His portraits are characterised by the vigorous faceted form typical of the 1960s, which by the end of the decade became more lyrical and naturalistic, this above all in sculptures portraying women. He has also created figural plastic works, mainly female nudes, as well as portrait reliefs of scholars connected with the University of Tartu in the university's buildings, and monuments to Estonian cultural figures.

artists.wdesc: English artist involved in printmaking and watercolour (1785-1863)

artists.b: Esther ROODE (1923, Tallinn – 2007, Tallinn) on eesti maalikunstnik, kes on loonud peamiselt portreesid ning looduslähedases laadis maastikke. Kunstihariduse omandas Roode moeerialal Tallinna naiskutsekoolis ja Tallinna Riiklikus Tarbekunsti Instituudis, maalierialal Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis. Hiljem töötas maali- ja joonistusõpetajana nii Tallinna Pedagoogilises Instituudis kui ERKI-s.
artists.ben: Esther ROODE (1923, Tallinn – 2007, Tallinn) is an Estonian painter who has created mainly portraits and landscapes in a nature-close manner. Roode obtained her art education in fashion at the Tallinn Women's Vocational School and the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art, and in painting at the Tartu State Art Institute. Later she worked as a teacher of painting and drawing both at the Tallinn Pedagogical Institute and at ERKI.

artists.b: 1943 lõpetas Tallinna Jakob Westholmi gümnaasiumi. 1944–1947 õppis Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis (õppejõud Ado Vabbe ja Elmar Kits). 1947 sügissemestril õppis Tallinna Riiklikus Tarbekunsti Instituudis (õppejõud Johannes Võerahansu ja Lepo Mikko).
artists.ben: In 1943 graduated from the Jakob Westholm Gymnasium in Tallinn. 1944–1947 studied at the Tartu State Art Institute (teachers Ado Vabbe and Elmar Kits). In the autumn semester of 1947 studied at the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art (teachers Johannes Võerahansu and Lepo Mikko).

artists.b: 1939 kunstiühingu Pallas liige. 1941 oli J. Koorti nim. Riigi Rakenduskunsti Kooli õppejõud ja mobiliseeriti seejärel nõukogude armeesse. 1942-44 töötas Moskvas skulptorina.
artists.ben: In 1939 a member of the Pallas art society. In 1941 he was a teacher at the J. Koort State School of Applied Art and was then mobilized into the Soviet army. In 1942-44 worked in Moscow as a sculptor.

artists.b: Kasvas üles Järvamaal, Nõmküla vallas Remmiku talus. Kunsti õppis alates 1901 Paide Karskuse Kuratooriumi joonistuskursustel, mida juhatas Rudolf Lepik, 1906 Peterburis Stieglitzi kunsttööstuskoolis, 1907 Münchenis Michael Zeno Diemeri ja Heinrich Heidneri ateljeedes. 1910 jätkas õpinguid Peterburis, Kunstide edendamise seltsi kunstikoolis, kus ta õpetaja oli Ivan Bilibin. 1913 sai joonistusõpetaja kutse. 1909 esines esmakordselt kunstinäitusel Tartus. I maailmasõja ajal oli tsaariarmees, tegi rindejoonistusi. 1918 oli Roosileht Põltsamaa Reaalgümnaasiumi joonistusõpetaja, alates 1919 Paide gümnaasiumi õpetaja. 1920 abiellus Magda Angelusega. Hukkus 1941 augustis mahalaskmisel.
artists.ben: Grew up in Järvamaa, in Nõmküla parish, at Remmiku farm. Studied art from 1901 at the drawing courses of the Paide Karskuse Kuratoorium, led by Rudolf Lepik, in 1906 at the Stieglitz School of Technical Drawing in St. Petersburg, in 1907 in the studios of Michael Zeno Diemer and Heinrich Heidner in Munich. In 1910 continued his studies in St. Petersburg at the art school of the Society for the Encouragement of the Arts, where his teacher was Ivan Bilibin. In 1913 received the qualification of drawing teacher. In 1909 exhibited for the first time at an art exhibition in Tartu. During the First World War he served in the Tsarist army, making front-line drawings. In 1918 Roosileht was the drawing teacher at Põltsamaa Realgymnasium, from 1919 a teacher at Paide Gymnasium. In 1920 married Magda Angelus. Perished by shooting in August 1941.

artists.wdesc: Canadian painter, lithographer, and muralist of Estonian origin (1932-2026)

artists.b: Sündinud Tallinnas 1945. aastal. Kunstihariduse omandas Eesti Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, mille lõpetas maali erialal 1969. Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige alates 1979. aastast. Näitustel esineb alates 1970. aastast.1992.aastast Eesti Kunstiakadeemia õppejõud. Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu Eestseisuse liige alates 1997 aastast. Eesti akvarellistide ühenduse liige 2002 . 2006.a. Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu esimees.
artists.ben: Born in Tallinn in 1945. He received his art education at the Estonian State Art Institute, graduating in painting in 1969. Member of the Estonian Artists' Union since 1979. Has taken part in exhibitions since 1970. Since 1992 a lecturer at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Member of the Board of the Estonian Painters' Association since 1997. Member of the Estonian Watercolourists' Association 2002. In 2006 chairman of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Uno Roosvalt on tunnustust pälvinud kogu loometee vältel, sh on talle omistatud Moskva Noortenäituse diplom (1972, 1975), NSVL Rahvamajandusnäituse pronksmedal (1984), Pühajärve preemia (1993 ja 1994), Maalijate Liidu preemia (2000) ja Konrad Mäe preemia (2011)
artists.ben: Uno Roosvalt has received recognition throughout his creative career, including the diploma of the Moscow Youth Exhibition (1972, 1975), the bronze medal of the USSR Exhibition of Economic Achievements (1984), the Pühajärve Prize (1993 and 1994), the Prize of the Painters' Association (2000) and the Konrad Mägi Prize (2011).

artists.b: Oli Venemaa kõrge riigiametnik, asehalduskorra üks loojaid. OliVene saatkonna sekretär Kopenhagenis ja 1749-1755 Londonis. 1756 Vene sõjaväes major, ülemkortrermeister, 1764-1776 Novgorodi kuberner, 1776-1781 Tveri, 1777 ka Pihkva ja Novgorodi asevalitseja, salanõuni. 1793 sai Venemaa saafdikuks Varssavis, jne. Abiellus oma onutütre Elisabeth von Sieversiga, kellest lahutati, naine abiellus vürst Putjatiniga, kellega elasid Dresdenis.
artists.ben: Was a high-ranking Russian state official, one of the creators of the vicegerency system. Was secretary of the Russian embassy in Copenhagen and in 1749-1755 in London. In 1756 major in the Russian army, ober-quartermaster, 1764-1776 Governor of Novgorod, 1776-1781 of Tver, 1777 also vice-governor of Pskov and Novgorod, privy councillor. In 1793 became Russia's envoy in Warsaw, etc. Married his cousin Elisabeth von Sievers, from whom he was divorced; the woman married Prince Putyatin, with whom they lived in Dresden.

artists.b: Baltisaksa kirjamees, estofiil ja pastor. Isa oli postijaamapidaja. Töötas Tori ja Pärnu kogudustes pastorina. Toimetas aastatel 1813–32 esimest eestiainelist teaduslikku sariväljaannet, ajakirja Beiträge zur genauern Kenntniss der ehstnischen Sprache. Tema eestvedamisel ehitati 1821. a Pärnus teatrimaja. Asutas 1814. a Pärnus Eesti koolmeistrite kooli, mis oli esimene teadaolev pedagoogikaõppeasutus, kus õpetati eesti keeles. Andis välja kooliraamatuid ning korraldas esimeste eestikeelsete näidendite lavastamist. Kogus õpilaste ja leerilaste abiga rahvaluulet. Tegeles aastakümneid eestikeelsete raamatute ja käsikirjade kogumise ning bibliografeerimisega.
artists.ben: A Baltic-German man of letters, Estophile and pastor. His father was a postmaster. He worked as a pastor in the congregations of Tori and Pärnu. From 1813 to 1832 he edited the first scholarly serial publication on Estonian subjects, the journal Beiträge zur genauern Kenntniss der ehstnischen Sprache. Under his leadership a theatre building was built in Pärnu in 1821. In 1814 he founded a school for Estonian schoolmasters in Pärnu, which was the first known pedagogical institution where teaching was conducted in Estonian. He published schoolbooks and organised the staging of the first plays in Estonian. With the help of pupils and confirmands he collected folklore. For decades he was engaged in collecting and bibliographing Estonian-language books and manuscripts.

artists.b: Linda ROSIN (1904, Lesnoi, Peterburi – 1981, Tallinn) oli eesti kujur, kes skulptuuri kõrval harrastas ka õlimaali. Skulptuuris viljeles peamiselt portreed ja figuraalkompositsiooni, portreedes omane teatud maneristlik laad. Kunstihariduse omandas Rosin Riigi Kunsttööstuskoolis naiskäsitööerialal (omandas muuhulgas ka joonistusõpetaja kutse), rakendusskulptuuri erialal Tallinna Rakenduskunsti Koolis ja skulptuurierialal Tallinna Riiklikus Tarbekunsti Instituudis, kus asus pärast lõpetamist tööle õppejõuna.
artists.ben: Linda ROSIN (1904, Lesnoi, St. Petersburg – 1981, Tallinn) was an Estonian sculptor who, alongside sculpture, also practised oil painting. In sculpture she worked mainly in portraiture and figural composition, her portraits having a certain mannerist quality. Rosin received her art education at the State School of Applied Art in the women's handicraft speciality (also obtaining a drawing teacher's qualification), in applied sculpture at the Tallinn School of Applied Art, and in sculpture at the Tallinn State Institute of Applied Art, where after graduating she began working as a teacher.

artists.b: Lembe Ruben (s. 1974) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika eriala. Magistrikraad vabades kunstides 2002. Wiiralti noore kunstniku preemia 2011. Ta on õpetanud graafikat, joonistamist ja kompositsiooni Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja huvialaringides; kujundanud ja illustreerinud ajakirju ja raamatuid; tegelenud ka animatsiooni, lavakujunduse ja näituste kureerimisega.
artists.ben: Lembe Ruben (b. 1974) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in the field of graphic art. Master's degree in fine arts 2002. Wiiralt Young Artist Prize 2011. She has taught graphic art, drawing, and composition at the Estonian Academy of Arts and in hobby groups; designed and illustrated magazines and books; and has also engaged in animation, stage design, and exhibition curating.

artists.b: Geometric abstractionist; her 1970s urban design projects were decades early.
artists.ben:
Sirje Runge (1950) is a painter and designer, recognised for her geometric abstract and minimalist paintings. In her earlier work Runge combined geometric balance and disciplined expressions to create repetitions of geometric shapes. In parallel to her interest in geometric elements the artist also has a deep interest in colour, which, over time, has become the main focus of her work.

Runge belongs among the artists who in the beginning of the 1970s created the new and more radical wave of Estonian avant-garde art. During this decade, as Runge was finding herself as an artist, she was experimenting with various styles. Works from her early creative period (e.g. “Pigeon above the city”, 1970; “Tigers in the city”, 1969) are characteristic of her generation, displaying architectural and design aesthetics. In 1975 Runge defended her diploma work “Possibilities for shaping the milieu of Tallinn city centre” that has since gained international attention. The work, executed in a colourful aesthetic, envisioned utopian futures for the city of Tallinn. Together with Leonhard Lapin and Raul Meel, Runge was one of the initiators of “Harku '75”, a landmark exhibition in the Estonian artistic renewal of the 1970s.

Soon figures in Runge's work were replaced by geometric shapes: triangles, quadrangles and circles. This period is characterised by a regular and structured approach to shapes and colours (e.g. “Geometry XI”, 1976; “Space II”, 1977). Focusing on colour, by the beginning of the 1980s the artist developed a vision based exclusively on colour sensitivity. Art historian Eha Komissarov has written that during this period the artist entrusted colour with conveying her message. The geometric forms she uses carry significance primarily as vessels of colour.

In the end of the 1980s Runge's work mainly consisted of abstract paintings in delicate tones. In the ethereal, deep and finely painted colour field the meaningful aspects were based on the limitations of the tonal scale (e.g. “Catastrophe III”, 1987; “Catastrophe VII”, 1988). In the 1990s Runge continued with minimalist painting and created large-format oil paintings, such as the series “Shadows” (1993–1994) and “Architectones” (1998). In the 2000s the artist created works that she considers among the most significant in her oeuvre: “Dance macabre” (2001–2003), “Great love” (2003) and “Battle flags” (2006), the last painting series before Runge quit painting.

artists.wdesc: Estonian artist, writer, photographer, and environmentalist (born 1974)

artists.b: Sündis Moskvas vene- ja poola juurtega haritlasperes ning saabus oma juristidest vanematega Tallinna aastal 1956. Lõpetanud Tallinna 19. keskkooli, astus ta Eesti Riiklikku Kunstinstituuti, lõpetades õpingud 1972. aastal skulptorina.
artists.ben: Born in Moscow into a family of intellectuals with Russian and Polish roots, he arrived in Tallinn with his lawyer parents in 1956. Having finished Tallinn Secondary School No. 19, he entered the Estonian State Art Institute, completing his studies in 1972 as a sculptor.

artists.b: Pärast nüüdse Pelgulinna Gümnaasiumi lõpetamist 1976. aastal asus ta tööle toonasesse Noorsooteatrisse reklaamikujundajana. Geomeetriliste guaššijoonistustega jõudis Andrus Rõuk 1977. aastal oma esimese ühisnäituseni Tartu Ülikooli vanas kohvikus.
artists.ben: After graduating from what is now Pelgulinna Gymnasium in 1976, he started working at the then Youth Theatre as an advertising designer. With his geometric gouache drawings, Andrus Rõuk reached his first joint exhibition in 1977 at the old café of the University of Tartu.

artists.b: Õppis Võru gümnaasiumis, 1928-30 ja 1934-1939 Tartus, kunstikoolis Pallas, mille lõpetas graafikuna. 1942 võitis Haridusdirektooriumi ideekavandite võistlusel I preemia graafilise sarja kavandi eest "Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus". 21.09.1944 siirdus eksiili, elas mitmel pool Saksamaal DP laagrites, 1949 asus USA-sse. Juhatas 1958-1973 Eesti kultuurfondi New Yorgis.
artists.ben: Studied at Võru Gymnasium, 1928-30 and 1934-1939 in Tartu, at the art school Pallas, which he graduated from as a graphic artist. In 1942 he won the I prize in the Education Directorate's design competition for the design of the print series "Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus" [South Estonian man and nature]. On 21.09.1944 he went into exile, lived in various DP camps in Germany, in 1949 moved to the USA. He directed the Estonian Cultural Fund in New York from 1958-1973.

Tõnis Saadoja (1980) is a painter, working with figurative analysis and matters of personal history (writings) and “small histories”. His works are described by their conceptual structure and quest for the technically exclusive form in everyday motives. The use of series are prevailing in Saadoja’s ouvre, the selected motive varies in a multiple sequence of works. Using photography as a starting point, he deals with the deceptive un-pretentiousness but also its capacity to shape reality.

In Saadoja’s early painting series “The Melting of an Ice cube” (2003) and “Exercise” (2004) and “Exercise 2” (2010) which depict a wooden plank, it’s possible to notice a scale of instrumentality that also pops up in his later work. “The Melting of an Ice cube” depicts with conceptual consistency the process in which the invested energy and volume is in contradiction with the choice for undistinguished motive. Methodical repetitiveness and obsessive attention to detail are also expressed in his later work. With the series “Mainstream I-XX” (2005) Saadoja paraphrased Gerhard Richter’s painting series “48 portraits” which was exhibited in 1972 at the Venice Biennial. The basis of those paintings was a single portrait of a smiling Richter, depicted through different painting techniques and figure deformations.

Saadoja displays urban views in the series “Hometown Tallinn” (2007-2008), “14.06.09” (2009) and “Candle” (2011). “Hometown Tallinn” is a 94-part series of miniature aquarelles, which offer a cross-section of the development of urban space and different social reference points in the format of a souvenir. “14.06.09” is a 9-part light box series, which by blinking in sync, depict neglected nightly crossroads of Tallinn city centre. “Candle”, shown from a carousel, exposits a sequence of 64 photos of deterioratingurban settings, taken in similar geometrical composition.

Saadoja has created a painting, which is situated on the ceiling of a Stalinist building in Tallinn city centre, address Sakala 3. This 50-square metre artwork is one of the few contemporary monumental paintings in a public space. The circular painting depicts pine treetops, Saadoja binds the fleeting nature of monumental artworks derived from traces of degradation and pale monochromatic colouring.

artists.b: Sven Saag (s. 1968) on Eesti maali- ja graafikakunstnik. Ta on õppinud maalikunsti Tartu Ülikoolis maali õppetoolis aastatel 1991-1994. Kunstnik on osalenud arvukatel näitustel nii kodus- kui ka välismaal. Oma maalimisest räägib kunstnik: “Nagu restauraator, kes eemaldab värvikihte ja leiab nende alt järjest uusi figuure, vaateid, nägusid, võib ka oma maalidele läheneda sügavuti – kraapida maale ja avastada värvikihtide alt järjest uusi ja vanu pilte.” Aastast 2001 Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige ja aastast 2008 Eesti Maalilkunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Sven Saag (b. 1968) is an Estonian painter and graphic artist. He studied painting at the Chair of Painting of the University of Tartu from 1991 to 1994. The artist has participated in numerous exhibitions both at home and abroad. The artist says of his painting: "Like a restorer who removes layers of paint and finds ever new figures, views, faces beneath them, one can also approach one's own paintings in depth — scrape the paintings and discover ever new and old images beneath the layers of paint." Since 2001 a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and since 2008 a member of the Estonian Painters' Association.

artists.b: Tartu maalikunstnik ja pedagoog. 1949 asus õppima Tartu Riiklikku Kunstiinstituuti maalikunsti erialale, 1955 lõpetas Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi. 1957-1992 töötas Tartu kunstikoolis joonistusõpetajana, seejärel, kuni pensionini minekuni ka maaliõpetajana.Näitustel hakkas esinema alates1956. aastast.
artists.ben: A Tartu painter and pedagogue. In 1949 he/she began studying painting at the Tartu State Art Institute, in 1955 graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute. From 1957-1992 he/she worked as a drawing teacher at the Tartu Art School, and thereafter, until retirement, also as a painting teacher. He/she began exhibiting at exhibitions from 1956.

artists.b: Õppis alates 1947. aastast Tartu Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis, lõpetas 1953. aastal ERKI. Töötas aastatel 1953-1954 Tartu linna kultuurimajas ja 1954-1967 Kunstifondi Tartu osakonnas kunstnikuna ning 1967-1992 Tartu Kunstikoolis maaliõpetajana. Alates 1963. aastast Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: He studied from 1947 at the Tartu State Art Institute, graduated from ERKI in 1953. He worked in 1953-1954 at the Tartu town culture house and in 1954-1967 at the Tartu department of the Art Fund as an artist, and in 1967-1992 as a painting teacher at the Tartu Art School. Member of the Artists' Union from 1963.

artists.b: Sten Saarits (s. 1987 Tallinnas) on installatsioonikunstnik, kelle loometöö peamiseks uurimisobjektiks on indiviidi suhestumine materiaalsusega ja enese positsioneerimine ruumis ning sündmuste ahelas. Sten kasutab oma teoste mõju vahendamiseks vaatajale erinevaid meediume. Peamiselt esineb kunstnik teostega, kus ta kasutab heli kui materjali erinevate vormide loomiseks, mida saab tajuda vaid akustilisel moel. Sten Saarits on õppinud Viini Kaunite Kunstide Akadeemias ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Kunstnik on ka ennast täiendanud arvukate rahvusvaheliste workshopide ja praktika raames. Sten Saarits on pälvinud Noore Skulptori preemianäitusel teise koha (2012) ning grand prix (2013). Ta on saanud ka Eduard Wiiralti stipendiumi. Sten on osalenud näitustel ja grupiprojektides Eestis, Austrias, Rootsis, Taanis, Prantsusmaal ja Leedus.
artists.ben: Sten Saarits (b. 1987 in Tallinn) is an installation artist whose creative work primarily investigates the individual's relationship with materiality and self-positioning in space and in the chain of events. Sten uses various media to convey the effect of his works to the viewer. The artist mainly presents works in which he uses sound as a material to create various forms that can only be perceived acoustically. Sten Saarits has studied at the Vienna Academy of Fine Arts and at the Estonian Academy of Arts. The artist has also furthered his education through numerous international workshops and practical training. Sten Saarits has won second place (2012) and the grand prix (2013) at the Young Sculptor Award exhibition. He has also received the Eduard Wiiralt scholarship. Sten has taken part in exhibitions and group projects in Estonia, Austria, Sweden, Denmark, France and Lithuania.

artists.b: * 16.12. (vkj.); teistel andmetel sündis Mestnitsis (Kaluga kub.), kuid see võib oll vaid ta pärisorjuse aegse emanda pärusmõis.
artists.ben: * 16.12. (O.S.); according to other information he was born in Mestnitsy (Kaluga Governorate), but this may only be the hereditary estate of his mistress from the time of serfdom.

artists.b: Günther Reindorffi juures graafikat. 1930. aastal läks ta üle Pallasesse ja jätkas maaliõpinguid N. Triigi ning graafikaõpinguid A. Vabbe juhendusel. Kooli lõpetas R. Sagrits 1936. aastal.
artists.ben: ...printmaking under Günther Reindorff. In 1930 he transferred to Pallas and continued his painting studies under N. Triik and his printmaking studies under A. Vabbe. R. Sagrits graduated from the school in 1936.

artists.ben: Born: 3.6.1960 in Pärnu Education: Estonian Academy of Arts Membership: member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 1991 Has exhibited since 1983. Speciality: graphic art, book illustration, sculpture Nominations: 2017 'Enter into Art' 2017, Cologne, Germany, Excellence Jury Prize 2015 2nd International Print Exhibition "In Search of Lost Paradise", Granada, Spain – Special Prize of the Archbishop of Granada 2013 7th Presbytère St-Nicolas International Miniature Print Art Exhibition, Lévis, Canada – Special Prize European Contemporary Graphic Art Triennial, Tournefeuille, Municipal Media Centre, exhibition of the Baltic States, Toulouse, France – 1st Prize 2012 A4 International Contemporary Print Art, Cornwall, England, one of three winning works 2011 6th International Miniature Art Exhibition, Levis, Quebec, Canada, 3rd Prize 7th Trois-Rivières International Print Biennial, Canada, Audience Prize 2010 9th Lessedra International Small Graphics, Bulgaria, 2nd Prize A4 International Contemporary Print Art Exhibition, Cornwall, England, 1st Prize 2009 K.
