artists.b: Otto Friedrich von Pistholkors IV (1789-1843) oli samanimelise Rutikvere mõisaomaniku (1754-1831) vanim poeg. Abiellus Helene von Oettingeniga. Kaotas sõjaväeteenistuses amputeerimise teel jala, mille tõttu signeeris oma pilte kargu märgiga.
artists.ben: Otto Friedrich von Pistholkors IV (1789–1843) was the eldest son of the owner of the Rutikvere manor of the same name (1754–1831). He married Helene von Oettingen. He lost a leg to amputation during military service, and thereafter signed his pictures with a crutch mark.

artists.b: Vanemad Priidu ja Maria Hõispu. Lapsepõlvekodu Pihtla v. Vanamõisa k. Saare talus.Juhtis 1915/16 Danilovisse evakueeritud gümnasistina kuulsa liuvälja rajamist.1920. a. kevadtalvel sattus Peipsi ääres salakaubaveole kaasa aitamise tõttu kohtu alla ja mõisteti sunnitööle, kuid vabastati karistusest V-sõjas üles näidatud vapruse eest ning arvati reservi. ["Sakala" 21.04.1920.]II m.-sõja algul lahkus koos abikaasa ja väikes tütrega Argentiinasse.Suri samas neeruhaiguse tagajärjel.
artists.ben: Parents Priidu and Maria Hõisp. Childhood home at the Saare farm, Vanamõisa village, Pihtla parish. In 1915/16, as a gymnasium student evacuated to Danilov, he led the construction of the famous skating rink. In the spring/winter of 1920, he was put on trial for helping with smuggling near Lake Peipsi and sentenced to forced labour, but was released from punishment for bravery shown in the War of Independence and transferred to the reserve. ["Sakala" 21.04.1920.] At the beginning of World War II, he left for Argentina together with his wife and small daughter. He died there as a result of kidney disease.

Kristina Õllek, Fluxes of Sediments no.2". 2023. Pigment ink print, 40×57 cm, with grown sea salt, cyanobacteria, green fluorescent pigment, limestone,

Kristina Õllek (1989) is a visual artist working in the field of photography, video and installation, with a focus on investigating contemporary visual culture and display; its materiality as well as the actual mode of mediation of the representation process. In her practice she frequently uses situations when fact and fiction, synthetic and natural, copies and the original intertwine, becoming a hybrid object/matter to obtain fresh meaning.

She’s interested in stretching the boundaries of what can we see and use from an image and space, especially now in the age of rapidly developing and highly manipulative technology. Within her recent projects she’s been more interested in the notion of new technologies and geological matter, the connectivity of the spatial and ecological circumstances, as well the components and resources that enable such technologies to create today’s environment.

Her work is often site-sensitive and analyses the location and the format of exhibition-making, questioning the display and the politics of installation from the perspective of a historical museum to an online space and future archeology.

artists.b: Ülo Õun on mõjutanud tervet põlvkonda Eesti kujureid, ehkki pole kunagi õppejõuna töötanud. Temaga tuli Eesti 1970. aastate skulptuuri midagi olemuslikult uut: senikogematu sõbralik grotesk, mis väljendus nii skulptori loodud portreedes kui ka figuraalses vabaloomingus. Üllatav oli ka kaudselt Alberto Giacometti (1901–1966) hilist loomingut meenutav vaba modelleering. Tänu Ülo Õunale muutus Eesti skulptuur tunduvalt kommunikatiivsemaks. Teda köitis värv skulptuuris, vormide voolavus ja muutlikkus. Ülo Õuna töömeetod erines oluliselt kaasaegsete Eesti skulptorite vormitaotlustest. Tema skulptuuridel puudus enamasti tol perioodil Eesti skulptuuris üldiselt oluliseks peetud natuuri järgiv modelleering ja sellest tuletatud üldistus. Õuna portreede ja figuuride voolavad vormid valgusid omatahtsi. Ta eelistas lõpliku materjalina seni vahematerjaliks peetud kipsi ja värvis oma skulptuure eredate aniliinvärvidega, mis kahjuks on oma intensiivsuse praeguseks enamasti kaotanud. Ta püüdis tuua skulptuuri kvaliteete, mida on tavaliselt peetud omaseks teatrikunstile ja muusikale. Ülo Õun lõpetas 1966. aastal ENSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi ja oli pärast lühikest ametitööd Eesti Loodusmuuseumi taksidermistina kogu elu vabakunstnik.
artists.ben: Ülo Õun has influenced an entire generation of Estonian sculptors, even though he never worked as a teacher. With him came something essentially new to Estonian sculpture of the 1970s: a previously unencountered, friendly grotesque, which found expression both in the portraits created by the sculptor and in figurative free creation. Also surprising was a free modelling that indirectly recalled the late work of Alberto Giacometti (1901–1966). Thanks to Ülo Õun, Estonian sculpture became considerably more communicative. He was captivated by colour in sculpture, and by the fluidity and mutability of forms. Ülo Õun's working method differed significantly from the formal aspirations of contemporary Estonian sculptors. His sculptures generally lacked the nature-following modelling and the generalisation derived from it, which was generally considered important in Estonian sculpture of that period. The flowing forms of Õun's portraits and figures spread according to their own will. As a final material he preferred plaster, which had until then been regarded as an intermediate material, and he painted his sculptures with bright aniline colours, which unfortunately have by now mostly lost their intensity. He sought to bring into sculpture qualities usually considered to belong to theatre art and music. Ülo Õun graduated from the Estonian SSR State Art Institute in 1966 and, after briefly working as a taxidermist at the Estonian Museum of Natural History, was a freelance artist for the rest of his life.

artists.b: Marje Üksine (sünd 1945) õppis aastail 1964-1970 toonases Eesti Riiklikus Kunstiinstituudis graafika erialal. Esimese isikunäituseni jõudis ta 1974. aastal. Tema isikunäitusi on peale Eesti toimunud.
artists.ben: Marje Üksine (b. 1945) studied graphic art at the then Estonian State Art Institute from 1964-1970. She reached her first solo exhibition in 1974. Besides Estonia, her solo exhibitions have taken place.

artists.b: Üliliidulise konkursi ajalehe "Izvestia" laureaat, üleliidulise rahvamajandussaavutuste näituse pronks- ja kuldmedal, Läti NSV I järgi diplom puuvillaste kangaste kõrge kunstilise kujundamise eest baltivabariikide näitusel, osalenud vabariiklikel, üleliidulistel ja rahvusvahelistel näitustel.
artists.ben: Laureate of the All-Union competition of the newspaper "Izvestia", bronze and gold medal of the All-Union Exhibition of Achievements of the National Economy, diploma of the Latvian SSR 1st degree for the high artistic design of cotton fabrics at the exhibition of the Baltic republics, participated in republican, all-union and international exhibitions.

artists.b: Maalis asjalik-kaines laadis põhjavene metsi. Tema stiil baseerub analüütilisele loodusvaatlusele ning erakorselt täpsele ja naturalistlikule, võiks öelda lausa fotograafiat jäljendavale joonistusele. Jälgides tähelepanelikult iga detaili - olgu see siis lilleke või puuoks, ei kaota ta kunagi silmist tervikut.
artists.ben: He painted northern Russian forests in a matter-of-fact, sober manner. His style is based on an analytical observation of nature and an exceptionally precise and naturalistic, one could even say photograph-imitating, drawing. Attentively following every detail - be it a small flower or a tree branch - he never loses sight of the whole.

Bita Razavi (1983) is a multidisciplinary artist whose practice is centered around observations on everyday situations and bringing the personal to the public sphere. She sheds light on the inner workings of social systems in relation to the political structures of various countries. She reacts to, and explores, the agency of the objects and the systems as they act upon her, and as she documents and records them.

(2011) at the Finnish Academy of Fine Arts, she carried out an artistic ceremony, in which she married the artist Jaakko Karhunen in reaction to worsened immigration policies, the rise of a populist right wing party and their introduction of lowering the funds for contemporary art. The project ended in 2017 with a public divorce ceremony. In 2020  Museum of Contemporary Art Kiasma obtained both works in the form of video installations and personal valuables in their collection.

Because of her experience of living in Iran, Estonia and Finland, Razavi is well equipped to reflect on the relationships of these cultures and on the perception of her heritage in the Western world. For instance, Razavi’s work “Pictures from Our Future, Pictures from Our Past” (2018) started from a situation on the street in Tartu where a young man said Razavi was a “picture of the future of Estonia”. In the series of photographs, we see Razavi embodying the average Estonian woman in various everyday roles. It also features photographs of empty country houses that have been abandoned, while dropping hints towards the radical social changes connected with the refugee crisis and urbanisation processes, but also the memory of the violent deportations in Estonia’s past.

Alongside her autofictional works, the installation “The Dog Days Will Be Over Soon” (2019) combining ready-made images from videogames and objects like PC hardware together with live moss and other plans, she points towards both the merging of artificial and natural materials, and the growing distance between humans and wild nature.
artists.wdesc: Iranian artist residing in Finland and Estonia (born 1983)

artists.b: Kristi Kangilaski (s. 1982) on Eesti illustraator, kunstnik ja kujundaja, kelle loomingut iseloomustab poeetiline jutustavus ja tundlik visuaalne keel. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia bakalaureuseõppe 2013. aastal ning tegutseb alates 2012. aastast vabakutselise kunstnikuna. Alates 2020. aastast töötab Kangilaski Viljandi linnakunstnikuna. Kangilaski on loonud ja illustreerinud mitmeid menukaid lasteraamatuid nii autorina kui ka illustraatorina. Tema töid on eksponeeritud laialdaselt Eestis ja rahvusvaheliselt, sealhulgas Tallinna illustratsioonitriennaalil, Bologna lasteraamatumessil, Bratislava illustratsioonibiennaalil ning mitmetel Euroopa rändnäitustel. Tema isikunäitused on toimunud Tartu ja Tallinna galeriides. Kristi Kangilaski kuulub Eesti Kujundusgraafikute Liitu.
artists.ben: Kristi Kangilaski (b. 1982) is an Estonian illustrator, artist and designer, whose work is characterised by poetic narrativity and a sensitive visual language. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a bachelor's degree in 2013 and has worked as a freelance artist since 2012. Since 2020 Kangilaski has worked as the town artist of Viljandi. Kangilaski has created and illustrated several popular children's books, both as author and as illustrator. Her works have been widely exhibited in Estonia and internationally, including at the Tallinn Illustration Triennial, the Bologna Children's Book Fair, the Bratislava Illustration Biennial, and several European touring exhibitions. Her solo exhibitions have taken place in galleries in Tartu and Tallinn. Kristi Kangilaski belongs to the Estonian Association of Graphic Designers.

artists.b: Andres Koort (s. 1969 Tallinnas) on eesti maalikunstnik, stsenograaf, kujundaja ja kuraator. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia lavakujunduse eriala (1987–1993) ja täiendanud end Hollandis Groningenis Academia Minervas maali erialal. Koort on osalenud näitustel alates aastast 1991 ja tegutseb Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu juhatuse liikmena 2002. aastast. Ta on loonud lavakujundusi lavastustele Eesti Draamateatris, Tallinna Linnateatris, Pärnu teatris Endla, Eesti Nukuteatris ja Theatrumis. Kunstniku teoseid leidub Tartu Kunstimuuseumi ja Leedu Kunstimuuseumi kogudes.
artists.ben: Andres Koort (b. 1969 in Tallinn) is an Estonian painter, scenographer, designer and curator. He graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in stage design (1987–1993) and furthered his studies in painting at the Academia Minerva in Groningen, Netherlands. Koort has participated in exhibitions since 1991 and has served as a board member of the Estonian Painters' Association since 2002. He has created stage designs for productions at the Estonian Drama Theatre, Tallinn City Theatre, Endla Theatre in Pärnu, the Estonian Puppet Theatre and Theatrum. The artist's works can be found in the collections of the Tartu Art Museum and the Lithuanian Art Museum.

artists.b: Vilen Künnapu (s. 1948) on kolme aastakümne jooksul kuulunud Eesti olulisimate ning tuntuimate arhitektide hulka, kerkides 1970. aastatel esile riigi esimeste postmodernistlike mõtlejate ja loojate seas.
artists.ben: Vilen Künnapu (b. 1948) has for three decades been among the most important and best-known architects in Estonia, emerging in the 1970s among the country's first postmodernist thinkers and creators.

artists.b: Klassikalist maalikunstitehnikat popkunsti, kitši ja campiga vürtsitav Katrin Valgemäe (sünd. 1979) on vabakutseline kunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Valgemäe on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias maali ja keraamikat, täiendanud ennast Läti Kunstiakadeemias.
artists.ben: Katrin Valgemäe (b. 1979), who spices classical painting technique with pop art, kitsch and camp, is a freelance artist who lives and works in Tallinn. Valgemäe has studied painting and ceramics at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and furthered her studies at the Art Academy of Latvia.

artists.b: Viljandis elav Gert Guriev on arhitekt ja õppejõud, kelle töö keskmes on avalik ruum, haridushooned, tervisekeskused ning kaasaegne puitarhitektuur. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia arhitektuuri ja linnaplaneerimise eriala, täiendanud end Taani Kuninglikus Kunstiakadeemias ning laiendanud oma ruumikäsitlust EKA maalikunsti mikrokraadiga Alates 2012. aastast töötab Guriev 3+1 arhitektide juures, kus on osalenud mitmete oluliste hoonete ja keskkondade loomisel: Narva hariduskompleks, Narva Sisekaitseakadeemia, Ülemiste City ja Narva hariduslinnaku visioonid, Võsu põhikool ja lasteaed, Haapsalu põhikool, Tartu Siili tänava korterelamu, Marienholmi poolsaare kortermajad, Pärnu Seileri kvartal, Tapa tervisekeskus, Suure-Jaani spa ning Eesti Rahva Muuseumi Eesti püsinäituse ruumiline kujundus. Tema looming on pälvinud rohkelt tunnustust. Narva hariduskompleks, Suure-Jaani tervisekoda ja Narva Sisekaitseakadeemia on olnud Euroopa kaasaegse arhitektuuri auhinna EU Mies Award nominendid; Narva Sisekaitseakadeemia on saanud nii Eesti Kultuurkapitali arhitektuuri sihtkapitali peapreemia kui ka Aasta puitehitise Arcwoodi eripreemia. Võsu põhikool ja lasteaed on pärjatud Aasta puitehitise.
artists.ben: Gert Guriev, who lives in Viljandi, is an architect and lecturer whose work focuses on public space, educational buildings, health centres and contemporary timber architecture. He graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in architecture and urban planning, furthered his studies at the Royal Danish Academy of Fine Arts, and expanded his approach to space with a micro-degree in painting at EKA. Since 2012, Guriev has worked at 3+1 arhitektid, where he has taken part in the creation of a number of significant buildings and environments: the Narva education complex, the Narva Academy of Security Sciences, the visions for Ülemiste City and the Narva education campus, the Võsu basic school and kindergarten, the Haapsalu basic school, the apartment building on Siili Street in Tartu, the apartment buildings on the Marienholm peninsula, the Seileri quarter in Pärnu, the Tapa health centre, the Suure-Jaani spa, and the spatial design of the permanent Estonia exhibition at the Estonian National Museum. His work has received considerable recognition. The Narva education complex, the Suure-Jaani health centre, and the Narva Academy of Security Sciences have been nominees for the EU Mies Award for contemporary European architecture; the Narva Academy of Security Sciences has received both the main prize of the Cultural Endowment of Estonia's architecture fund and the Arcwood special award for Building of the Year in Wood. The Võsu basic school and kindergarten has been awarded the Building of the Year in Wood.

artists.b: Gudrun Heamägi on visuaalkunstnik, kes kasutab oma töödes enamasti graafika, foto ja installatiivseid vahendeid. Tema loomingut saab iseloomustada poeetilise ja narratiivse lähenemisega. Teda huvitavad lõputud narratiivid, mis korduvad pidevalt ajas nagu end sabast õgivad müütilised maod. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika osakonna magistriõppe 2013. aastal, täiendanud end Aalto Ülikoolis Soomes. 2019. aastal oli ta Wiiralti preemia laureaat. Tema teoseid on mitmete galeriide, kunstikeskuste jm rahvusvaheliste institutsioonide kogudes. Gudrun Heamägi on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu, Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse ja ofset litograafia töökoja „Ubu Noir“ liige.
artists.ben: Gudrun Heamägi is a visual artist who mostly uses printmaking, photography and installation media in her works. Her creative output can be characterized by a poetic and narrative approach. She is interested in endless narratives that constantly repeat in time like mythical snakes devouring their own tails. She graduated from the master's programme of the Graphic Art Department of the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2013, and continued her studies at Aalto University in Finland. In 2019, she was the laureate of the Wiiralt Prize. Her works are in the collections of several galleries, art centres and other international institutions. Gudrun Heamägi is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association, the Estonian Association of Printmakers and the offset lithography workshop "Ubu Noir".

artists.b: Lauri Koppel (s. 1986) on noor graafik, kes on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika eriala bakalaureuse- ja magistrikraadiga. Koppel on osalenud mitmetel ühisnäitustel ning 2010. aastal pälvis ta kultuuriministeeriumi poolt väljaantava Eduard Wiiralti nimelise stipendiumi. Alates 2013. a. kuulub Koppel Eesti Kunstnike Liitu.
artists.ben: Lauri Koppel (b. 1986) is a young printmaker who has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a bachelor's and master's degree in printmaking. Koppel has participated in a number of group exhibitions and in 2010 he was awarded the Eduard Wiiralt scholarship given out by the Ministry of Culture. Since 2013 Koppel has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Kadri Toom (s. 1984) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika õppetooli magistrikraadiga (2009). Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli maalingute osakonna (2006) ning täiendanud end ka Saimaa Rakenduskõrgkoolis (2005).
artists.ben: Kadri Toom (b. 1984) graduated from the graphic arts department of Eesti Kunstiakadeemia with a master's degree (2009), from the painting department of Tartu Kõrgem Kunstikool (2006), and has also continued her studies at Saimaa Rakenduskõrgkool (2005).

artists.b: Hedi Jaansoo (1989) töötab enamasti väikeste ja õrnade asjade, lillede, ebakindluste, tunnetuste ja tundlikkustega. Oma praktikas kombineerib Jaansoo fotograafiat ja installatiivseid detaile. Tema loomingut läbivateks niitideks on naised, vanaemad, õrnad vastupanud ja vähemärgatavad detailid. 2023. aastal töötas Jaansoo 6-kuulises kunstiresidentuuris WIELSi kaasaegse kunsti keskuses Brüsselis. Alates 2024. aastast on ta Fotokunstnike Ühenduse (FOKU) projektijuht ja FOKU galerii eestvedaja.
artists.ben: Hedi Jaansoo (1989) mostly works with small and delicate things, flowers, uncertainties, feelings and sensitivities. In her practice Jaansoo combines photography and installative details. Recurring threads running through her work are women, grandmothers, gentle resistances and less noticeable details. In 2023 Jaansoo took part in a 6-month artist residency at the WIELS contemporary art centre in Brussels. Since 2024 she has been project manager of the Estonian Society of Photographic Art (FOKU) and head of the FOKU gallery.

artists.b: Lauri Kulpsoo on eesti fotograaf ja trummar. Ta on Tartu Tamme Gümnaasiumi vilistlane ning on õppinud geograafiat Tartu Ülikoolis. Lauri Kulpsoo on töötanud fotograafina ajalehes Postimees ning ajakirjas Pere ja Kodu. Lisaks on teinud kaastööd veel mitmele Eesti ja Soome meediaväljaandele. Kulpsoo fotosid on kasutatud mitmes raamatus. Kulpsoo on mänginud trumme ansamblites Lloyd, Tartu Popi ja Roki Instituut, Jaan Pärn ja Pahad Seemned, Honey Power ning Kuma. Alates 2008. aasta sügisest teeb Lauri Kulpsoo “Fantaasia” saateid Klassikaraadios.
artists.ben: Lauri Kulpsoo is an Estonian photographer and drummer. He is a graduate of Tartu Tamme Gymnasium and has studied geography at the University of Tartu. Lauri Kulpsoo has worked as a photographer for the newspaper Postimees and the magazine Pere ja Kodu. He has also contributed to several other Estonian and Finnish media publications. Kulpsoo's photographs have been used in several books. Kulpsoo has played drums in the bands Lloyd, Tartu Popi ja Roki Instituut, Jaan Pärn ja Pahad Seemned, Honey Power and Kuma. Since autumn 2008 Lauri Kulpsoo has been making "Fantaasia" programmes on Klassikaraadio.

artists.b: Maria Izabella Lehtsaar on Tallinnas tegutsev kunstnik. Ta on lõpetanud EKA graafikaosakonna bakalaureuseõppes ja omandanud magistrikraadi EKA kaasaegse kunsti erialal. Lehtsaar töötab eelkõige alaesindatud kväär kogemuse ja narratiiviga, mängides sageli reaalsuse ja fantaasia piiridega. Tema tööd jutustavad tihti ruumidest ja peidetud sümbolitest ning kodeeritud tähendustest kväär- ja lesbi materiaalkultuuris. Oma loomingus põimib ta popkultuuri esteetikat ja tundlikku monokroomset graafikat, kombineerides neid praktikas tekstiili, joonistamise ja luulega. Erinevate meediumite kasutamine teostes moonutab tuttavlikku, luues mitmekihilisi tähendusi. Lehtsaare esimene isiknäitus “Sinikalilla” toimus 2024 aastal. Lisaks on kunstnik osalenud mitmetel grupinäitustel, näiteks Leedu kaasaegse kunsti muuseumis (MO museum) näitusel “We Don‘t Do This. Intimacy, Norms and Fantasies in Baltic Art”. Kunstnik pälvis 2023 aastal Wiiralti preemia.
artists.ben: Maria Izabella Lehtsaar is an artist working in Tallinn. She graduated from the EKA graphic art department with a bachelor's degree and earned a master's degree in EKA's contemporary art speciality. Lehtsaar works primarily with underrepresented queer experience and narrative, often playing with the boundaries between reality and fantasy. Her works often tell of spaces and hidden symbols, and of coded meanings in queer and lesbian material culture. In her work she weaves together pop culture aesthetics and sensitive monochrome graphic art, combining them in practice with textile, drawing and poetry. The use of different media in her works distorts the familiar, creating multilayered meanings. Lehtsaar's first solo exhibition "Sinikalilla" took place in 2024. In addition, the artist has taken part in several group exhibitions, for example at the Lithuanian Museum of Contemporary Art (MO museum) in the exhibition "We Don't Do This. Intimacy, Norms and Fantasies in Baltic Art". The artist received the Wiiralt Prize in 2023.

artists.b: Inessa Saarits otsib oma praktikas ühisosi kunsti ja bioloogia vahel. Ta huvitub naturaalsetest ja ajas muutuvatest materjalidest ning uurib oma töödes inimese ja looduse vahelist suhet, kasutades elementidena näiteks üraskikäikudest pungil puukoort ja mikroskoobi all filmitud mikroorganisme. Saarits on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia installatsiooni- ja skulptuurieriala ning on täiendanud end Viini Kunstiakadeemias. Ta kuulub ENKKLi ning on noorte kunstisündmuse “Kunstikompott” algatajaliige.
artists.ben: In her practice, Inessa Saarits seeks common ground between art and biology. She is interested in natural and time-changing materials and, in her works, explores the relationship between man and nature, using as elements, for example, tree bark swollen with bark beetle galleries and microorganisms filmed under a microscope. Saarits has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in installation and sculpture and has furthered her studies at the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna. She is a member of ENKKL and a founding member of the young art event "Kunstikompott".

artists.b: Anna-Liisa Sääsk on noor kunstnik ja disainer, kelle looming keskendub graafikale, performance’ile ja erinevatele visuaalmeedia valdkondadele. Varasemate tunnustuste hulka kuuluvad Ilon Wiklandi Noore Kunstniku Preemia ning tunnustus kaasaegse kunsti festivali „Kunstikompott“ korraldamise eest noortele. Kunstikompoti ja kunstikooli väikesest grupist on alguse saanud kunstirühm TEMA, mis on osalenud mitmel festivalil oma performance’ite ja installatsioonidega, näiteks Diverse Universe performance-festival Pärnus, Tartu Valgus, Viljandi Tuled ja Made in Estonia maraton 2024.
artists.ben: Anna-Liisa Sääsk is a young artist and designer whose work focuses on graphics, performance and various fields of visual media. Her earlier recognitions include the Ilon Wikland Young Artist Award and recognition for organising the contemporary art festival "Kunstikompott" for young people. From Kunstikompott and a small group at the art school arose the art group TEMA, which has participated in several festivals with its performances and installations, such as the Diverse Universe performance festival in Pärnu, Tartu Valgus, Viljandi Tuled and the Made in Estonia marathon 2024.

artists.b: As topics in her art practice, Nõmm mainly deals with the (woman’s)body and related things – the relationship between body and space, the connections between the psyche and the body, and other topics, analyzed from a feminist point of view. Both the representation of women’s in society, experience and power relations. Based on this, she also sees an opportunity to deal with personal experiences in her own work. The introspective moment comes in interpreting one’s experiences and integrating them into creation. She often does research art practice, uses archives to get information and conduct interviews. At the moment, she is analyzing ancient Estonian customs and the repressive cultural symbols contained in them. She feels that such an insight into the past by creating parallels with it helps to better analyze the many societal problems that are still relevant and intertwined into today’s customs. One of the most important starting points and the most characteristic material for her is hair and its manipulation. artists.ben: As topics in her art practice, Nõmm mainly deals with the (woman's) body and related things – the relationship between body and space, the connections between the psyche and the body, and other topics, analyzed from a feminist point of view. Both the representation of women's in society, experience and power relations. Based on this, she also sees an opportunity to deal with personal experiences in her own work. The introspective moment comes in interpreting one's experiences and integrating them into creation. She often does research art practice, uses archives to get information and conduct interviews. At the moment, she is analyzing ancient Estonian customs and the repressive cultural symbols contained in them. She feels that such an insight into the past by creating parallels with it helps to better analyze the many societal problems that are still relevant and intertwined into today's customs. One of the most important starting points and the most characteristic material for her is hair and its manipulation. artists.wdesc: Estonian painter, art historian and journalist (1906-2004)

artists.b: Mauri Gross (s. 1969 Raplas) on kunstihariduse saanud Tallinna Ülikoolist ja lisaks õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias lavakujundust. Aastatel 1998- 2007 töötas ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafilise disaini õppejõuna. 2009. aastast on Gross vabakutseline kunstnik, väljendades end peamiselt läbi õlimaali. Teised tegevusvaldkonnad on graafiline disain ja sisekujundus.
artists.ben: Mauri Gross (b. 1969 in Rapla) received his art education at Tallinn University and additionally studied stage design at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Between 1998 and 2007 he worked as a lecturer in graphic design at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Since 2009 Gross has been a freelance artist, expressing himself mainly through oil painting. His other fields of activity are graphic design and interior design.

artists.b: Tarmo Roosimölder (1970) on õppinud Tartu Ülikoolis geoloogiat, maalija ja graafikuna on ta aga iseõppija, kes on end täiendanud mh Tõnis Laanemaa joonistusstuudios. Tema „stiil“ on kujunenud keskooliaegsete kõrbematkade ja kodumaise mereranna koosmõjul, kus väike inimene kohtub suure loodusega. Roosimölder on osalenud näitustel nii Eestis kui ka mujal ning tema teoseid on paljudes erakogudes. Ta on Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Tarmo Roosimölder (1970) studied geology at the University of Tartu, but as a painter and graphic artist he is self-taught, having, among other things, furthered his skills in Tõnis Laanemaa's drawing studio. His "style" has developed under the combined influence of desert trips in his school years and the native seacoast, where the small human meets great nature. Roosimölder has participated in exhibitions both in Estonia and elsewhere, and his works are in many private collections. He is a member of the Estonian Association of Independent Graphic Artists and the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Ivika Luisk (s.1969) on maalikunstnik ja nukufilmikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali- ja monumentaalmaali eriala bakalaureuseõppe 1995 a. ja magistratuuri 1998 a. Luisk on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Eesti maalikunstnike Liidu liige. Kunstikul on seni olnud 15 isiknäitust, ta on esinenud mitmetel grupinäitustel ning teinud kunstnikutöö 15 nukufilmile.Tema loomingus on tähtsal kohal inimene ja loodus, nende omavaheline suhe ja vastastikune mõju.
artists.ben: Ivika Luisk (b.1969) is a painter and puppet-film artist who lives and works in Tallinn. She completed her bachelor's studies in painting and monumental painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 1995 and her master's studies in 1998. Luisk is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Painters' Association. The artist has so far had 15 solo exhibitions, has participated in several group exhibitions and has worked as an artist on 15 puppet films. In her work, an important place is occupied by the human being and nature, their relationship and mutual influence.

artists.b: Vjatšeslav Semerikov on sündinud Venemaal 1949. aasal. Lõpetas 1977. aastal Eesti NSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi graafika erialal. Tema põhilisteks loomealadeks on vaba- ja tarbegraafika, raamatukujundus ning maalikunst. Ta on osalenud alates 1988. aastast paljudel ühisnäitustel ja korraldanud ka isikunäitusi nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. Tema tööd on galeriides ja erakollektsioonides Eestis, Venemaal, Soomes, Prantsusmaal, Itaalias, Kreekas, Ameerika Ühendriikides, Jaapanis, Rootsis ja Hollandis. Vjatšeslav Semerikov kuulub Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liikmeskonda ja Eestis tegutsevasse Vene Kunstnike Ühendusse.Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Vjatšeslav Semerikov was born in Russia in 1949. He graduated in 1977 from the Estonian SSR State Art Institute in the speciality of graphic art. His main fields of creative work are free and applied graphic art, book design and painting. He has participated in numerous joint exhibitions since 1988 and has also organised solo exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad. His works are in galleries and private collections in Estonia, Russia, Finland, France, Italy, Greece, the United States of America, Japan, Sweden and the Netherlands. Vjatšeslav Semerikov is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and of the Association of Russian Artists operating in Estonia. Member of the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Sündinud 1974 Tallinnas, Katrin on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide eriala 2005 – 2012 Viimased olulisemad näitused: “MIS VÄRVI ON ARMASTUS”, Kunstiruum Gallery, Tallinn, Estonia (2021), MERRILY, MERRILY, MERRILY, Sakala keskus, Viljandi; Kõnnu Viinaköögi Gallery, Estonia (2021), IN THE LIGHT, Fruttis Gallery, Brazil, Abadiania (2021), 20. Spring Exhibition of Estonian Artists Association ‘‘Kunstnikud maalivad kunstnikke’’, Tallinn Art Hall, Estonia (2020), GAIA, Sargvere Manor, Estonia 2020, TROPICAL PASSION, Caminho Encantado Gallery, Brazil, Abadiania and in Kõnnu Viinaköögi Gallery, Estonia.
artists.ben: Born in 1974 in Tallinn, Katrin studied fine arts at the Estonian Academy of Arts from 2005–2012. Most important recent exhibitions: "MIS VÄRVI ON ARMASTUS", Kunstiruum Gallery, Tallinn, Estonia (2021), MERRILY, MERRILY, MERRILY, Sakala Centre, Viljandi; Kõnnu Viinaköögi Gallery, Estonia (2021), IN THE LIGHT, Fruttis Gallery, Brazil, Abadiania (2021), 20th Spring Exhibition of Estonian Artists Association "Kunstnikud maalivad kunstnikke", Tallinn Art Hall, Estonia (2020), GAIA, Sargvere Manor, Estonia 2020, TROPICAL PASSION, Caminho Encantado Gallery, Brazil, Abadiania and in Kõnnu Viinaköögi Gallery, Estonia.

artists.b: Külli Suitso (s. 1974. a. Tartus) lôpetas 1996. a. TÜ maaliosakonna. Aastatel 2001-2004 töötasTartu Kôrgemas Kunstikoolis lektorina. Aastast 2004 elab ja töötab Taanis. Alates 2013. a. ôpetab maali Århuse Kunstiakadeemias.
artists.ben: Külli Suitso (b. 1974 in Tartu) graduated in 1996 from the Department of Painting at the University of Tartu. In 2001-2004 she worked as a lecturer at the Tartu Art College. Since 2004 she has lived and worked in Denmark. Since 2013 she has taught painting at the Aarhus Academy of Fine Arts.

artists.b: Jüri Mildeberg kuulub Eesti Kunstnike Liitu, Eesti Kujundusgraafikute Liitu ja IBBY Eesti osakonda. Ta on illustreerinud lasteraamatuid, teinud koostööd ajakirjadega ja loonud 2005. aastal Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu identiteedi. Lisaks on ta maalinud Eesti Lastekirjanduse Keskuse saali aknaluugid (2008) ja loonud eksliibriseid. Tema teosed kuuluvad Eesti Rahvusraamatukogu kunstikogusse ja Eesti Lastekirjanduse Keskuse illustratsioonikogusse.
artists.ben: Jüri Mildeberg is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association, the Estonian Association of Graphic Designers, and the Estonian branch of IBBY. He has illustrated children's books, collaborated with magazines, and created the identity of Estonian Public Broadcasting in 2005. In addition, he painted the window shutters of the hall of the Estonian Children's Literature Centre (2008) and created ex libris. His works belong to the art collection of the National Library of Estonia and to the illustration collection of the Estonian Children's Literature Centre.

artists.b: Orest Kormašov (1964) on maalikunstnik, ikooniloolane ja restauraator. Tema maalid on inspireeritud loodusest, inimestest ja igapäevaelu hetkedest, kuid peegeldavad elu sügavamaid kihte ja pakuvad mõtteainet. Kormašov on lõpetanud ERKI maali eriala (1990), omandanud kunstiajaloo magistrikraadi Tallinna Ülikoolis (2001) ning töötanud pikalt sealsamas Kunstide Instituudis. Ta on osalenud näitustel ning neid ka korraldanud, avaldanud artikleid, tegelenud vana-Vene ikoonikunsti konserveeri- misega ning viib alates 2014. aastast läbi mitmeid temaa- tilisi ekskursioone Ikoonimuuseumis. Kormašov on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Orest Kormašov (1964) is a painter, icon scholar and restorer. His paintings are inspired by nature, people and moments of everyday life, but reflect deeper layers of life and offer food for thought. Kormašov graduated from ERKI in the field of painting (1990), obtained a master's degree in art history at Tallinn University (2001) and worked for a long time at the Institute of Art there. He has participated in exhibitions and also organised them, published articles, worked on the conservation of ancient Russian icon art, and since 2014 has been conducting a number of thematic tours at the Icon Museum. Kormašov is a member of the Estonian Painters' Association and the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Margus Kontus (1987) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia Kaasaja kunsti õppekava (MA2020). Osalenud mitmetel grupinäitustel ja valgusfestivalidel. Margus Kontuse loomingut iseloomustab magnetismi mõtestamine läbi kunsti. Tema teaosed on justkui pisikesed meditatsioonid, mis otsivad seoseid nähtava ja nähtamatu maailma vahel. Aastast 2020 kuulub ta kunstirühmitusse DARKovSKY.
artists.ben: Margus Kontus (1987) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts' Contemporary Art curriculum (MA2020). Has participated in several group exhibitions and light festivals. Margus Kontus's work is characterised by the interpretation of magnetism through art. His works are like tiny meditations that seek connections between the visible and the invisible world. Since 2020 he has belonged to the art group DARKovSKY.

artists.b: Vladimir Baciu (s. 1965 Gilicenis, Moldovas) on lõpetanud Kishinjovi I. Repini nimelise Kunstikooli maalikunstnik-pedagoogina (1984). Alates 1985 elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige ja eesti- vene kunstnike grupi OKO liige.
artists.ben: Vladimir Baciu (b. 1965 in Gilicenis, Moldova) graduated as a painter-pedagogue from the I. Repin Art School in Kishinev (1984). Since 1985 he has lived and worked in Tallinn. He is a member of the Estonian Artists' Union and of the Estonian-Russian artists' group OKO.

artists.b: Regina-Mareta Soonsein (1991) on lõpetanud Kõrgema Kunstikooli Pallas 2019. aastal maali erialal, ent viimastel aastatel keskendunud oma loomingus linoollõikele. Tema autoripositsioon hõlmab joone subjektistamist, paine, hävimise ilu, hälbimise, lõhestumise, sisekaemuste ja arhetüüpide temaatikat. Osalenud grupinäitustel, teinud isikunäituseid ja loonud ekspositsioone avalikel sotsiaalpindadel alates aastast 2017. Pälvinud Biafarin Awardi preemia NordArt näitusel, Wiiralti preemia publikulemmiku tiitli, I Land Sound festivali parima lavakujunduse preemia, Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse aasta uue tulija tiitli.
artists.ben: Regina-Mareta Soonsein (1991) graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences in 2019 in painting, but in recent years has focused her creative work on linocut. Her authorial position encompasses the subjectification of line, the beauty of coercion and destruction, and the themes of deviation, fragmentation, introspection and archetypes. She has participated in group exhibitions, held solo exhibitions and created expositions in public social spaces since 2017. She has received the Biafarin Award at the NordArt exhibition, the Wiiralt Prize audience favourite title, the best stage design award at the I Land Sound festival, and the title of Newcomer of the Year from the Estonian Association of Independent Graphic Artists.
