artists.b: Jaanika Peerna (1971) on Tallinnas sündinud kunstnik, kes elanud ja töötanud New Yorgis alates 1998. aastast. Magistriõpingud lõpetas 2005 New Yorgi Osariigi Ulikoolis. Tema loodusjõududest pungis tööd hõlmavad väga eri mõõtmetes joonistusi, installatsioone ja ühe enam performance kunsti. Peerna töid leidub sadades era ja avalikes kollektsioonides ning teda esindab esindab USAs JHB Fine Art and ARC Fine Art. 2018 aastal ostis Glynn Vivian UK muuseum oma kogusse Peerna performance nimega Liustike Eleegia.
artists.ben: Jaanika Peerna (1971) is an artist born in Tallinn who has lived and worked in New York since 1998. She completed her master's studies in 2005 at the State University of New York. Her works, brimming with the forces of nature, encompass drawings, installations and, increasingly, performance art of very different scales. Peerna's works can be found in hundreds of private and public collections, and she is represented in the USA by JHB Fine Art and ARC Fine Art. In 2018, the Glynn Vivian museum in the UK purchased for its collection Peerna's performance titled Glacier Elegy.

artists.b: Aleksei Shatunov (s. 1981) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia, kunstipedagoogika eriala magistrikraadiga (2009); 2008 täiendas ta end Hispaanias Valencias Politecnico de Valencia Belas Artes ridades. Ta kuulub Eesti Kunstnike Liitu ja Vene Kunstnike Ühendusse Eestis.
artists.ben: Aleksei Shatunov (b. 1981) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in art pedagogy (2009); in 2008 he furthered his studies in Spain at the Universidad Politécnica de Valencia, Facultad de Bellas Artes. He is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Union of Russian Artists in Estonia.

artists.b: Rait Rosin (s. 1981) on omandanud bakalaureusekraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali erialal (2005), magistrikraadi sealsamas kunsti erialal (2007) ning jätkab õpinguid EKAs kunsti ja disaini doktorantuuris (alates 2015). Kunstihariduse kõrval on Rosin omandanud magistrikraadi filosoofia valdkonnas Tallinna Ülikoolist (2013).
artists.ben: Rait Rosin (b. 1981) earned a bachelor's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts (2005), a master's degree in art from the same institution (2007), and continues his studies in the doctoral programme in art and design at EKA (since 2015). Besides his artistic education, Rosin has earned a master's degree in philosophy from Tallinn University (2013).

artists.b: Ivi Arrak maalib akrüülvärvidega, tema lõuendeid täidavad tundeküllased, emotsionaalselt rikkad ja harmooniliselt tasakaalus kompositsioonid. Ivi Arraku teosed eristuvad tänasest eesti kunstist just hea värvimeele ja tundliku vormikäsitluse poolest. Näiliselt abstraktsetest pindadest eenduvad suure üldistusjõuga kujundid, mis suunavad vaataja imelisse looduslähedasse maailma.
artists.ben: Ivi Arrak paints with acrylic paints, her canvases filled with emotionally rich and harmoniously balanced compositions. Ivi Arrak's works stand out in today's Estonian art precisely for their good sense of colour and sensitive treatment of form. From seemingly abstract surfaces emerge highly generalised images, which guide the viewer into a wondrous world close to nature.

artists.b: Ove Maidla on sündinud Tartus 1959. aasta külmal talveõhtul kell kolmveerand üheksa. Maidla on lüürilise hingelaadiga Tartu fotokunstnik. Talle meeldib tegutseda fotograafia ja graafika piirimail, eriti pakuvad huvi vanad vääristehnikad, mis annavad tulemuseks maalilise pildi. Peamiselt on Maidla jäänud broomõlitehnika ja fotogravüüri juurde. Uusimaks kireks on hetkel linoollõige.
artists.ben: Ove Maidla was born in Tartu on a cold winter evening in 1959 at a quarter to nine. Maidla is a Tartu photographic artist of a lyrical temperament. He likes to work on the borderline between photography and printmaking, and is especially interested in old noble techniques, which produce a painterly image as a result. Maidla has mainly remained devoted to the bromoil technique and photogravure. His newest passion at the moment is linocut.

artists.b: Liisi Örd on lõpetanud Tartu Ülikooli maaliosakonna magistriõppe. Tema loomingut iseloomustab tundlik ja mõtlik lähenemine, kus visuaalne keel kõneleb vaikusest, melanhooliast ja põhjamaise maastiku sisemisest jõust. Ördi maalistiili võib kirjeldada kui “lõhutud realismi” – lähenemist, kus kord ollakse väga lähedal täpsele kujutamisele, kord liigutakse abstraktsiooni ja tajuruumi poole. Vorm ei domineeri kunagi idee üle, vaid lähtub sellest, mida kunstnik parasjagu oluliseks peab. See paindlikkus loob teoseid, mis on visuaalselt mitmekesised ja kontseptuaalselt kihilised.
artists.ben: Liisi Örd has completed a master's degree in the painting department of the University of Tartu. Her work is characterised by a sensitive and reflective approach, in which the visual language speaks of silence, melancholy and the inner strength of the northern landscape. Örd's painting style can be described as "broken realism" – an approach where at times one is very close to precise depiction, and at times moves toward abstraction and perceptual space. Form never dominates over idea, but stems from what the artist currently considers important. This flexibility creates works that are visually diverse and conceptually layered.

artists.n: Aavo Kokk, Andres Eilart, Rain Käärst

artists.b: Kaupo Kikkas (b. 1983) is an Estonian visual artist and music portraitist. He received formal training in photography at Finland’s Visual Arts Institute, but he attributes his award-winning classical music portraits to his education in that field (clarinet, sax, and voice). He has concentrated on fine art photography for twelve years. Although based in Northern Europe, he frequently works in London, Berlin and in the US, as well annual projects in the Amazon rainforest. His personal projects include a study of graveyards, a portrait series of shale miners, and images of a lost cinema in the Egyptian desert, which received wide exposure in the international media. He has photographed a number of books and classical music album covers, and his work often appear in magazines. He was named best commercial portrait photographer at the WPPI Las Vegas 16×20 print competition in 2013, and was honoured as the best Estonian portrait photographer in 2011 (Baltic’s Photography Festival).
artists.ben: Kaupo Kikkas (b. 1983) is an Estonian visual artist and music portraitist. He received formal training in photography at Finland’s Visual Arts Institute, but he attributes his award-winning classical music portraits to his education in that field (clarinet, sax, and voice). He has concentrated on fine art photography for twelve years. Although based in Northern Europe, he frequently works in London, Berlin and in the US, as well annual projects in the Amazon rainforest. His personal projects include a study of graveyards, a portrait series of shale miners, and images of a lost cinema in the Egyptian desert, which received wide exposure in the international media. He has photographed a number of books and classical music album covers, and his work often appear in magazines. He was named best commercial portrait photographer at the WPPI Las Vegas 16×20 print competition in 2013, and was honoured as the best Estonian portrait photographer in 2011 (Baltic’s Photography Festival).

artists.b: Eveli Varik on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika osakonna. Õppinud juurde disaini ja ruumikujundust. Tunnustust leidnud interjööri – ja eseme disainerina. Kureerib ja kujundab näitusi aastast 1999. Varik töötas üheksa aastat Rakvere Teatri peakunstniku ja – galeristina. Hetkel Tartu Kunstikooli stiiliajaloo ja valikainete õpetaja.
artists.ben: Eveli Varik has graduated from the graphic art department of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Has also studied design and spatial design. Has gained recognition as an interior and object designer. Has curated and designed exhibitions since 1999. Varik worked for nine years as chief artist and gallerist at Rakvere Theatre. Currently a teacher of the history of style and elective subjects at Tartu Art School.

artists.b: Mati Uprus (sündinud 29. detsembril 1963 Põlvas) on eesti kunstnik, kes tegutseb peamiselt maalijana. Ta alustas oma kunstnikuteed 1989. aastal ning on õppinud graafikat Boris Lukatsi juhendamisel, keda peab oma vaimseks isaks.
artists.ben: Mati Uprus (born 29 December 1963 in Põlva) is an Estonian artist who works mainly as a painter. He began his artistic career in 1989 and has studied printmaking under the guidance of Boris Lukats, whom he considers his spiritual father.

artists.b: Santa on lõpetanud Tallinna Ülikooli kultuuriteaduse eriala. Ta õpib kunstiteadust ja visuaalkultuuri, magistrantuuris Eesti Kunstiakadeemias.
artists.ben: Santa has graduated from Tallinn University in Cultural Studies. She is studying art history and visual culture in the master's programme at the Estonian Academy of Arts.

artists.b: Gea Sibola Hansen (s.1962 Tapa linn) on skulptor, kes osaleb aktiivselt rahvusvahelises kunstielus.
artists.ben: Gea Sibola Hansen (b. 1962, Tapa) is a sculptor who actively participates in international art life.

artists.b: Peeter Must (snd 1967) on lõpetanud ERKI keraamika eriala, kuid oma kunstiväljundi leidnud maalijana. Oma loomingus pühendub Peeter inimesele, kui väärtuste kandjale ja edastajale, suunates vaataja vastamisi oma alateadvusega. EKL ja EML liikmena osalenud paljudel näitustel.
artists.ben: Peeter Must (b. 1967) graduated from ERKI in ceramics, but found his artistic outlet as a painter. In his work Peeter dedicates himself to the human being as a bearer and conveyor of values, directing the viewer to confront their own subconscious. As a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Painters' Union, he has participated in numerous exhibitions.

artists.b: Juba lapsepõlves ilmutas Kaljo Simson osavust joonistamises ja esines koolide näitustel nii Eestis kui Rootsis. Arreteerimise käigus 1949. aastal hävitati kunstniku sõnul 500 joonistust, akvarelli ja õlimaali. Laagris tegutses ta kunstnikuna täites tellimustöid. Sellest ajast on säilinud postkaardikavandeid, visandeid ja portreejoonistusi. Inimnäo ja looduse kujutamise vastu kujuneski kunstnikul sügavam huvi, mis jätkus hiljem läbi kogu loomeperioodi.
artists.ben: Already in childhood Kaljo Simson showed skill in drawing and exhibited at school exhibitions both in Estonia and Sweden. During his arrest in 1949, according to the artist, 500 drawings, watercolours and oil paintings were destroyed. In the camp he worked as an artist, fulfilling commissioned works. From that time, postcard designs, sketches and portrait drawings have survived. It was then that the artist developed a deeper interest in depicting the human face and nature, which continued later throughout his entire creative period.

artists.wdesc: Estonian artist, radio personality and politician (1954–2012)

artists.b: Anu Muiste (s 1984) on omandanud disaini magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ning sotsiaalteaduste magistrikraadi Tallinna Ülikoolis. Ta on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu aktiivne liige. Tema taust psühholoogias, disainis ja sotsiaalteadustes peegeldub ka loomingus, kus ta uurib inimese ja ühiskonna vahelisi suhteid ning eksistentsi eri tasandeid. Muiste teosed on introspektiivsed, visuaalselt mitmetähenduslikud ja kontseptuaalselt kihilised, kutsudes vaatajat tajuma maailma läbi orgaaniliste vormide ja sürrealismi.
artists.ben: Anu Muiste (b. 1984) holds a master's degree in design from the Estonian Academy of Arts and a master's degree in social sciences from Tallinn University. She is an active member of the Estonian Painters' Association. Her background in psychology, design and the social sciences is also reflected in her work, in which she examines the relationships between the individual and society and the various levels of existence. Muiste's works are introspective, visually ambiguous and conceptually layered, inviting the viewer to perceive the world through organic forms and surrealism.

artists.b: Johanna Mudist on Eesti maalikunstnik, kes hetkel elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Bakalaureusekraadi omandas Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis (2010 – 2014) ja magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias (2014 – 2017). Õppinud on ka Erasmuse programmi raames Soomes (2013) ja Poolas (2015 – 2016). Osalenud mitmetel grupinäitustel nii Eestis kui ka välismaal (Soome, Poola, Leedu, Tšehhi). On Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige alates 2016. aastat.
artists.ben: Johanna Mudist is an Estonian painter who currently lives and works in Tallinn. She obtained her bachelor's degree at the Tartu Art College (2010–2014) and her master's degree at the Estonian Academy of Arts (2014–2017). She has also studied under the Erasmus programme in Finland (2013) and Poland (2015–2016). She has participated in numerous group exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad (Finland, Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic). She has been a member of the Estonian Painters' Union since 2016.

artists.b: Alvar Reisner (s. 1979) on õppinud maalikunsti Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ning aastatel 2005-2013 tegutses ta Kunstiakadeemias ka õppejõuna, õpetades peamiselt värvusõpetust ja maalimist. Näitustel osaleb Reisner alates 2003. a. ning 2005. a auhinnati teda esimese noorele kunstnikule mõeldud Wiiralti-nimelise stipendiumiga. Alates 2013. a teguseb Alvar Reisner vabakutselise kunstniku ja sisekujundajana, samuti on tema sulest ilmunud mitmeid luuletusi. Suurematest sisekujundusprojektidest võib mainida populaarset lounge-restorani Manna La Roosat Tallinnas ja Kuur Restot Kärdlas, Hiiumaal.
artists.ben: Alvar Reisner (b. 1979) studied painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts and worked there as a lecturer from 2005 to 2013, teaching mainly colour theory and painting. Reisner has taken part in exhibitions since 2003, and in 2005 he was awarded the first Wiiralt Scholarship intended for young artists. Since 2013 Alvar Reisner has worked as a freelance artist and interior designer, and several poems have also been published by him. Among his larger interior design projects one may mention the popular lounge restaurant Manna La Roosa in Tallinn and Kuur Resto in Kärdla, on Hiiumaa.

artists.wdesc: actor, tap dancer residing in Estonia (born 1960)

artists.b: Ludmilla õppis Tartu 2. keskkoolis ja seejärel Tartu kunstikoolis. ERKI lõpetas ta 1965. aastal maali erialal. Seejärel oli ta Tallinna 46. keskkoolis kunstiõpetaja mõjutades tulevasi maalikunstnikke, näiteks on tema õpilane olnud Ando Keskküla. Teda huvitasid spiritualistlikud ja müstilised õpetused.
artists.ben: Ludmilla studied at Tartu 2nd Secondary School and then at Tartu Art School. She graduated from ERKI in 1965 in painting. She then worked as an art teacher at Tallinn 46th Secondary School, influencing future painters, for example Ando Keskküla was her student. She was interested in spiritualist and mystical teachings.

artists.b: Johannes Luik (1988) on sündinud Tartus. 2019 aastal omandas bakalaureuse kraadi ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemias Installatsiooni- ja skulptuuri osakonnas. 2021 aastal omandas ta Belgia LUCA School of Arts’is Magistrikraadi Kaunite kunstide erialal. Skulptori ja installatsioonikunstnikuna on Luik huvitatud (objektide) materiaalsusest ja selle abil edasi antavatest füüsilise maailma omadusi kirjeldavatest parameetritest nagu materjal, tekstuur, mass, maht ja dimensionaalsus. Olles huvitatud (abstraktsete) objektide suhtest kolmemõõtmelisse arhitektuursesse ruumi ja arhitektuursete detailide funktsionaalsest suhtest neisse objektidesse. Luik ütleb: “Sedalaadi sekkumine osutab ruumi potentsiaalile näha välja teistsugune või olla kasutatud teistmoodi. Installatsioonikunstnikuna muutub seeläbi ruum materjaliks, mida aktiveerides on võimalik luua teistmoodi kogemise ja mäletamise viise.” 2018 ja 2019 aastal pälvis ta Noore skulptori Preemia ja 2020 aastal tunnustati teda Adamson Ericu nimelise stipendiumiga.
artists.ben: Johannes Luik (1988) was born in Tartu. In 2019 he obtained a bachelor's degree at the Estonian Academy of Arts in the Department of Installation and Sculpture. In 2021 he obtained a master's degree in Fine Arts at the LUCA School of Arts in Belgium. As a sculptor and installation artist, Luik is interested in the materiality of (objects) and the parameters conveyed through it that describe the properties of the physical world, such as material, texture, mass, volume and dimensionality. He is interested in the relationship of (abstract) objects to three-dimensional architectural space and the functional relationship of architectural details to these objects. Luik says: "This kind of intervention points to the potential of a space to look different or to be used differently. As an installation artist, space thus becomes a material which, when activated, makes it possible to create different ways of experiencing and remembering." In 2018 and 2019 he received the Young Sculptor Award, and in 2020 he was recognized with the Adamson-Eric scholarship.

artists.b: Kärt Hammer (1988), on õppinud Tallinna Ülikoolis filosoofiat (BA 2011) ja kultuuriteooriat (MA 2014) ning tegelenud oma töös kunstiteose tõlgendamise võimalikkuse ning võimatuse paradoksiga. Hammer on interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kes põhiliselt keskendub oma loomingus puhtesteetilisele ning intuitiivsele abstraktsusele, vältides liigset tekstuaalsust.
artists.ben: Kärt Hammer (1988) has studied philosophy (BA 2011) and cultural theory (MA 2014) at Tallinn University and in her work has dealt with the paradox of the possibility and impossibility of interpreting a work of art. Hammer is an interdisciplinary artist who in her creative work mainly focuses on purely aesthetic and intuitive abstraction, avoiding excessive textuality.

artists.b: Katrin Piile (1987) on maali- ja tegevuskunstnik ning joonistaja, kes lõpetas Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali eriala 2010. aastal ja näitustel on esinenud juba 2006. aastast, ning tegutseb ühe Eesti kunstimaastiku eripäraseima nähtuse, kunstnikekommuuni Metropol ridades. Katrin Piile maale ja joonistusi iseloomustab maaliline ja emotsionaalne trickster-tüüpi hüperrealism, täpsus detailides, suur töömaht, teatav dramaatilisus, mida võib seostada koomiksikultuuri mõjudega.
artists.ben: Katrin Piile (1987) is a painter, performance artist and draughtsman who graduated in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2010, has been exhibiting since 2006, and works within the ranks of Metropol, one of the most distinctive phenomena of the Estonian art scene, an artists' commune. Katrin Piile's paintings and drawings are characterised by a painterly and emotional trickster-type hyperrealism, precision in detail, a large volume of work, and a certain dramatic quality that can be associated with the influences of comic culture.

artists.b: Liis Tedre (s. 1976 Tallinnas) lõpetas 2022 Eesti Kunstiakadeemias vabade kunstide osakonnas bakalaureuseõppe graafika eriala. On täiendanud end erialaselt Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas ja Dedalo Arte Contemporanea’s Itaalias. Kunstnikuna hindab kõrgelt graafikapaberi käes hoidmise tunnet ‒ selle reljeefsust, struktuuri ja tundlikkust. Ta loob nii tasapinnalist traditsioonilisemat graafikat kui ka mängulisust ja ettearvamatusi pakkuvate uute autoritehnikatega teoseid. Viimasel ajal on ta kujutanud teostel igapäevaseid objekte mänguliste lugude jutustamiseks. Ta huvitub maailma universaalsetest ja ajatutest seaduspärasustest nähes sarnasusi looduse ja inimmaailma toimimises ning käib radu mis järgnevad headusele.
artists.ben: Liis Tedre (b. 1976 in Tallinn) completed her Bachelor's studies in graphic art at the Department of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2022. She has furthered her professional training at the Tartu Art College Pallas and at Dedalo Arte Contemporanea in Italy. As an artist she highly values the feeling of holding graphic paper in one's hands – its relief, structure and sensitivity. She creates both flat, more traditional prints as well as works using new author's techniques offering playfulness and unpredictability. Recently she has depicted everyday objects in her works to tell playful stories. She is interested in the universal and timeless patterns of the world, seeing similarities in how nature and the human world function, and follows paths that lead toward goodness.

artists.b: Alexandre Valetto (1996) on Vene-Itaalia kunstnik. Õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias  skulptuuri ja installatsiooni osakonnas. Aastal 2018 õppis Itaalias Università Iuav di Venezias arhitektuuri ja linnaplaneerimist. Osalenud neljal rühmanäitusel ja töötanud lavakunstnikuna I Land Sound festivalil. Töötab VFX-kunstniku ja ehtekunstnikuna.
artists.ben: Alexandre Valetto (1996) is a Russian-Italian artist. He studied in the sculpture and installation department at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In 2018 he studied architecture and urban planning at the Università Iuav di Venezia in Italy. He has participated in four group exhibitions and worked as a stage designer at the I Land Sound festival. He works as a VFX artist and jewellery artist.

artists.b: Andrei Maksimjuk on Eesti kunstnik. Ta on sündinud Tallinnas ja elanud aastaid Milanos. Ta omandas bakalaureuse- ja magistrikraadi maalikunstis ja joonistamises Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja Brera Kunstiakadeemias Milanos – institutsioonides, millel on olnud kunstniku karjääris võtmeroll. Maksimjuk on töötanud erinevates valdkondades: restaureerimises, õpetamises, näituste planeerimises, kujundamises ja ennekõike maalimises. Ta on katsetanud ka erinevaid tehnikaid: joonistamist, kollaaži ja segatehnikat.
artists.ben: Andrei Maksimjuk is an Estonian artist. He was born in Tallinn and has lived for years in Milan. He obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees in painting and drawing at the Estonian Academy of Arts and the Brera Academy of Fine Arts in Milan – institutions that have played a key role in the artist's career. Maksimjuk has worked in various fields: restoration, teaching, exhibition planning, design and, above all, painting. He has also experimented with various techniques: drawing, collage and mixed media.

artists.b: Annika Haas (1974, Pärnu) huvitub fotokunstnikuna marginaalsetest ühiskonnarühmadest või subkultuuridest. Ta uurib nende toimemehhanisme, sisereegleid ja suhet keskkonnaga.
artists.ben: Annika Haas (1974, Pärnu) as a photographic artist is interested in marginal social groups or subcultures. She examines their mechanisms of operation, internal rules and relationship with their environment.

artists.b: Brenda Purtsak (sündinud 1994) on Eestist pärit kunstnik. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia Kaasaegse Kunsti eriala (2022) ning Maali eriala (2020). Alates 2023 töötab ta õppejõuna Eesti Kunstiakadeemias.
artists.ben: Brenda Purtsak (born 1994) is an artist from Estonia. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in Contemporary Art (2022) and Painting (2020). Since 2023 she has worked as a lecturer at the Estonian Academy of Arts.

artists.n: The work is on display at the exhibition

artists.b: Britta Benno (1984) on Tallinnas elav joonistus- ja graafikakunstnik. Teda huvitavad erinevad hübriidtehnikad ja materjalid ning nende kõrvutamisel ja laiendamisel avanevad uued perspektiivid. Benno viimaste aastate näitused toimivad seriaalselt, kujutades inimesejärgseid maastikke. Kontseptuaalsed võtmesõnad on mälu, maastik ja tähenduste kaduvus (varemed,.
artists.ben: Britta Benno (1984) is a drawing and print artist living in Tallinn. She is interested in various hybrid techniques and materials and the new perspectives that open up when juxtaposing and extending them. Benno's exhibitions of recent years function serially, depicting post-human landscapes. The conceptual keywords are memory, landscape and the transience of meanings (ruins,.

artists.b: Edgar Tedresaar (s. 1984 Tartus) on lõpetanud Tartu Ülikooli maalikunsti eriala magistrikraadiga (2014) ning varem õppinud maali ka Tartu Kõrgem Kunstikoolis. Tedresaarele pakuvad erilist huvi tahvelmaalid ja seinamaalingud. Tema loomingus on olulise kohal materjalide upcycling ehk väärtustav taaskasutamine. Tema suuremõõtmelised abstraktsed maalid on valmistatud naturaalsete pigmentidega toonitud lõuendijääkidest.
artists.ben: Edgar Tedresaar (b. 1984 in Tartu) graduated from the University of Tartu with a master's degree in painting (2014), and had earlier studied painting at the Tartu Art College. Tedresaar has a particular interest in panel paintings and wall paintings. In his work, the upcycling, i.e. the valorising reuse, of materials plays an important role. His large-format abstract paintings are made from remnants of canvas tinted with natural pigments.

artists.b: Eneli Valge (1970), kunstnik ja disainer, on kunstialase hariduse omandanud Tartu Kunstikoolis kunstnik-kujundajana, Eesti Kunstiakadeemia disainiteaduskonnas kunstide magistri kraadi ning täiendanud end Hollandis – Utrecht School of the Arts, visuaalsete kunstide ja disaini erialal.
artists.ben: Eneli Valge (1970), artist and designer, has acquired art education at the Tartu Art College as an artist-designer, a master's degree in arts at the Faculty of Design of the Estonian Academy of Arts, and has continued her education in the Netherlands - Utrecht School of the Arts, in the field of visual arts and design.

artists.b: Eve Ermann (s. 1972) on lõpetanud EKA klaasikunsti osakonna (1999) BA, sellele järgnevalt EKA õpetajate koolituse (2001). Töötanud seinamaalingute konservaator restauraatorina. Läbinud EKA Avatud Akadeemia täiendkoolituse Arhitektuuri konserveerimine ja restaureerimine (2014). 2016 aastast Eesti Akvarellistide Ühingu liige. Osalenud ühisnäitustel, üleeuroopalistel ECWS (Euroopa Akvarellistide Ühingute Konföderatsiooni) näitustel Avignonis, Salamancas, Krakowis, Ulmis, Bilbaos. Samuti rahvusvahelistel akvarellinäitustel Itaalias, Fabrianos ja Soomes, Helsingis. Tal on olnud viis isiknäitust. Osalenud protsendikunsti konkurssidel, neist 2021 Washingtoni Eesti Suursaatkonna kunstikonkursil üks seitsmest võidutööst, 2023 Eestimaa rüütelkonna hoone kunstikonkursil III koht. Maalide olemust ja esteetikat on mõjutanud töö ajaloolistel objektidel.
artists.ben: Eve Ermann (b. 1972) graduated from the EKA Department of Glass Art (1999) with a BA, followed by the EKA teacher training programme (2001). She has worked as a wall painting conservator-restorer. She completed the EKA Open Academy continuing education programme in Architectural Conservation and Restoration (2014). From 2016 she has been a member of the Estonian Watercolour Society. She has taken part in joint exhibitions, the pan-European ECWS (European Confederation of Watercolour Societies) exhibitions in Avignon, Salamanca, Kraków, Ulm, Bilbao. Also international watercolour exhibitions in Italy, in Fabriano, and in Finland, in Helsinki. She has had five solo exhibitions. She has taken part in percent-for-art competitions, among them in 2021 one of seven winning works at the art competition of the Estonian Embassy in Washington, and in 2023 third place at the art competition for the building of the Estonian Knighthood. The nature and aesthetics of her paintings have been influenced by her work on historical sites.

artists.b: Heleliis Hõim on interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kes töötab paralleelselt eri meediumites. Ta on teinud mitmeid koostööprojekte ja isikunäitusi Eestis, täiendanud end Eesti Kunstiakadeemia MA kaasaegse kunsti õpingute kõrval Läti Kunstiakadeemias ning Belle di Arti de Milano ülikoolis Itaalias. Samuti on ta osalenud rahvusvahelistel grupinäitustel ja kunsti residentuurides nagu “NordArt'23”, “Biennale Larnaca”, Panama “La Wayaka” ja Ukraina “Policlinica '20”.
artists.ben: Heleliis Hõim is an interdisciplinary artist who works in parallel in different media. She has done several collaborative projects and solo exhibitions in Estonia, and has furthered her studies, alongside her MA studies in contemporary art at the Estonian Academy of Arts, at the Art Academy of Latvia and at the Accademia di Belle Arti di Milano in Italy. She has also participated in international group exhibitions and art residencies such as "NordArt'23", "Biennale Larnaca", "La Wayaka" in Panama and "Policlinica '20" in Ukraine.

artists.b: Jane Muts (snd 1984) lõpetas Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide maalikunsti erialal. Jane Muts kujutab peamiselt enda töödes ruumi ruumis. Muts käsitleb värvi kui ehitusmaterjali ja loob kompositsiooni kaudu ruumiillusiooni. Lõuendile järk-järgult kantud paksud pigmendikihid loovad rikkaliku tekstuuriga pindu, mille tulemusena interjööristseenid seavad kahtluse alla ruumitaju. Tema tehnika aitab ühendada detailide ja tühjuse alasid. Ta on osalenud Eesti Kunstnike Liidu 22. aastanäitus „Kevadnäitus 2022“ (2022), TASE’22 lõputööde näitusel (2022), EKA maalitudengite grupinäitusel Eesti Vabariigi Õiguskantsleri kantselei ruumides (2021), Osta Noort Kunsti näitusel Telliskivi Loomelinnaku rohelises saalis (2021) ja EKA Maalikursuse A,B,C…Z grupinäitusel restoran Kärbes seintel (2019).
artists.ben: Jane Muts (b. 1984) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting within the Fine Arts department. Jane Muts depicts primarily space within space in her works. Muts treats colour as a building material and creates an illusion of space through composition. Thick layers of pigment gradually applied to the canvas create richly textured surfaces, as a result of which the interior scenes call spatial perception into question. Her technique helps to connect areas of detail and emptiness. She has taken part in the Estonian Artists' Association's 22nd annual exhibition "Kevadnäitus 2022" (2022), the TASE'22 graduation exhibition (2022), a group exhibition of EKA painting students at the premises of the Chancellor of Justice of the Republic of Estonia (2021), the Buy Young Art exhibition in the green hall of the Telliskivi Creative City (2021), and the EKA Painting Course A,B,C…Z group exhibition on the walls of the restaurant Kärbes (2019).

artists.b: Kaidi Kaasik on graafiline disainer, kes tegeleb abstraktse maaliga. Ta on õppinud Non Gratas tegevuskunsti, EKA-s graafikat ja BFM-is dokumentaalfilmi. Tema kalligraafilised abstraktsed segatehnikas maalid on värviküllased ning kontrastsed, tuues maailma organiseeritud kaost. Tema maaliseeria NO MIND tähistab meeleseisundit, milles ta loob. See on loominguline kulgemine, millest puudub ego ning igapäevaelu.
artists.ben: Kaidi Kaasik is a graphic designer who works with abstract painting. She has studied performance art at Non Grata, graphic art at EKA and documentary film at BFM. Her calligraphic abstract mixed-media paintings are colourful and contrasting, bringing organised chaos into the world. Her painting series NO MIND denotes the state of mind in which she creates. It is a creative flow free of ego and everyday life.

artists.b: Kalli Kalde (s. 1967) on maalikunstnik ja graafik, kes on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli kunstilise kujundamise eriala (1986), seejärel omandanud Tallinna Pedagoogilise Instituudi kunstiõpetuse ja tööõpetuse õpetaja kutse (1991) ning töötab alates 1991. a. Tartu Kunstikoolis joonistamise ja graafika õpetajana (aastatel 2001- 2010 ka graafika eriala lektorina). Näitustel on Kalli Kalde osalenud alates 1988. a. Ta on Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse ja Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Kalli Kalde (b. 1967) is a painter and printmaker who graduated from the Tartu Art School in artistic design (1986), then obtained the qualification of a teacher of art education and handicraft from the Tallinn Pedagogical Institute (1991), and has worked since 1991 at the Tartu Art School as a teacher of drawing and print (in the years 2001–2010 also as a lecturer in the print speciality). Kalli Kalde has participated in exhibitions since 1988. She is a member of the Estonian Print Artists' Association and the Tartu Artists' Association.

artists.b: Karin Strohm on Eesti kunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Münchenis. Tal on maalikunsti magistrikraad Eesti Kunstiakadeemiast ning ta on töötanud kunstnik‑maalijana Eesti Rahvusooperis. Strohmi looming uurib iha kui bioloogilise ja esteetilise jõu avaldumisvorme. Korduvad motiivid — naaritsad, putukad ja teemandid — kehastavad ühtaegu nii külgetõmmet kui ohtu. Tema unenäolistes, sageli liigagi kaunites maastikes põimuvad ilu, instinkt ja õrn ärevusevarjund.
artists.ben: Karin Strohm is an Estonian artist who lives and works in Munich. She holds a master's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts and has worked as an artist-painter at the Estonian National Opera. Strohm's work explores desire as a manifestation of biological and aesthetic force. Recurring motifs — minks, insects and diamonds — embody both attraction and danger at once. In her dreamlike, often too-beautiful landscapes, beauty, instinct and a delicate shade of anxiety intertwine.

artists.b: Kati Müüripeal (1994) on Eestis tegutsev maalikunstnik, kes on alates 2019. aastast võtnud osa grupinäitustest. Teismelisena omandas akadeemilist joonistamist animalistilt Sándor Martin Sterilt. Tänaseks on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias (BA) vabad kunstid ja (MA) kaasaegne kunsti eriala. Vahetusõpingudel käis ennast täiendamas Hamburgi Kaunite Kunstide Ülikoolis.
artists.ben: Kati Müüripeal (1994) is a painter active in Estonia who has taken part in group exhibitions since 2019. As a teenager she acquired academic drawing skills from the animal painter Sándor Martin Sterl. She has now graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a BA in Fine Arts and an MA in Contemporary Art. During an exchange programme she furthered her studies at the University of Fine Arts Hamburg.

artists.b: Kristen Rästas on 1992. aastal sündinud eesti kunstnik. Praegu õpib ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemia magistrantuuris maalikunsti erialal. Kristen on osalenud näitustel alates 2012. aastast. Tema eelistatud meedium on maal, kuigi tegeleb ka videokunstiga. Kunstniku stiili on varem kommenteeritud kui “ekspressiivne pop”. Kristen elab ja töötab Tallinnas.
artists.ben: Kristen Rästas is an Estonian artist born in 1992. She is currently studying painting in the master's programme at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Kristen has taken part in exhibitions since 2012. Her preferred medium is painting, though she also works with video art. The artist's style has previously been described as "expressive pop". Kristen lives and works in Tallinn.

artists.b: Liis Karu (1983) on fotokunstnik ja raamatukujundaja, kes kirjeldab oma loomin-.
artists.ben: Liis Karu (1983) is a photo artist and book designer who describes her crea-.

artists.b: Liisa Jugapuu (s.1990) omandas bakalaureusekraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias maalikunsti erialal, hetkel on käsil õpinguid magistratuuris samal erialal. Ta on osa võtnud Vano Allsalu kureeritud näituste korraldamisest, organiseerinud ERKI Moeshow-d ning praktikandina esindanud aastal 2013 toimunud Veneetsia Biennaalil Dénes Kalev Farkase näitust „Evident in advance“.
artists.ben: Liisa Jugapuu (b. 1990) obtained a bachelor's degree in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and is currently pursuing master's studies in the same field. She has taken part in organising exhibitions curated by Vano Allsalu, organised the ERKI Moeshow, and as an intern represented Dénes Kalev Farkas's exhibition "Evident in advance" at the Venice Biennale in 2013.

artists.b: Luisa Greta Vilo on fotokunstnik, kes on lõpetanud Kõrgema Kunstikooli Pallas. Vilo alustas näitusetegevusega aastal 2020, kui osales Eesti kunstike ühisnäitusel “Paus”. Sellest ajast saadik on ta osalenud mitmel grupinäitusel ja loonud kaks isikunäitust “Loodu sees” Aparaaditehases Avatud kultuuriplatvormi raames (aastal 2022) ja “Haavatavuse fragmendid” Tartus Tampere Majas (2023). Kõrgem Kunstikool Pallas on tunnustanud Vilo valdkonnastipendiumiga kunstide suunal.
artists.ben: Luisa Greta Vilo is a photographic artist who graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. Vilo began exhibiting in 2020, when she participated in the joint exhibition of Estonian artists "Paus". Since then she has participated in several group exhibitions and created two solo exhibitions, "Loodu sees" [Inside the Created] at Aparaaditehas as part of the Open Culture Platform (in 2022) and "Haavatavuse fragmendid" [Fragments of Vulnerability] at Tampere House in Tartu (2023). Pallas has recognised Vilo with a field-specific scholarship in the arts direction.

artists.b: Marta Vaarik on interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kes on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maalikunsti eriala ja kaasaegse kunsti õppekava ning täiendanud end Berliini Kunstiülikoolis. Ta kasutab loomingus maali, fotot,.
artists.ben: Marta Vaarik is an interdisciplinary artist who has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting and the contemporary art curriculum, and further trained at the Berlin University of the Arts. In her work she uses painting, photography,.

artists.b: Martti Ruus (snd 1968) on õppinud Tallinna Kunstiülikoolis arhitektuuri ja sisearhitektuuri. Maalikunstiga alustas 2011. aastal Konrad Mägi ateljees Tartus. Ruus vaatleb ja stiliseerib loodust läbi arhitektuurse ja koloristliku prisma. Minimalistlikud motiivid, teineteisest eristuvad värvipinnad, varjatud seoste leidmine on loomingu märksõnadeks. Näitustel, peamiselt Tartus, osaleb alates 2013 a.
artists.ben: Martti Ruus (b. 1968) studied architecture and interior architecture at the Estonian Academy of Arts in Tallinn. He began painting in 2011 in Konrad Mägi's studio in Tartu. Ruus observes and stylises nature through an architectural and coloristic prism. Minimalist motifs, colour surfaces distinguishing themselves from one another, and the search for hidden connections are keywords of his work. He has participated in exhibitions, mainly in Tartu, since 2013.

artists.b: Piret Rohusaar (1961) keskendub oma maalipraktikas muusikale, eeskätt jazzile, mille kaudu ta uurib rütmi, kohalolu, muusika ja kujutatava vahelist nähtamatut pin- gevälja. Kunstniku portreedes on ühendatud äratuntav kujutis ja muusikaline, voolavalt maaliline käsitlus, kus sulanduvad figuur ja atmosfäär. Rohusaar on lõpeta- nud ERKI maali eriala (1988) ning osalenud kunstielus nii arvukate isiku- kui ka rühmanäitustega. Ta on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Piret Rohusaar (1961) focuses in her painting practice on music, especially jazz, through which she explores rhythm, presence, and the invisible field of tension between music and the depicted subject. In Rohusaar's portraits, a recognisable image is combined with a musical, fluidly painterly treatment, in which figure and atmosphere merge. Rohusaar graduated from ERKI in painting (1988) and has participated in art life with numerous solo and group exhibitions. She is a member of the Estonian Painters' Association and the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Rain Saarik (s. 1998) on Pärnust pärit maalikunstnik. Aastal 2023 lõpetas kunstnik Eesti Kunstiakadeemias skulptuuri ja installatsiooni eriala.
artists.ben: Rain Saarik (b. 1998) is a painter from Pärnu. In 2023 the artist graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in sculpture and installation.

artists.b: Saskia Järve omandas Eesti Kunstiakadeemias magistrikraadi ja tegutseb peamiselt figuratiivse maalikunsti vallas. Järve käsitleb oma loomingus igapäevaelu sündmusi ja keskendub inimloomuse keerulisele psühholoogiale. Ta kombineerib isikliku elu kaadreid popkultuuri ja folkloristika elementidega.
artists.ben: Saskia Järve earned a master's degree from the Estonian Academy of Arts and works mainly in the field of figurative painting. In her work Järve deals with everyday events and focuses on the complex psychology of human nature. She combines frames from personal life with elements of pop culture and folklore.

artists.n: The work is part of the group exhibition

artists.b: Tauno Ostra on hetkel esimese aasta vabade kunstide magistritudeng graafika suunal. Tähtsamateks näitusteks peab ta isikunäitust “Identiteet”, mis leidis aset 2015. aastal Haapsalu Linnagaleriis ja 2016. Võru Linnagaleriis ning “Sümmeetria” 2017. aasta veebruar-märts Viljandi Linnagaleriis. Grupinäitustest on suuremad Tallinna V Rahvusvaheline Joonistustriennaal ja Kevadnäitus (2016) Tallinna Kunstihoones ning Baltic Drawing Biennial Soomes, Imatras. Lisaks veel sel aastal toimuv Mirror Face To Face Rahvusraamatukogus ning Vicenzas, Itaalias.
artists.ben: Tauno Ostra is currently a first-year Master's student in Fine Arts, specialising in graphic art. He considers his most important exhibitions to be the solo exhibition "Identiteet", which took place in 2015 at the Haapsalu City Gallery and in 2016 at the Võru City Gallery, and "Sümmeetria" in February–March 2017 at the Viljandi City Gallery. Among his major group exhibitions are the 5th Tallinn International Drawing Triennial and the Spring Exhibition (2016) at the Tallinn Art Hall, and the Baltic Drawing Biennial in Imatra, Finland. In addition, this year's Mirror Face To Face at the National Library and in Vicenza, Italy.

artists.b: Timo Kähara (s. 1981) on Eesti kunstnik. Kuigi joonistada ja maalida meeldis talle juba varases eas, siis viis elutee ta mõneks ajaks kunstist eemale. Peale gümnaasiumi lõpetamist (aastal 2000) soovis ta sisse astuda kunstikooli, kuid jäi napilt välja. Ta õppis hoopis Eesti Mereakadeemias ja töötas peale kooli lõpetamist (aastal 2006) kaks aastat maailmameredel seilavatel kaubalaevadel 3. tüürimehena. Lõpuks ta mõistis, et see ei ole siiski tema jaoks, silm ei säranud, kunst tõmbas endiselt. Ta lõpetas meremehe karjääri ja proovis uuesti kunstikooli sisse saada, seekord õnnestus. 2012. a lõpetas ta Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli (nüüd Kõrgem Kunstikool Pallas) meedia- ja reklaamidisaini eriala. Ta on loometööga seotud sellest ajast alates. Osalenud mitmel isiku – ja grupinäitusel. Aastast 2019 on ta Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Timo Kähara (b. 1981) is an Estonian artist. Although he liked to draw and paint already at an early age, his life path took him away from art for a while. After finishing upper secondary school (in 2000) he wanted to enrol in an art school, but narrowly failed to get in. Instead he studied at the Estonian Maritime Academy and, after graduating (in 2006), worked for two years as a 3rd mate on cargo ships sailing the world's seas. Eventually he realised that this was not for him after all, his eyes did not light up, art still drew him. He ended his career as a seaman and tried again to get into art school, and this time he succeeded. In 2012 he graduated from the Tartu Art College (now the Pallas University of Applied Sciences) with a degree in media and advertising design. He has been engaged in creative work since then. He has participated in several solo and group exhibitions. Since 2019 he has been a member of the Tartu Artists' Union.

artists.b: Tõnu Noorits, PhD (s.1952 Tartus) lõpetas Tartu Ülikooli 1975.a. bioloogina. Doktorikraadi kaitses 1984.a. Fotokunstiga tegeleb aastast 1982. 1992.a. rajas koos Silver Vahtrega disaini- ja kunstiseltsi KYNA, kus tegeleb foto-lavastuste, kujundamise ja kirjastamisega. Ta on mitmekülgne looja ning tema tööd – portreed, aktid, fotolavastused, abstraktsed maastikud – sisaldavad tihti ootamatuid nägemusi. Fotodele on iseloomulik kõrge pildikultuuur ja perfektne teostus. Möödunud sajandi lõpukümnendite Euroopa fotosalongides oli ta enim eksponeeritud Eesti autor. Tal on olnud 35 isiknäitust erinevates riikides – Austrias, Belgias, Itaalias, Lätis, Prantsusmaal, Rootsis, Saksamaal, samuti 12 grupinäitust.
artists.ben: Tõnu Noorits, PhD (b. 1952 in Tartu) graduated from the University of Tartu in 1975 as a biologist. He defended his doctoral degree in 1984. He has worked in photographic art since 1982. In 1992, together with Silver Vahter, he founded the design and art society KYNA, where he engages in photo-staging, design and publishing. He is a versatile creator, and his works – portraits, nudes, staged photographs, abstract landscapes – often contain unexpected visions. His photographs are characterised by a high pictorial culture and perfect execution. In the final decades of the last century he was the most exhibited Estonian author in European photo salons. He has had 35 solo exhibitions in various countries – Austria, Belgium, Italy, Latvia, France, Sweden, Germany, as well as 12 group exhibitions.

artists.wdesc: Estonian designer, artist, and art historian (born 1982)

artists.b: Fred Kotkas (1986) on Eesti Kunstiakadeemia lõpetanud maalikunstnik ja illustraator, kelle introspektiivne looming keskendub inimese sisemaailmale ja seda kujundavatele teguritele. Tema väljenduslaad on kirev ja kujundlik ning seda saadab eneseirooniline hoiak, mis lisab tema töödele teatava mängulisuse.
artists.ben: Fred Kotkas (1986) is a painter and illustrator who graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, whose introspective work focuses on the inner world of the human being and the factors shaping it. His mode of expression is vivid and figurative, accompanied by a self-ironic attitude, which adds a certain playfulness to his works.

artists.b: Cloe Jancis (s. 25.03.1992) on Tallinnas elav, peamiselt foto, video ja installatsiooni meediumites töötav, konseptuaalne kunstnik. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia fotograafia eriala (BA, 2018) ning hetkel õpib Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonnas Kaasaegse kunsti magistriprogrammis.
artists.ben: Cloe Jancis (b. 25.03.1992) is a conceptual artist living in Tallinn, working mainly in the media of photography, video and installation. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in photography (BA, 2018) and is currently studying in the Contemporary Art master's programme at the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts.

artists.b: Eetu Sihvonen (born 1994) will receive his BFA in sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts, Helsinki by the end of 2019. Previously Sihvonen has studied in Aalto University, department of graphic design. His works have previously been shown in several group exhibitions in Finland.
artists.ben: Eetu Sihvonen (born 1994) will receive his BFA in sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts, Helsinki by the end of 2019. Previously Sihvonen has studied in Aalto University, department of graphic design. His works have previously been shown in several group exhibitions in Finland.

artists.b: Elina Vitola (s. 1986) on noor Läti kunstnik, kes tutvustab end järgmiselt: “Maalimist olen lustlikult õppinud peaaegu kogu oma elu ning 2018. a. lõpetan oma magistriõpinguid Läti Kunstiakadeemias. Näitused, millest mul on olnud suurim rõõm osa võtta, on näiteks “Uue Ida lapsed” Tallinna Kunstihoones ja “Vaatamis- ja lugemistuba” Kogo galeriis Tartus. Hiljuti olen teinud mitmeid abstraktseid maale, kuid lähimas tulevikus plaanin maalida pastat.”.
artists.ben: Elina Vitola (b. 1986) is a young Latvian artist who introduces herself as follows: "I have been joyfully learning to paint for almost my entire life, and in 2018 I will complete my master's studies at the Art Academy of Latvia. The exhibitions I have had the greatest pleasure of taking part in are, for example, "Children of the New East" at the Tallinn Art Hall and "Viewing and Reading Room" at Kogo Gallery in Tartu. Recently I have made several abstract paintings, but in the near future I am planning to paint pasta."

artists.b: Tiina Sarapu on klaasikunstnik, kelle loomingus klaas on peamiselt installatsiooni- ja skulptuurimaterjal, ideetasandil aga vaheaste nähtava ja nähtamatu maailma vahel. Sageli on tema tööde lähtematerjaliks lehtklaas, millest pealtnäha lihtsa painutuse abil on saanud ruumiline vorm. Servad ja pinnad on neis ühtaegu iseseisvad, samas üksteisest sõltuvad elemendid ja moodustavad tänu klaasi läbipaistvusele keeruka mitmekihilisuse. Ruumilised klaasikihid on Sarapu teostes sageli aja kihtide tähenduses. Tiina Sarapu on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia klaasikunsti osakonnas, mille lõpetas 1996. aastal magistrikraadiga. Sellest ajast on ta olnud samas osakonnas õppejõuks, alates 2003. aastast dotsent. Ta on osalenud paljudel näitustel, sümpoosionidel ja workshopides nii kodu- kui välismaal. Tema teoseid on muuseumide ja erakogujate kollektsioonides. Sarapule on omistatud aunimetus “Tunnustatud klaasikunstnik 2004–2005” ja Kristjan Raua preemia 2007. Ta on pälvinud tunnustust mitmetel rahvusvahelistel klaasikunsti konkurssidel. (M. Bukovec)
artists.ben: Tiina Sarapu is a glass artist in whose work glass is primarily an installation and sculptural material, but on the level of ideas an intermediate stage between the visible and invisible world. Sheet glass is often the starting material for her works, from which, by means of a seemingly simple bending, a three-dimensional form has been created. The edges and surfaces in these are at once independent yet interdependent elements, and thanks to the transparency of the glass they form a complex multi-layeredness. The spatial layers of glass in Sarapu's works often carry the meaning of layers of time. Tiina Sarapu studied in the Department of Glass Art at the Estonian Academy of Arts, from which she graduated with a master's degree in 1996. Since that time she has taught in the same department, and has been a docent there since 2003. She has taken part in numerous exhibitions, symposia and workshops both at home and abroad. Her works are held in the collections of museums and private collectors. Sarapu has been awarded the honorary title "Tunnustatud klaasikunstnik 2004–2005" ("Recognised Glass Artist 2004–2005") and the Kristjan Raud Prize in 2007. She has received recognition at several international glass art competitions. (M. Bukovec)

artists.b: Madlen Hirtentreu (1993) on multidistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kelle looming hõlmab skulptuuri ja kohaspetsiifilisi installatsioone. Tal on omandanud bakalaureusekraadi Milano Disainiinstituudis (Instituto Europeo di Design’is) visuaalse kommunikatsiooni erialal ning magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias skulptuuris ja installatsioonikunstis. Hirtentreu loomingu jõukeskmeks on mälestused, ajalugu ja materiaalsuse uurimine, mille abil ta hajutab piire arheoloogia, spekulatiivse fiktsiooni ja tööstusesteetika vahel. Need skulptuurid ja installatsioonid võivad olla nii ajaloolised väljakaevamised kui ka oletuslikud tulevikunägemused. Tema tööd viitavad sageli puudumisele või kadunud kohalolule. Teostes kohtab tihti kummituslikke, hübriidseid ja fragmentaarseid kehi või mahajäetud struktuure, mis toovad esile tunde, et midagi on kunagi olemas olnud, kuid ei eksisteeri enam täielikult. Hirtentreu pakub alternatiivset vaadet ajaloole, nähes seda mitte kui fikseeritud minevikku, vaid kui pidevas tõlgendamises olevat protsessi. Ta käsitleb objekte ja materjale kui tundmatu tuleviku fossiile.
artists.ben: Madlen Hirtentreu (1993) is a multidisciplinary artist whose work encompasses sculpture and site-specific installations. She has earned a bachelor's degree in visual communication from the Istituto Europeo di Design in Milan and a master's degree in sculpture and installation art from the Estonian Academy of Arts. The driving force of Hirtentreu's work is memory, history and the exploration of materiality, through which she blurs the boundaries between archaeology, speculative fiction and industrial aesthetics. These sculptures and installations can be both historical excavations and speculative visions of the future. Her works often refer to absence or a lost presence. In her works one frequently encounters ghostly, hybrid and fragmentary bodies or abandoned structures, which evoke the feeling that something once existed but no longer exists fully. Hirtentreu offers an alternative view of history, seeing it not as a fixed past but as a process in constant interpretation. She treats objects and materials as fossils of an unknown future.

artists.b: Agate Tūna is a multidisciplinary artist from Riga, Latvia, specialising in the field of analogue and experimental photography. Her techniques include film soups, chemigrams, and photograms along with experiments in sound art. With her camera, Tūna plays the role as an investigator between reality and fiction, uncovering intriguing strangeness and compelling evidence, stimulating discussions about the blurred boundary between these two domains. Tūna delves deep into the influential role of imagery in shaping our beliefs by examining the complex, evolving interplay between technology and spirituality. Tūna’s educational background includes a BA degree in Arts from the Painting department at the Art Academy of Latvia, earned in 2020. In 2022, a two-year programme in Developing Photographic Language at ISSP School and more recently, in 2023, she graduated from an interdisciplinary MA programme POST at the Art Academy of Latvia. Tūna has participated in numerous exhibitions and art projects both in Latvia and internationally. Her solo-show, “The Order of Invisible Things,” took place at gallery DOM in Riga in 2022. She has also been part of group exhibitions such as ”

artists.b: Maria Kapajeva (1976) kunsti feministlik lähtepunkt toob sageli esile mikroaja-.
artists.ben: Maria Kapajeva's (1976) feminist starting point in art often brings to the fore micro-histo-.

artists.b: Ann Pajuväli (1990) töötab peamiselt joonistuse ja installatsiooniga, jäädvustades vaikseid, oma tavapärasuses märkamatuks jäävaid hetki. Liikudes tuttava ja abstraktse vahel, taandab ta objekte poeetilisteks fragmentideks, mängides äratuntavuse piiril. Pajuvälja loomingut juhib intuitsioon, mitte kindel narratiiv, luues unenäolise kvaliteediga teoseid. Ta loob maailma, kus aeg näib venivat — meditatiivse ruumi, mis on ühtaegu isiklik ja universaalne.
artists.ben: Ann Pajuväli (1990) works mainly with drawing and installation, capturing quiet moments that in their ordinariness remain unnoticed. Moving between the familiar and the abstract, she reduces objects to poetic fragments, playing at the edge of recognisability. Pajuväli's work is guided by intuition rather than a fixed narrative, creating works with a dreamlike quality. She creates a world where time seems to stretch — a meditative space that is at once personal and universal.

artists.b: Holger Loodus on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia muinsuskaitse ja restaureerimise eriala, õppinud maali erialal vabade kunstide osakonnas ning täiendanud ennast Karlsruhe Kunsti- ja Disainiülikooli meediakunsti osakonnas. Tema loomingu läbivaks meetodiks on igapäevaste kogemuste müstifitseerimine.
artists.ben: Holger Loodus has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in the specialty of heritage conservation and restoration, studied painting in the department of free arts, and furthered his studies at the Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design in the media art department. The recurring method of his work is the mystification of everyday experiences.

artists.b: Sandra Sirp (s 1988) väljendab end minimalistliku geomeetrilise visuaalse keelega, läbi tühjuse ja ruumi. Alates 2015. aastast on Sirp oma loomingus keskendunud nii sisult kui ka teostuselt aeglusele, protsessile ja tasakaalule, mis tõmbab siduva joone maaliseeriate vahele ning moodustab ühtse tervikliku lähenemise. Sirp on lõpetanud Tallinna Ülikooli kunstiõpetuse bakalaureuseõppe (2012), Eesti Kunstiakadeemia meediagraafika bakalaureuseõppe (2017), täiendanud end maalikunstis Porto Ülikooli vabade kunstide osakonnas (2015/2016) ning õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia ja Tallinna Ülikooli ühises kunstiõpetaja magistriõppes (2019–2022). Aastast 2023 on Sirp Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige. Sirbi teoseid võib leida erakogudest ja Espoo kaasaegse kunsti muuseumi EMMA kogust.
artists.ben: Sandra Sirp (b 1988) expresses herself through a minimalist geometric visual language, through emptiness and space. Since 2015, Sirp has focused in her work, both in content and execution, on slowness, process and balance, which draws a connecting line between her painting series and forms a unified, coherent approach. Sirp graduated from Tallinn University with a bachelor's degree in art education (2012), from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a bachelor's degree in media graphics (2017), furthered her studies in painting at the Department of Fine Arts of the University of Porto (2015/2016), and studied in the joint master's programme in art teaching of the Estonian Academy of Arts and Tallinn University (2019–2022). Since 2023 Sirp has been a member of the Estonian Painters' Association. Sirp's works can be found in private collections and in the collection of EMMA, the Espoo Museum of Modern Art.

artists.b: Tiiu Leis (s. 1967) on kunstiõpetaja ja kunstnik, kriitik, kes elab ja töötab Pärnus Eestis ja Poris Soomes. Lõpetanud Tallinna Ülikooli kunstiõpetuse eriala JT (1994). 2016-2019 animatsiooni töötubade juhendaja Pärnu Muuseumis, 2017-2019 osales Erasmus+ ProArt kunstiprojektis Poolas, Lätis, Slovakkias, Itaalias ja veebidisaini kursusel Luxemburgis. Korraldas Erasmus+ kunstiprojekti 2026 Treimanis. 2017-2018 animatsioonilaagri korraldaja/juhendaja Pärnus ja maalilaagrites Kihnus 2013-2020, Muhus 2023 ning Treimanis 2024-2026. Tal on alates 2020 oma kunstistuudio, töötab ka erivajadustega laste ja täiskasvanutega. 1995-1997 oli Pärnu Chaplini kunstikeskuses raamatukogu juhataja ja korraldas näitusi, luule-, kirjanduse ja filmiõhtuid. Leis oli I videoformaadis Eesti filmifestivali Do-Re-Vi (dokumentaal-, reklaam- ja videofilm) peakorraldaja Mai kultuurikeskuses Pärnus. Tiiu Leis on 2016. aasta õpetaja Pärnus ja 2016. aasta noorsootöötaja nominent vabariigis, saanud 2017 kultuuripreemia “Rao Heidmetsa animamaailm” näituse korraldamise eest Pärnu Muuseumis. Osalenud rahvusvahelisel aktinäitusel „Mees ja naine“, taaskasutusnäitustel Uue Kunsti Muuseumis Pärnus ja ülevaatenäitustel Pärnu.
artists.ben: Tiiu Leis (b. 1967) is an art teacher and artist, critic, who lives and works in Pärnu, Estonia and Pori, Finland. Graduated from Tallinn University with a degree in art education, JT (1994). 2016-2019 supervisor of animation workshops at Pärnu Museum, 2017-2019 participated in the Erasmus+ ProArt art project in Poland, Latvia, Slovakia, Italy and a web design course in Luxembourg. Organised the Erasmus+ art project 2026 in Treimani. 2017-2018 organiser/instructor of an animation camp in Pärnu and painting camps in Kihnu 2013-2020, Muhu 2023 and Treimani 2024-2026. Since 2020 she has had her own art studio, and also works with children and adults with special needs. 1995-1997 she was head of the library at the Pärnu Chaplin Art Centre and organised exhibitions, poetry, literature and film evenings. Leis was the chief organiser of the 1st Estonian video-format film festival Do-Re-Vi (documentary, advertising and video film) at the Mai Culture Centre in Pärnu. Tiiu Leis is Teacher of the Year 2016 in Pärnu and a nominee for Youth Worker of the Year 2016 nationally, and received the 2017 culture award for organising the exhibition "Rao Heidmets's Animaworld" at the Pärnu Museum. She has participated in the international performance exhibition "Man and Woman", in recycling exhibitions at the Museum of New Art in Pärnu and in overview exhibitions in Pärnu.

artists.b: Erika Aasa on Eestis tegutsev maalikunstnik, kelle looming uurib inimese kohanemist muutuvate eluoludega ning seda, miks sarnased kogemused mõjutavad inimesi erineval viisil.
artists.ben: Erika Aasa is a painter working in Estonia, whose work explores how people adapt to changing life circumstances and why similar experiences affect people differently.

artists.b: Margus Teska on Eesti multidistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kelle looming hõlmab skulptuuri, keraamikat, kostüümi- ja graafilist disaini. Erinevate meediumite vahel liikudes uurib ta materjali, vormi ja visuaalse jutustamise omavahelisi seoseid, ühendades tehnilise meisterlikkuse kujutlusvõimelise ja kontseptuaalse lähenemisega.
artists.ben: Margus Teska is an Estonian multidisciplinary artist whose work encompasses sculpture, ceramics, costume and graphic design. Moving between different media, he explores the interrelations of material, form and visual storytelling, combining technical mastery with an imaginative and conceptual approach.

artists.b: Pavel Kašutin on kaasaegne Eesti kunstnik, kes töötab šabloonkunsti, popkunsti ja tänavakunsti tehnikatega. Ta on sündinud ja kasvanud Suurpeal ning elab ja töötab praegu Loksal. Kunstiga tegeleb alates 2020. aastast, alustades ekspressionismist ja liikudes popkunsti suunas.
artists.ben: Pavel Kašutin is a contemporary Estonian artist who works with stencil art, pop art and street art techniques. He was born and raised in Suurpea and currently lives and works in Loksa. He has been engaged in art since 2020, starting with expressionism and moving towards pop art.

artists.b: Rebeka Vaino (s. 1995, Tallinn, Eesti) on Londoni ja Pariisi vahel tegutsev kunstnik, kes on tuntud oma värvikirevate ja kontseptuaalsete tööde poolest. Ta lõpetas hiljuti Goldsmiths’i ülikooli vabade kunstide magistriõppe (MFA, jaanuar 2025).
artists.ben: Rebeka Vaino (b. 1995, Tallinn, Estonia) is an artist working between London and Paris, known for her colourful and conceptual works. She recently completed her Master of Fine Arts (MFA) at Goldsmiths, University of London (January 2025).

artists.b: Maik Kalberg (sündinud 1987-ndal aastal Tartus) on eesti maalikunstnik ja filmitegija. Ta on õppinud Tartu Kunstigümnaasiumis kunstikallakuga klassis ning omandanud filmikunsti alase kõrghariduse Balti Filmi- ja Meediakoolis. Hetkel elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Kunstnikuna soovib Maik nii oma eksistentsi kui loominguga luua maailma positiivset energiat ning otsida vähimana alati kasvõi kasulikku ja praktilist käitumismustrit. Inimese asi siin ilmas pole mitte lihtsalt koormata ja kulutada keskkonda, milles ta viibib, vaid oma siinolemisega sünnitada midagi tõstvat.
artists.ben: Maik Kalberg (born 1987 in Tartu) is an Estonian painter and filmmaker. He studied at Tartu Art Grammar School in a class with an art focus and obtained higher education in film art at the Baltic Film and Media School. He currently lives and works in Tallinn. As an artist, Maik wishes, both with his existence and his creative work, to create positive energy in the world and to seek, at the very least, even a useful and practical pattern of behaviour. A person's task in this world is not merely to burden and consume the environment in which they exist, but to give birth, through their presence here, to something uplifting.

artists.b: Viktor Kiss (s 1981) on Eesti skulptor ja interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kelle loominguline praktika ühendab nüüdisskulptuuri, installatsioonikunsti, sotsiaalse disaini ja meditsiini.
artists.ben: Viktor Kiss (b. 1981) is an Estonian sculptor and interdisciplinary artist whose creative practice combines contemporary sculpture, installation art, social design and medicine.

artists.b: Kaia Otstak (b. 1987 Tallinn, Estonia) is a freelance painter, an illustrator, a performance-artist and a Master of philosophy. She holds a B.A. and M.A. in Philosophy from Tallinn University. Otstak has participated in solo and group exhibitions since 2006, she has performed on an international scale, her articles have published in different special magazines and newspapers. Her main interests in her artwork are to find representation for the mysticism and to be in a dialogue with ethics. She currently lives and works in Estonia. Over the years, Kaia’s paintings and drawings have changed from the more minimalistic and slightly monochrome style to more detailed and colourful style. But throughout the times her figurative paintings and graphics represent other realms or this realm with a philosophical or a spiritual touch.

artists.b: Õppisin 6 aastat Ivangorodi kunstikoolis ja 3 aastat Venemaal Jekaterinburgi Shadri kunstikoolis. Töötan Narvas kunstikoolis. Vabal ajal tegelen loovtööga. Osalen Westervalli kunstnike kogukonna grupinäitustel erinevates linnades.
artists.ben: I studied for 6 years at the Ivangorod Art School and for 3 years in Russia at the Shadr Art School in Yekaterinburg. I work at the art school in Narva. In my free time I engage in creative work. I participate in group exhibitions of the Westerwall artists' community in various cities.

artists.b: Lappy Mary (Maria Lapteva) on Eesti maalikunstnik. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali erialal (MA, 2014). Ta on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Autorite Ühingu liige ning aastatel 2015–2017 oli ta Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu juhatuse esinaine. Näitustel on ta osalenud alates 2008. aastast.
artists.ben: Lappy Mary (Maria Lapteva) is an Estonian painter. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting (MA, 2014). She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Authors' Society, and in 2015-2017 she was the chairwoman of the board of the Estonian Painters' Association. She has participated in exhibitions since 2008.

artists.b: Lotte Jürjendal on Eesti multidistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kelle looming ühendab maali, helikunsti, tekstiili, installatsiooni ja skulptuuri. Valitud isikunäitused 2022 – “Baroque in Metaverse”, Solaris Galerii, Tallinn. Näitus ühendas käsitsi tikitud kõrgmoe, heli ja tekstiilimaali. 2022 – “Avatars”, OKAPI Galerii, Tallinn. Installatiivne näitus uuris virtuaalset identiteeti, kosmost ja kehastumist maali, helikunsti, tikitud skulptuuride ja valgusinstallatsioonide kaudu.
artists.ben: Lotte Jürjendal is an Estonian multidisciplinary artist whose work combines painting, sound art, textile, installation and sculpture. Selected solo exhibitions: 2022 – "Baroque in Metaverse", Solaris Gallery, Tallinn. The exhibition combined hand-embroidered haute couture, sound and textile painting. 2022 – "Avatars", OKAPI Gallery, Tallinn. An installation exhibition exploring virtual identity, cosmos and embodiment through painting, sound art, embroidered sculptures and light installations.

artists.b: Õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja Oslo Kunstiakadeemias. Kirjastuse Näo Kirik ja disainistuudio AKT7 loovjuht. Tunnustatud auhindadega raamatukujunduse, turunduse ja reklaami alal. Eestis avaldanud seitse, Soomes kolm luulekogu. Kultuurkapitali kirjanduse aastapreemia, Rahvuskultuurfondi debüüdipreemia ja Loomingu aastapreemia. Teostanud end kunstnikuna graafikas, supergraafikas, maalis, fotos, illustratsioonis, animatsioonis ja koomiksis. Isikunäitused on toimunud Eestis, Soomes, Rootsis ja Norras.
artists.ben: Studied at the Estonian Academy of Arts and the Oslo Academy of Arts. Creative director of the publishing house Näo Kirik and design studio AKT7. Recognised with awards in book design, marketing and advertising. Has published seven collections of poetry in Estonia and three in Finland. Cultural Endowment of Estonia annual literary award, the Estonian National Culture Foundation's debut prize and the Looming annual award. Has developed as an artist in printmaking, super-graphics, painting, photography, illustration, animation and comics. Solo exhibitions have taken place in Estonia, Finland, Sweden and Norway.

artists.b: Meriliis Rinne (MERU) on Eestis sündinud kunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Ühendkuningriigis. Tema looming keskendub abstraktse maalikunsti ja abstraheeritud naisfiguuride kaudu pingete uurimisele – tasakaalule struktuuri ja vabaduse, kontrolli ja intuitiivsuse ning pinna ja sügavuse vahel. Tema teosed käsitlevad identiteeti, mälu, haavatavust ja psühholoogilist ruumi, muutes emotsionaalsed kogemused materiaalselt ja visuaalselt mitmekihilisteks kompositsioonideks. Rinne valmistab oma lõuendid ise ning kasutab oma töödes sageli taaskasutatud tekstiile, vanu kangaid ja leitud materjale. Materjal ei ole tema jaoks pelgalt vormiline element, vaid teose lahutamatu osa, mis kannab endas aega, puudutusi ja varasemaid lugusid. Kihthaaval üles ehitatud pinnad sünnivad kraapimise, katmise, lihvimise ja uuesti ülesehitamise kaudu, talletades protsessi jälgi ning peegeldades muutumist ja vastupanu. Tema naisfiguurid ei kujuta konkreetseid inimesi, vaid mõjuvad pigem aimduslike kohaloludena, mis kerkivad ja hajuvad abstraktsete värvipindade sees. Liikudes abstraktsiooni ja figuratsiooni piiril, jätavad need vaatajale ruumi tõlgendamiseks ning kutsuvad mõtisklema identiteedi, sisemaailma ja inimese.
artists.ben: Meriliis Rinne (MERU) is an artist born in Estonia who lives and works in the United Kingdom. Her work focuses on exploring tensions through abstract painting and abstracted female figures – the balance between structure and freedom, control and intuitiveness, and surface and depth. Her works address identity, memory, vulnerability and psychological space, transforming emotional experiences into materially and visually multilayered compositions. Rinne makes her own canvases and often uses recycled textiles, old fabrics and found materials in her works. For her, material is not merely a formal element but an inseparable part of the work, carrying within it time, touches and earlier stories. Surfaces built up layer by layer are created through scraping, covering, sanding and rebuilding, retaining traces of the process and reflecting change and resistance. Her female figures do not depict specific people, but rather function as intimated presences that arise and disperse within abstract fields of colour. Moving along the border between abstraction and figuration, they leave room for the viewer's interpretation and invite reflection on identity, the inner world and the human.

artists.b: Sofia Hallik, a Tallinn-based artist, holds positions as a PhD researcher at the Estonian Academy of Arts and as the Creative Director of jewellery brands SOMA and ONEHE. Renowned for exhibiting her works locally and worldwide, Sofia has garnered recognition through numerous awards. Her work encapsulates the evolving narrative of art in the 21st century, where the tangible and the digital blend seamlessly. By exploring this intersection, Sofia aims to challenge perceptions, evoke emotions, and invite viewers into a world where tradition and technology coexist in harmony. In her artistic practice, Sofia Hallik blends traditional handwork with digital technology. Through mediums such as jewellery and paintings, she explores the synergy between artists’ creativity and machine. In her jewellery, Sofia Hallik utilises digital technologies to create pieces that reflect the idea of a Future Renaissance. Each creation is a testament to the blend of traditional techniques with the limitless possibilities of the machine. When it comes to her paintings, she embraces collaboration with AI, which serves as a starting point for her works. Full portfolio link – https://shorturl.at/beu.
