In 2018 she joined the Estonian Painters' Association, and since 2019 she has also been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association. Colourful and lush in style, she has been actively engaged in creative work since 2008. In 2019 she received the Grand Prize of the Jurmala Seascape Biennial.

artists.b: Andre Joosep Arming (1995) elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonnas fotograafia BA (2018) ja kaasaegse kunsti MA (2024) eriala. Oma loomingus kasutab Arming peamiselt polaroid- ja videomeediume ning päevikuformaati. Armingu töödele on iseloomulikud teemad nagu sündimine ja suremine, eluline katsetamine, ajajoon ja tsüklilisus. Pärast seda jätkas kaasaegse kunsti magistriõpinguid, võttes aega kunstnikupositsiooni täiendamiseks. 2022. aasta oktoobris sai ta uue südame. Käesoleval aastal osales Arming grupinäitusesel „Enese õrnad žestid“ EKA galeriis (kuraator: Kaisa Maasik) ning kevade lõpus osales TASE ‘24 lõputööde näitusel Tallinna Kunstihoones.
artists.ben: Andre Joosep Arming (1995) lives and works in Tallinn. He studied in the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts, BA in Photography (2018) and MA in Contemporary Art (2024). In his work Arming primarily uses the media of polaroid and video, as well as the diary format. Arming's works are characterised by themes such as being born and dying, experiential experimentation, timeline and cyclicality. After that he continued his master's studies in contemporary art, taking time to develop his position as an artist. In October 2022 he received a new heart. This year Arming took part in the group exhibition "Enese õrnad žestid" ["Tender Gestures of the Self"] at the EKA gallery (curator: Kaisa Maasik) and at the end of spring took part in the TASE '24 graduation exhibition at the Tallinn Art Hall.

artists.b: Aime Kuulbusch-Mölder on lõpetanud ERKI skulptuuri eriala ning on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu auliige. Ta alustas näitusetegevust juba 1969. aastal ning on korraldanud 19 isiknäitust Tallinnas, Tartus, Stockholmis, Helsingis ja mujal. Lisaks on ta loonud mitmeid portreemonumente ja skulptuure avalikku ruumi. Tema loomingus on olulisel kohal portreekunst, figuraalne vabaplastika ja abstraktsed suurvormid.
artists.ben: Aime Kuulbusch-Mölder graduated from ERKI in sculpture and is an honorary member of the Estonian Artists' Union. She began exhibiting already in 1969 and has held 19 solo exhibitions in Tallinn, Tartu, Stockholm, Helsinki and elsewhere. She has also created a number of portrait monuments and sculptures for public space. Portraiture, figurative free-standing sculpture and abstract large-scale forms hold an important place in her work.

artists.b: Sander Raudsepp on õppinud keraamikat Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Loomingus ammutab ta peamiselt inspiratsiooni vandenõuteooriatest, religioonist, psühhedeeliast ja mitmeti mõistetavatest naljadest. Raudsepp julgustab vaatajaid looma seoseid esmapilgul seosetuna tunduva vahel ja mõtlema teemadel, mida muidu parema meelega väldiks.
artists.ben: Sander Raudsepp has studied ceramics at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his work he draws inspiration mainly from conspiracy theories, religion, psychedelia and ambiguous jokes. Raudsepp encourages viewers to create connections between things that at first glance seem unrelated, and to think about topics that they would otherwise rather avoid.

artists.b: Philiph A. Luik on maalikunstnik, kes on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli ning õppinud ka Stockholmi Kuninglikus Kunstiinstituudis. Tema looming paistab eelkõige silma ekspressiivse ja julge koloriidiga.
artists.ben: Philiph A. Luik is a painter who has graduated from the Tartu Art School and also studied at the Royal Institute of Art in Stockholm. His work stands out especially for its expressive and bold colouring.

artists.b: Laivi (Laivi Suurväli, snd 1988) on omandanud bakalaureusekraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia moeosakonnas ning magistrikraadi moedisainis Aalto Ülikoolis Helsingis. Ta on täiendavalt õppinud moeajakirjade kujundamist ja reklaami Londonis, läbinud jätkusuutliku moe suvekooli Kopenhaagenis ning praktiseerinud Boris Bidjan Saberi moemajas Barcelonas. Lisaks grupinäitustel on tal viimase 2 aasta jooksul olnud 6 isiknäitust, tähtsamatena neist “Unista Edasi/Liiga Hea” Tartu Kunstimuuseumis ja “Maine igatsus: leida ja kaotada” kahasse Mihkel Maripuuga Hobusepea galeriis. Ta on hiljuta alustanud uut performatiivsete moeinstallatsioonide seeriat, mille kaks esimest näituseõhtut on toimunud ARSi Projektiruumis Tallinnas. Tema loomingut iseloomustab eksperimenteeriv lähenemine tekstiilidele ja rõivastele.
artists.ben: Laivi (Laivi Suurväli, b. 1988) obtained a bachelor's degree from the fashion department of the Estonian Academy of Arts and a master's degree in fashion design from Aalto University in Helsinki. She has additionally studied fashion magazine design and advertising in London, completed a sustainable fashion summer school in Copenhagen, and interned at the fashion house of Boris Bidjan Saberi in Barcelona. In addition to group exhibitions, she has had 6 solo exhibitions over the past 2 years, the most notable of which are "Unista Edasi/Liiga Hea" at the Tartu Art Museum and "Maine igatsus: leida ja kaotada" together with Mihkel Maripuu at Hobusepea Gallery. She has recently started a new series of performative fashion installations, the first two exhibition evenings of which took place at the ARS Project Room in Tallinn. Her work is characterised by an experimental approach to textiles and clothing.

artists.b: Krista Leesi on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias tekstiilikunsti erialal. Ta osaleb aktiivselt näitustel ja omab pikaaegset õpetamiskogemust Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Leesi loomingu hulka kuuluvad nii unikaalteosed kui ka praktilised väikeseeriad.
artists.ben: Krista Leesi has studied textile art at the Estonian Academy of Arts. She actively participates in exhibitions and has long-standing teaching experience at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Leesi's body of work includes both unique works and practical small series.

artists.b: Tõnis Paberit on lõpetanud Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi skulptuuri eriala. Ta on töötanud õppejõuna Tartu Ülikooli kunstide osakonnas, Konrad Mäe nimelises maaliateljees, Tartu Kunstikoolis ning on praegu kaasprofessor Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas. Tema põhisuunad loomingus on psühholoogiline portree, kontseptuaalne installatsioon ja monumentaalkunst ning retrospektsioon. Viimasel kümnendil on Paberit tegelenud turba ja mulla kasutusega skulptuuris.
artists.ben: Tõnis Paberit graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in sculpture. He has worked as a lecturer in the art department of the University of Tartu, in the Konrad Mägi painting studio, at the Tartu Art School, and is currently an associate professor at the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. His main directions in creative work are psychological portraiture, conceptual installation and monumental art, as well as retrospection. Over the last decade Paberit has been working with peat and soil in sculpture.

artists.b: Danel Ülper on lõpetanud Kõrgema Kunstikooli Pallas. Maalikunstis keskendub ta ajalooliste hoonete interjööri uurimisele ning tunneb huvi arhitektuuri ja keskkonna vastu. Praegu tegeleb kunstnik Lõuna-Eesti ja Põhja-Läti piiriäärse piirkonnaga, süvenedes ääremaa olemusse nii kunstiloomingus kui ka hävimisohus olevate hoonete ajaloolise interjööri dokumenteerimisega.
artists.ben: Danel Ülper has graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. In his painting he focuses on the study of the interiors of historical buildings and is interested in architecture and the environment. Currently the artist is working with the border region of South Estonia and North Latvia, delving into the nature of the periphery both in his artistic work and by documenting the historical interiors of buildings at risk of destruction.

artists.b: Veera Gontšugova is a multidisciplinary talent who is working at the intersection of spatial design and creative direction. Her main practice includes production and set design, creative direction for photo/video and events, as well as spatial design and interior styling. Master’s Degree of Interior Architecture from Estonian Academy of Arts, 2023.
artists.ben: Veera Gontšugova is a multidisciplinary talent who is working at the intersection of spatial design and creative direction. Her main practice includes production and set design, creative direction for photo/video and events, as well as spatial design and interior styling. Master's Degree of Interior Architecture from Estonian Academy of Arts, 2023.

artists.b: Evi Gailit (1952) on vabakutseline kunstnik. 1999-2005 õppis Gailit Tartus Konrad Mägi ateljees. Osaleb näitustel alates aastast 2003. Gailit on Eesti Maalikunstnike Liit liige, lisaks Tartu Kunstnike Liidu ja KÜ Pallas liige.
artists.ben: Evi Gailit (1952) is a freelance artist. In 1999-2005 Gailit studied in Tartu in the studio of Konrad Mägi. She has participated in exhibitions since 2003. Gailit is a member of the Estonian Painters' Union, and also a member of the Tartu Artists' Union and KÜ Pallas.

artists.b: Alisa Vasina sündis Tartus aastal 1992. Vasina omandas kunstialased algteadmised aastatel 2002–2007 Tartu Lastekunstikoolis. Kutsekeskhariduse omandas 2008–2012 aastatel Tartu Kunstikoolis dekoraator-stilisti erialal. Leonardo da Vinci programmi raames sai täiendõpet vahetusõpilasena Janis Rozentālsi nimelises Riia Kunstikoolis aastal 2011. Vasina omandas rakendusliku kõrghariduse Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis maalingute osakonnas disaini suunal aastatel 2012-2016. Tänavu kannab kool nime Kõrgem Kunstikool Pallas. Aastast 2019 on Alisa Vasina Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige. Alisa Vasina väljendab oma mõtteid läbi loomadel põhinevate tegelaste kes suhestuvad aja temaatikaga ning kannavad endas erinevaid sümboleid. Kunstnik viljeleb populistliku kunsti liikumise stiili mis kannab nime Lowbrow või Pop-sürrealism. Kunstniku inspireerib selle stiili dekoratiivsus ja huumorimeel – mis on vahel mõnus, mõnikord ebameeldiv ning kohati sarkastiline. Noort maalikunstniku on alati huvitanud moekunst, mistõttu on ta ühendanud need kaks maailma ja loob lisaks maalidele ka omapärase käekirjaga moekunsti esemeid. Kunstniku eesmärk on tuua inimeste ellu värvirõõmu ja väge läbi oma värvikate kujund.
artists.ben: Alisa Vasina was born in Tartu in 1992. Vasina acquired her basic art education between 2002 and 2007 at the Tartu Children's Art School. She obtained her vocational secondary education between 2008 and 2012 at the Tartu Art School, specialising in decorator-stylist. Within the framework of the Leonardo da Vinci programme, she received further training as an exchange student at the Janis Rozentāls Riga Art School in 2011. Vasina obtained her professional higher education at the Tartu Art College, in the painting department, design track, between 2012 and 2016. This year the school bears the name Pallas University of Applied Sciences [Kõrgem Kunstikool Pallas]. Since 2019 Alisa Vasina has been a member of the Tartu Artists' Union. Alisa Vasina expresses her thoughts through animal-based characters that relate to the theme of time and carry various symbols within them. The artist cultivates the style of the populist art movement known as Lowbrow or Pop-Surrealism. The artist is inspired by this style's decorativeness and sense of humour – which is sometimes pleasant, sometimes unpleasant, and at times sarcastic. The young painter has always been interested in fashion, which is why she has combined these two worlds and, in addition to paintings, also creates fashion items with a distinctive style. The artist's aim is to bring colourful joy and strength into people's lives through her colourful imag.

artists.b: Kunst on minu jaoks järgmise viiekümne aasta projekt. Olgu see foto, maal, muusika, tätoveerimine või video, ma näen võimalust end väljendada ning jätta jälg. Suurimaks motivaatoriks on olla eeskujuks kõigile, kes arvavad, et nad ei suuda. Tahan julgustada neid tegutsema just nende enda rada mööda – nende enda stiili, olgu selleks või kriipsujukud.
artists.ben: Art is a fifty-year project for me. Be it photography, painting, music, tattooing or video, I see an opportunity to express myself and leave a mark. My greatest motivation is to be an example to everyone who thinks they cannot. I want to encourage them to act along their own path – their own style, even if it is stick figures.

artists.b: Eva Jänes (1942) on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli 1962. aastal kunstiõpetaja erialal ning Eesti Kunstiinstituudi 1970. aastal maalikunstniku diplomiga, spetsialiseerudes monumentaalmaalile. Loomeperioodi esimestel aastakümnetel keskendus kunstnik enamasti monumentaalmaalile, teostades arvukalt sgrafiitosid, freskosid, sekosid, vitraaže, mosaiike nii Tallinnas kui mitmel pool mujal, peamiselt Virumaal. Viimastel aastakümnetel on autor pühendunud tahvelmaalile. Jänes on koostanud kümneid isikunäituseid, osalenud vabariiklikel kunstinäitustel ja grupinäitustel ning seadnud kokku arvukalt väljapanekuid ka kuraatorina. .
artists.ben: Eva Jänes (1942) graduated from the Tartu Art School in 1962 in the speciality of art teacher, and from the Estonian Art Institute in 1970 with a diploma in painting, specialising in monumental painting. In the first decades of her creative period, the artist mostly focused on monumental painting, executing numerous sgraffiti, frescoes, secco paintings, stained glass windows, and mosaics both in Tallinn and in various other places, mainly in Virumaa. In recent decades the author has devoted herself to easel painting. Jänes has arranged dozens of solo exhibitions, participated in national art exhibitions and group exhibitions, and has also put together numerous displays as a curator.

artists.b: Jaan Luik (s. 1953 Tallinnas) on Eesti skulptor ja kunstiõppejõud. Luik on lõpetanud Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi (1979) ning töötanud ka Tartu Kunstikoolis õpetajana. Ta on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige alates 1990.aastast.
artists.ben: Jaan Luik (b. 1953 in Tallinn) is an Estonian sculptor and art lecturer. Luik graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute (1979) and has also worked as a teacher at the Tartu Art School. He has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Union since 1990.

artists.b: Martin Lazarev (s. 1977 Tartus) on õppinud Tartu kunstikoolis mööbli disaini, puidu restaureerimist ning klassikalist joonistamist. Fotokunsti on autor tudeerinud Tartu kunstikooli kursuste raames, peamiselt on teadmisi omandanud siiski omal käel, praktika käigus. Tööelu on viinud Lazarevi kokku mitmete erinevate disaini- ja reklaamiagentuuridega.
artists.ben: Martin Lazarev (b. 1977 in Tartu) has studied furniture design, wood restoration and classical drawing at the Tartu Art College. The artist has studied photographic art within the framework of courses at the Tartu Art College, but has mainly acquired his knowledge on his own, through practice. His working life has brought Lazarev together with several different design and advertising agencies.

artists.b: Taje Paldrok on performancéi, installatsiooni ja uue meedia kunstnik. Kunstialase hariduse omandanud Academia Non Gratas, Kuvataideakatemias Helsingis, Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja Universität der Künste Berliinis. Ta on rahvusvahelise Non Grata Performance Groupi üks peamisi mootoreid alates 1998. aastast.
artists.ben: Taje Paldrok is a performance, installation and new media artist. She acquired her art education at Academia Non Grata, at the Kuvataideakatemia in Helsinki, at the Estonian Academy of Arts and at the Universität der Künste Berlin. She has been one of the main driving forces of the international Non Grata Performance Group since 1998.

artists.b: M.Hakk (sünd. 1947) on vabakutseline akvarellist kes töötab Eestis ja Prantsusmaal.Lôpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia (end. ERKI) 1971 a. ruumikujunduse erialal.Töötas Eesti Tööstusprojektis , seejärel Helsingis Into Pyykkö ja Leena Kolineni arhitektibüroodes sisearhitektina. Al. 2008 Eesti Akvarellistide Ühingu (EAÜ) liige Al. 2015 Prantsuse Akvarellistide Ühingu (SFA) liige Vôtab pidevalt osa EAÜ ja SFA näitustest.
artists.ben: M. Hakk (b. 1947) is a freelance watercolourist who works in Estonia and France. Graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts (former ERKI) in 1971 in the speciality of interior design. Worked at Eesti Tööstusprojekt, then in Helsinki as an interior architect at the architectural offices of Into Pyykkö and Leena Kolineni. From 2008 a member of the Estonian Watercolour Society (EAÜ). From 2015 a member of the French Watercolour Society (SFA). Regularly participates in exhibitions of the EAÜ and SFA.

artists.b: Anniki Kari on õppinud Tartu Kunstikoolis ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Ta on lõpetanud vabade kunstide ja kunstipedagoogika erialad. Lisaks aktiivsele näitusetegevusele on ta alates 1996. aastast Sally Stuudio kunstiõpetaja ning EKA kunstididaktika lektor.
artists.ben: Anniki Kari has studied at Tartu Art School and the Estonian Academy of Arts. She has graduated in the specialities of fine arts and art pedagogy. In addition to active exhibition activity, she has since 1996 been an art teacher at Sally Stuudio and a lecturer in art didactics at EKA.

artists.b: Evi Tuvikene ( snd 1958) vabakutseline kunstnik.
artists.ben: Evi Tuvikene (b. 1958) freelance artist.

artists.b: Kristiina Jakimenko (s. 1991. aastal Rakveres) elab ja töötab Tallinnas. 2013. aastal lõpetas ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemias vabade kunstide teaduskonnas maali bakalaureuseõpingud ning 2017. aastal Tallinna Ülikoolis kunstiõpetaja magistriõpingud.
artists.ben: Kristiina Jakimenko (b. 1991 in Rakvere) lives and works in Tallinn. In 2013 she graduated with a bachelor's degree in painting from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and in 2017 with a master's degree in art teaching from Tallinn University.

artists.b: Margus Tiitsmaa (s. 1963) tuntud ka Sorgena, kunstnikutee on olnud pikk ja värvikas. Nõukaajal õppis ta peda kunstiosakonnas, töötas kaubamaja akende kujundajana ja tegi Saue tammikus salaja performance’eid. ERKIsse teda ei võetud, kuna Sorge mõttemaailm väljus igas mõttes standarditest ega mahtunud traditsioonilise kunstihariduse raamesse.
artists.ben: Margus Tiitsmaa (b. 1963), also known as Sorge, has had a long and colourful artistic path. During the Soviet era he studied in the art department of the pedagogical institute, worked as a window designer for a department store, and secretly performed performances in the Saue grove. He was not accepted to ERKI, because Sorge's mindset in every sense went beyond the standards and did not fit within the framework of traditional art education.

artists.b: Kerstin Rei (1981) lõpetas Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli skulptuuri eriala. Õpingute käigus täiendas end Ioannina Ülikoolis, Kreekas. Kuulub nii Eesti kui Jaapani Akvarellistide Ühendustesse. On osalenud mitmetel grupinäitustel nii kodu-kui välismaal.
artists.ben: Kerstin Rei (1981) graduated in sculpture from the Tartu Art College. During her studies she continued her education at the University of Ioannina, Greece. She belongs to both the Estonian and Japanese Watercolourists' Associations. She has participated in numerous group exhibitions both at home and abroad.

artists.b: Artur Kuus (s. 1970 Tartus) on Tartus tegutsev kunstnik.
artists.ben: Artur Kuus (b. 1970 in Tartu) is an artist working in Tartu.

artists.b: Maria Hommik, kunstnikunimega Marmiamum, on Võrumaal sündinud ja Tartus elav kunstnik-muusik. Hetkel naudib ta Hiina tušiga maalimist, millele pühendus oma lõpuaastal Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas. Järgmine siht on kaasata isetehtud värve, mis on nii tervise- kui loodussõbralikud, et kunsti tegemine oleks hea ka maisele maailmale, mitte vaid vaimule. Ta näeb loomingut kui head võimalust jagada unikaalset vaatenurka, oma hinge olemust. Elu müsteerium, küsimused ja mõned harvad vastused leiavad koha tema kunstis ja muusikas. Marmiamumi töömeetod on suuresti intuitiivne, improvisatsiooniline, spontaanne.
artists.ben: Maria Hommik, known by the artist name Marmiamum, is an artist-musician born in Võrumaa and living in Tartu. At the moment she enjoys painting with Chinese ink, to which she devoted herself in her final year at the Pallas University of Applied Sciences. Her next goal is to incorporate homemade paints that are both health- and nature-friendly, so that making art would also be good for the earthly world, not only for the spirit. She sees creative work as a good opportunity to share a unique perspective, the essence of her soul. The mystery of life, questions and a few rare answers find a place in her art and music. Marmiamum's working method is largely intuitive, improvisational, spontaneous.

artists.b: Cristelll (kunstnikunimi) on sündinud ja õppinud Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia ning kuulub Eesti Kunstnike Liitu. Cristelll’i põhiliseks väljendusvahendiks on kujunenud akrüülmaal lõuendil. Tema loomingut iseloomustab intuitiivne teekond ja pidev otsing. Inspiratsiooniks on nii emotsioonid, tähendus, mõni ratsionaalne või irratsionaalne ese, orgaanilised vormid, sündmus, mõte. Kunstnik peab lugu taaskasutusest ja eksperimenteerib oma loomingus väga erinevate materjalidega alates kaneelikoorest lõpetades 3D prinditud või ready-made esemetega. Tema töid võib leida nii Eesti Kunstiakadeemia fondist, Pariisi galeriist Mandalianpaillard kui erakogudest. Oma maaliloomingut on Cristelll näidanud nii ühis-kui isiknäitustel nt MONA’s ja Haus galeriis.
artists.ben: Cristelll (artist's pseudonym) was born and educated in Tallinn. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts and is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association. Acrylic painting on canvas has become Cristelll's main means of expression. Her work is characterised by an intuitive journey and constant searching. Her inspiration comes from emotions, meaning, some rational or irrational object, organic forms, an event, a thought. The artist values reuse and experiments in her work with very different materials, from cinnamon bark to 3D-printed or ready-made objects. Her works can be found in the collection of the Estonian Academy of Arts, in the Mandalianpaillard gallery in Paris, as well as in private collections. Cristelll has shown her painterly work both in group and solo exhibitions, for example at MONA and at Haus Gallery.

artists.b: Juhan Soomets (1975) on tuntud ennekõike heliruumi “Kunstnike tuba” autorina, mis on olnud väljapanekutel Tallinnas, Viljandis ja Riias ning mis tõi autorile esimese Balti noore kunstniku preemia. Juhan eksperimenteerib oma loomingus interaktiivsuse, osaluskunsti ja kasutajaliidestega, ühendades oma töödes madaltehnoloogilisuse kaasaegsete praktikatega. Loobunud autoripositsioonist, sünnib kunstiteos kas näitusel külastaja osalusel või loob teose algusest lõpuni generatiivne masin (Mandala graafikaseeria). Lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia Uusmeedia osakonna MA (2016) ja Tallinna Ülikooli BA kunstiõpetajana (2004).
artists.ben: Juhan Soomets (1975) is known above all as the author of the sound space "Kunstnike tuba" ["Artists' Room"], which has been exhibited in Tallinn, Viljandi and Riga and which brought the author the first Baltic Young Artist Prize. In his work Juhan experiments with interactivity, participatory art and user interfaces, combining low-tech elements with contemporary practices in his works. Having relinquished the position of author, the work of art comes into being either through the participation of the visitor at an exhibition, or is created from beginning to end by a generative machine (the Mandala graphic series). He graduated with an MA from the New Media Department of the Estonian Academy of Arts (2016) and with a BA as an art teacher from Tallinn University (2004).

artists.b: Taavi Rekkaro on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafikat ning omandab magistrikraadi Tartu Ülikoolis. Oma loomingus keskendub Rekkaro eelkõige fotograafia, maali ja installatsiooni meediumile.
artists.ben: Taavi Rekkaro studied graphic art at the Estonian Academy of Arts and is earning a master's degree at the University of Tartu. In his work Rekkaro focuses primarily on the mediums of photography, painting and installation.

artists.b: Väino Õun (sündinud 1984) on vabakutseline kunstnik ja graafiline disainer. Lõpetas Eesti Kunstiakadeemia (EKA) graafilise disaini eriala, millest ka tärkas huvi tüpograafia, tähtede ja kalligraafia vastu. Tema kunstilist suunda on mõjutanud kokkupuude tänavakunstiga 1996. aastal, millest tekkis dekaadipikkune suhe ja mõju edasisele loomingule. Iseseisvalt hakkas kalligraafiaga tegelema 2015. aastal, juhindudes siirast huvist õppida ära klassikaliste tähevormide printsiibid. Sellest kasvas välja ainulaadne ja.
artists.ben: Väino Õun (born 1984) is a freelance artist and graphic designer. He graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts (EKA) in graphic design, from which also arose his interest in typography, letters and calligraphy. His artistic direction has been influenced by contact with street art in 1996, from which grew a decade-long relationship and influence on his further work. He independently began working with calligraphy in 2015, guided by a sincere interest in learning the principles of classical letterforms. From this grew a unique and.

artists.b: Urmo Teekivi on Göteborgi Ülikooli metallikunsti magistriõppekava üliõpilane, kes on varem lõpetanud Kõrgema Kunstikool Pallas skulptuuriosakonna. Tal on pühendunud ja omanäoline lähenemine visuaalkunstidele, mida on oluliselt mõjutanud tema aastatepikkune kokkupuude näituste ülesseadmiste ja ettevalmistamistega.
artists.ben: Urmo Teekivi is a student of the master's programme in metal art at the University of Gothenburg, having previously graduated from the sculpture department of the Pallas Higher Art School. He has a dedicated and distinctive approach to visual arts, significantly influenced by his years of experience in setting up and preparing exhibitions.

artists.b: Laura Talvet (s. 1981) on Tallinnas elav ja töötav kunstnik. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide osakonnas maali eriala BA (2019) ning on osalenud mitmel rühmanäitusel Eestis. Oma BA lõputöö "Merd vaadates muutud ise selleks" (2019, juhendaja Mihkel Ilus) eest pälvis Talvet EKA Noore Kunstniku preemia. Praegu tegutseb ta vabakutselise kunstnikuna, kelle peamisteks loomingulisteks valdkondadeks on maal, segatehnikad ja fotograafia.
artists.ben: Laura Talvet (b. 1981) is an artist living and working in Tallinn. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, BA in Painting (2019), and has participated in several group exhibitions in Estonia. For her BA thesis work "Merd vaadates muutud ise selleks" (2019, supervisor Mihkel Ilus) Talvet was awarded the EKA Young Artist Prize. She currently works as a freelance artist, whose main creative fields are painting, mixed media and photography.

artists.b: Lõpetasin 2021.a Kõrgema Kunstikooli Pallas maali ja restaureerimise eriala ning täiendasin ennast Portugalis ja Ungaris Erasmuse programmi raames. Ma tegelen monokroomse visuaali uurimisega. Kasutan selleks sütt ja grafiiti. Süsi inspireerib oma ürgsuse ja visandliku tunnetusega. Lõuendina katsetan erineva tekstuuri ja poorsusega pindu nagu paber, linane kangas, betoon, puit jne. Teemadena käsitlen reaalse maailma ja inimese sentimentaalsete mälupiltide vahelist teekonda, milles sisalduvad tahtlikult esile kutsutud ja tahtmatult tekkivad mälestused.
artists.ben: I graduated in 2021 from the Kõrgem Kunstikool Pallas in painting and restoration, and further trained in Portugal and Hungary within the Erasmus programme. I deal with research into monochrome visuals. For this I use charcoal and graphite. Charcoal inspires me with its primordial and sketch-like feel. As a canvas I experiment with surfaces of different texture and porosity, such as paper, linen fabric, concrete, wood, etc. As themes I address the journey between the real world and a person's sentimental memory images, containing both deliberately evoked and involuntarily arising memories.

artists.b: Mart Trummal sündis 1953 Tartus. Lõpetas Tartu Ülikooli teoreetilise füüsika erialal 1976. Maalima hakkas 2017, samast aastast alates osalenud viiel Tartu kunstnike aasta­näitusel ja neljateistkümnel Konrad Mägi Ateljee grupinäitusel. Näitus ”Kaks vaadet” koos Külli Trummaliga Betti Alveri muuseumis Jõgeval 2018. Isikunäitus ”Alasti portreed” Promenaadiviis galeriis Tartus 2019. 2019. aastast tegeleb ka söe- ja pliiatsijoonistustega. Kolmeteistkümne eesti kultuuri­tegelase portreed leidsid kasutust Hando Runneli luulekogu ”Aadamal oli seitse poega” illustratsioonidena, Ilmamaa 2020. Kaks tellitud portreed avalikus ruumis, Eesti Maaülikool 2021, Eesti Teaduste Akadeemia 2022. Iseõppija. Lapsepõlves saanud aasta jagu juhatust Silvia Jõgeverilt ja Laine Pukilt, 2017. aastast alates Konrad Mägi Ateljeest, Aapo Pukilt ja Tiit Pääsukeselt.
artists.ben: Mart Trummal was born in 1953 in Tartu. He graduated from the University of Tartu in theoretical physics in 1976. He began painting in 2017, and since that year has taken part in five annual exhibitions of Tartu artists and fourteen group exhibitions of the Konrad Mägi Studio. The exhibition "Kaks vaadet" ["Two Views"] together with Külli Trummal at the Betti Alver Museum in Jõgeva in 2018. Solo exhibition "Alasti portreed" ["Naked Portraits"] at Promenaadiviis Gallery in Tartu in 2019. Since 2019 he has also worked with charcoal and pencil drawings. Portraits of thirteen figures of Estonian culture were used as illustrations for Hando Runnel's poetry collection "Aadamal oli seitse poega", Ilmamaa 2020. Two commissioned portraits in public space, Estonian University of Life Sciences 2021, Estonian Academy of Sciences 2022. Self-taught. As a child he received a year's worth of guidance from Silvia Jõgever and Laine Pukk, and from 2017 onward from the Konrad Mägi Studio, from Aapo Pukk and Tiit Pääsuke.

artists.b: Asteria (s. 1991) on Eesti maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tartus. Ta on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli dekoratsiooni eriala ning omandanud maalikunsti kraadi Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas.Asteria teoseid eksponeeritakse regulaarselt erinevatel näitustel ning tema töid leidub mitmetes erakogudes nii Eestis kui ka välismaal.
artists.ben: Asteria (b. 1991) is an Estonian painter who lives and works in Tartu. She graduated from the Tartu Art College in decoration and earned a degree in painting from the Pallas Higher Art School. Asteria's works are regularly exhibited at various exhibitions and can be found in numerous private collections both in Estonia and abroad.

artists.b: Martin Buschmann on lõpetanud 2021. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemia magistriõppe kaasaegse kunsti erialal ning 2019. aastal bakalaureuseõppe fotograafia erialal. Buschmann kasutab väljendusvahenditena fotograafiat ja installatsiooni, uurides kriitilisest vaatevinklist erinevaid soolisi representatsioone, mänguteooriaid ja simulaakrume.
artists.ben: Martin Buschmann completed his master's studies in Contemporary Art at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2021, and his bachelor's studies in Photography in 2019. Buschmann uses photography and installation as means of expression, exploring from a critical perspective various gender representations, game theories and simulacra.

artists.b: Anton Aunma on sündinud Tallinnas 1972. aastal. Tartu Kunstikooli lõpetas Anton Aunma 1993. aastal. Lõputööks oli seeria Tartu vaateid. Kunstnik on esinenud näitustel alates 1999. aastast. Peamiselt maalib autor maastikke, linnavaateid ja merd. Vähesel määral on Anton Aunma loomingus ka akte ja natüürmorte. Põhiliseks kasutatvaks tehnikaks on õlimaal.
artists.ben: Anton Aunma was born in Tallinn in 1972. Anton Aunma graduated from the Tartu Art School in 1993. His graduation work was a series of views of Tartu. The artist has taken part in exhibitions since 1999. The artist mainly paints landscapes, cityscapes and the sea. To a lesser extent, Anton Aunma's oeuvre also includes nudes and still lifes. His principal technique used is oil painting.

artists.b: Matti Pärk (s.1945) on lõpetanud Tartu Kunstikooli puitehistöö erialal ning ERKI raamatuillustraatori erialal. On töötanud ENE kunstilise toimetuse juhatajana ja EKA joonistamise kateedri õppejõuna (1984. aastast tänaseni). Ta on oma joonistuste ja pastellmaalidega esinenud paljudel isiknäitustel nii Eestis kui välismaal, samuti osalenud grupinäitustel. Ta on kujundanud, maketeerinud ja illustreerinud ligi 200 raamatut (millest mitmed on pälvinud tunnustust konkurssidel). Viimasel joonistustriennaalil oli Matti Pärk üks peaauhinna nominentidest. Praegu on pooleli isiknäituse koostamine Kuressaare Raegaleriisse.
artists.ben: Matti Pärk (b. 1945) has graduated from the Tartu Art School in the speciality of woodworking and from ERKI in the speciality of book illustrator. He has worked as the head of the art editorial department of the ENE [Estonian Soviet Encyclopaedia] and as a lecturer at the drawing department of EKA (from 1984 to the present). He has presented his drawings and pastel paintings at numerous solo exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad, and has also participated in group exhibitions. He has designed, laid out and illustrated nearly 200 books (several of which have received recognition at competitions). At the last drawing triennial, Matti Pärk was one of the nominees for the main prize. He is currently working on preparing a solo exhibition for the Kuressaare Town Hall Gallery.

artists.b: Olen õppinud maalikunsti eriala alamastme aineid Tartu ülikooli maaliosakonnas ning sattunud visandite lõuendilekandmise järel ka Kumu ühisnäitusele "Muutuv maalikunst". Märkimist väärivad Tartu Loomemajanduskeskuses peetud Noore kunsti oksjonitel osalemine, kus on alghinnaga ostetud ära kolm tööd; tähelepanu väärib Y galerii näituste tegevuses osalemine,nagu ka ART IST KUKU NUUT-il osalemine. Väljendusvahenditest kasutan kujutavat kunsti vaid ühe vahendina, samuti kasutan kirja ja muusikat.
artists.ben: I have studied lower-level painting courses in the painting department of the University of Tartu, and after transferring sketches onto canvas ended up also in Kumu's joint exhibition "Muutuv maalikunst" ["Changing Painting"]. Worth mentioning is my participation in the Young Art auctions held at the Tartu Centre for Creative Industries, where three works have been bought at the starting price; also worth noting is my participation in the activities of Y Gallery's exhibitions, as well as participation in ART IST KUKU NUUT. Among means of expression I use visual art only as one medium, and I also use writing and music.

artists.b: Toomas Rein (s. 1940) on Eesti arhitekt ja akvarellist. Ta lõpetas Tallinna Polütehnikumi tööstus- ja tsiviilehituse erialal ning 1967. aastal Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi arhitektuuriteaduskonna. Pälvis 1986. aastal Riias toimunud Baltimaade akvarellitriennaalil peapreemia. 2011. aastal valmis režissöör Peeter Brambati film “Ehituskunstnik Toomas Rein”.
artists.ben: Toomas Rein (b. 1940) is an Estonian architect and watercolourist. He graduated from the Tallinn Polytechnic in industrial and civil construction and, in 1967, from the Faculty of Architecture of the Estonian State Art Institute. He received the grand prize at the Baltic Watercolour Triennial held in Riga in 1986. In 2011, director Peeter Brambat's film "Ehituskunstnik Toomas Rein" ("Architect Toomas Rein") was completed.

artists.b: Merike Sule-Trubert (s. 1974) on alates 1996. a esinenud arvukatel grupinäitustel Eestis ja välismaal, korraldanud personaalnäitusi ja osalenud mitmetel rahvusvahelistel konkurssidel. Sule-Trubert lõpetas Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafika osakonna 2001. a., pärast õpingute lõpetamist on ta tegelenud peamiselt joonistamise ja fotograafiaga, kuid on loonud ka installatsioone ja kunstnikuraamatuid. Kunstiloomingu kõrvalt on Merike Sule-Trubert juhendanud kunstitudengeid ning võtnud osa ka Tallinna rahvusvahelise joonistustriennaali ja triennaali seminari korraldustoimkonna tööst (2012 ja 2015).
artists.ben: Merike Sule-Trubert (b. 1974) has, since 1996, appeared in numerous group exhibitions in Estonia and abroad, organised solo exhibitions and participated in several international competitions. Sule-Trubert graduated from the Graphic Art Department of the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2001; after completing her studies she has worked mainly in drawing and photography, but has also created installations and artist's books. Alongside her artistic work, Merike Sule-Trubert has supervised art students and has also taken part in the organising committee of the Tallinn International Print Triennial and the triennial seminar (2012 and 2015).

artists.b: MAIKRO on Tartusse, Ülejõe linnaossa rajatava Mikrogalerii kunstnik, kes on ka varem loojana tegutsenud. 80ndate lõpus ja 90ndate alguses osales ta aktiivselt näitusetegevuses peamiselt maalijana ning aeg-ajalt luues ka installatsioone. Lisaks proovis ta kätt moekunstnikuna, luues peamiselt alternatiivseid ja taaskasutatud materjalidel põhinevaid rõivaid. Kuna galeriide võrgustik oli tollal keskendunud peamiselt peavoolu kunstnike esindamisele ja müümisele, jätkas MAIKRO, kes tollal esines loomulikult teise nime all, tegevust lava- ning sisekujundajana.
artists.ben: MAIKRO is the artist of the Micro Gallery being established in the Ülejõe district of Tartu, who has also worked as a creator before. In the late 1980s and early 1990s he actively participated in exhibition activity, mainly as a painter, and occasionally also creating installations. In addition he tried his hand as a fashion designer, creating mainly alternative garments based on recycled materials. Since the gallery network at that time was focused mainly on representing and selling mainstream artists, MAIKRO, who at the time naturally appeared under a different name, continued working as a stage and interior designer.

artists.b: JUNNY CHUN AU-YEUNG (b.1991) graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University with a Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Visual Arts degree in 2015. He also completed a master’s degree in Contemporary Arts from Estonian Academy of Arts in 2022.
artists.ben: JUNNY CHUN AU-YEUNG (b.1991) graduated from Hong Kong Baptist University with a Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Visual Arts degree in 2015. He also completed a master's degree in Contemporary Arts from Estonian Academy of Arts in 2022.

artists.b: Iseõppinud portreefotograaf Ida-Virust. EL komisjoni fotokonkursi “Mina ja Euroopa” auhinnakoht 2013 Nikoni fotokonkurss “Sõbralik Eesti” 2013 I koht Pentaxi aasta portreefotokonkurss 2015 III koht Louvre’i muuseumi 2015. aasta grupinäitus “Exposure awards” Sony World Photography Awards 2015. aasta detsembri võitja Global Encounters Snapshot konkursis 2015 Personaalne fotonäitus Tartu Ülikooli Narva Kolledži galeriis 2016 Pentaxi aasta portreefotokonkurss 2016 II koht Sony World Photography Awards National Awards II koht 2017 Sony World Photography Awards grupinäitus Sommerset House, London 2017 Nikoni 2018. aasta konkursi “Kuupilt” võitja oktoobris ‘What Lies Beneath’ 500px grupinäitus Toronto 2019 Bridgemani stuudioauhinna 2019. aasta jaanuari 2020 valitud nimekiri Grupinäitus ZE+F, Objekt Multimedia Future Hub, Narva 2020.
artists.ben: Self-taught portrait photographer from Ida-Viru. EU Commission photo competition "Mina ja Euroopa" prize place 2013 Nikon photo competition "Sõbralik Eesti" 2013 1st place Pentax portrait photo competition of the year 2015 3rd place Louvre Museum's 2015 group exhibition "Exposure awards" Sony World Photography Awards December 2015 winner Global Encounters Snapshot competition 2015 personal photo exhibition at the gallery of the University of Tartu Narva College 2016 Pentax portrait photo competition of the year 2016 2nd place Sony World Photography Awards National Awards 2nd place 2017 Sony World Photography Awards group exhibition Somerset House, London 2017 Nikon 2018 competition "Kuupilt" winner October 'What Lies Beneath' 500px group exhibition Toronto 2019 Bridgeman studio award, January 2020, 2019 shortlist Group exhibition ZE+F, Object Multimedia Future Hub, Narva 2020.

artists.b: Laurene Bois-Mariage (s. 1981 Prantsusmaal) on prantsuse kunstnik, kes praegu elab ja töötab nii Eestis kui Soomes. Ta omandas esmase vabade kunstide alase kõrghariduse ning ka hilisema magistrikaardi l´Ecole Nationale Superieure de la Photographie kõrgkoolis Arles´is. Pärast seda on Laurene tegelenud oma loomingulise raja arendamisega peamiselt läbi fotograafilise meediumi, laiendades samas fotograafia pakutavaid võimalusi läbi läbi skulptuuri ja installatsoonimaailma.
artists.ben: Laurene Bois-Mariage (b. 1981 in France) is a French artist who currently lives and works in both Estonia and Finland. She obtained her initial higher education in fine arts as well as a later master's degree at the l'Ecole Nationale Supérieure de la Photographie in Arles. Since then, Laurene has been developing her creative path mainly through the medium of photography, while expanding the possibilities offered by photography through the worlds of sculpture and installation.

artists.b: Tartust pärit skulptor Olger Lehtsaar (sünd. 1995) õppis Tartu Ülikoolis bioloogia erialal (2014-2018), kust sattus edasi Kõrgemasse Kunstikooli Pallas (2016-2022). Pallases lõpetas ta skulptuuri eriala Amanduse tunnustusega. Oma õpingute vältel võttis ta osa lumeskulptuuride sümpoosionist Prantsusmaal Valloires, tegi tellimusena bareljeefi Oskar Rütlist, aitas tehniliselt luua teoseid kunstnik Jevgeni Zolotko näitusele “Armastus”(2021) ning on osalenud ka mitme filmiprojekti kunstimeeskonnas võtteplatsi kujundajana ja keerulisemate prop’ide ehitajana. On osa võtnud näitustest “Maniakaalsed rütmid”(2017), “Pallase skulptuurinäitus EMÜ’s” (2019), “0,04tk/m²” (2019), “vali Vari” (2020), “Tulvab olemisse” (2021), “LEND 2022“(2022) ja kõige hilisemalt Eesti Kujurite Ühenduse aastalõpu näitusel “Konserveeritud mateeria” (2022). Skulptuure kirjeldab ta enda jaoks kui meeleolu kajastavat tervikut ehk konkreetses vormis füüsilist kujutust mingist mõttest või meeleolust. Objekti kaudu meeleolu kirjeldamine annab juurde nüansirohkust, sest keeleliselt jääb tihtipeale sõnadest vajaka. Seega saab skulptuuri kaudu inimeste meeleolu maailmu üksteisele lähemale tuua. Oma teoste loomisele läheneb.
artists.ben: Sculptor Olger Lehtsaar (born 1995), originally from Tartu, studied biology at the University of Tartu (2014-2018), from where he moved on to the Pallas University of Applied Sciences (2016-2022). At Pallas he completed his studies in sculpture with the Amandus distinction. During his studies he took part in the snow sculpture symposium in Valloires, France, made a commissioned bas-relief of Oskar Rütli, technically assisted in creating works for artist Jevgeni Zolotko's exhibition "Armastus" (2021), and has also participated in the art teams of several film projects as a set designer and builder of more complex props. He has taken part in the exhibitions "Maniakaalsed rütmid" (2017), "Pallase skulptuurinäitus EMÜ's" (2019), "0,04tk/m²" (2019), "vali Vari" (2020), "Tulvab olemisse" (2021), "LEND 2022" (2022) and, most recently, at the Estonian Sculptors' Union's year-end exhibition "Konserveeritud mateeria" (2022). He describes sculptures for himself as a whole reflecting a mood, i.e. a physical depiction in concrete form of some thought or mood. Describing a mood through an object adds nuance, since words are often insufficient linguistically. Thus, through sculpture, people's worlds of mood can be brought closer to one another. He approaches the creation of his works.

artists.b: Maria Generalova (s. 1991 Tallinnas) on noor maalikunstnik, kes lõpetas 2013. a. Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali eriala bakalaureuseõppe. Tema looming on keskendunud figuratiivsele kompositsioonile; tema maalides on peegeldatud erinevad ühiskondlikult aktuaalsed globaalsed küsimused.
artists.ben: Maria Generalova (b. 1991 in Tallinn) is a young painter who graduated in 2013 from the bachelor's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Her work is focused on figurative composition; her paintings reflect various socially topical global issues.

artists.b: Kertu Rannula (s. 1997) elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Läbi kohaspetsiifiliste foto- ja videoinstallatsioonide uurib ta kaasaegse inimese ja kultuuriruumi suhteid, märke ja sümboleid. Inspireerudes igapäevaelust ja isiklikust kogemusest, adapteerub Rannula oma loomingu vahendusel maailma ning selle nähtustega. Teoseid luues kasutab ta sageli iseenda füüsilist kohalolu ning võtab erinevaid rolle. Selle käigus leiab ta vastuseid enda küsimustele, analüüsib ja mõtestab end ümbritsevat keskkonda. Teoste vormistamisel peab ta oluliseks töötamist ruumiga, lähenedes materjalile ja meediumitele eksperimentaalselt. Rannula on omandanud bakalaureusekraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonnas fotograafia erialal. Ta on täiendanud end Islandi Kunstiülikoolis vabade kunstide osakonnas ning Belgias PXL Rakendusteaduste ja Kunstide Ülikooli skulptuuri ja installatsiooni osakonnas. Rannula on osalenud näitustel Eestis ja välismaal. Viimaste hulgas „snapchat dystoopia” Kanal Galeriis(2022) ja „mälestused -70%” Riia Fotokuul (2021). Aastal 2020 osales ta ISSP Residentuuris Riias, Lätis.
artists.ben: Kertu Rannula (b. 1997) lives and works in Tallinn. Through site-specific photo and video installations, she explores the relationships, signs and symbols between the contemporary human being and cultural space. Inspired by everyday life and personal experience, Rannula adapts to the world and its phenomena through her creative work. In creating her works, she often uses her own physical presence and takes on different roles. In doing so, she finds answers to her own questions, analyses and makes sense of the environment around her. In shaping her works, she considers it important to work with space, approaching materials and media experimentally. Rannula has earned a bachelor's degree in photography from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts. She has furthered her studies at the Iceland University of the Arts in the Fine Arts department and at PXL University of Applied Sciences and Arts in Belgium in the department of sculpture and installation. Rannula has participated in exhibitions in Estonia and abroad. Among the most recent are “snapchat dystopia” at Kanal Gallery (2022) and “memories -70%” at Riga Photomonth (2021). In 2020, she participated in the ISSP Residency in Riga, Latvia.

artists.wdesc: Estonian journalist, artist and film director (born 1948)

artists.b: Helen Bunder (sündinud 31. märtsil 1991 Tartus) on Eesti maalikunstnik ja kunstiõpetaja. Ta lõpetas 2011. aastal Tartu Kunstikooli kujundusgraafika erialal ning 2014. aastal Tartu Ülikooli maalikunsti erialal. 2016. aastal omandas ta Tartu Ülikoolis magistrikraadi kunsti, käsitöö ja kodunduse õpetaja erialal.
artists.ben: Helen Bunder (born 31 March 1991 in Tartu) is an Estonian painter and art teacher. In 2011 she graduated from the Tartu Art College in the speciality of design graphics, and in 2014 from the University of Tartu in the speciality of painting. In 2016 she obtained a master's degree at the University of Tartu in the speciality of teacher of art, handicraft and home economics.

artists.b: Mara Ljutjuk sündis Tallinnas 1978. aastal. Eesti Kunstiakadeemias lõpetas ta maali eriala 2001. aastal ning omandas samas ka haridusteaduste magistrikraadi. Ta on täiendanud end vabades kunstides 2007. aastal Hispaanias Valencia Universidad Politécnicas. 2006. aastast on ta Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ning Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige. Alates 2004. aastast on tal olnud mitmeid isikunäitusi ning osalenud mitmetel ühisnäitustel aastast 2000. Maalimise kõrval tegeleb Mara näituste kureerimise ja kujundamisega, on aktiivselt seotud Evald Okase Muuseumi programmi kureerimise ja korraldamisega. 2019. a. pälvis ta Galerii-G kunstipreemia. 2020 a. oli ta Konrald Mäe preemia nominent. Maral on kolm last (s. 2009/2012/2015) ning ta elab ja töötab Tallinnas.
artists.ben: Mara Ljutjuk was born in Tallinn in 1978. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting in 2001, and also obtained a master's degree in education sciences there. She furthered her education in fine arts in 2007 at the Universidad Politécnica de Valencia in Spain. Since 2006 she has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Painters' Association. Since 2004 she has held several solo exhibitions and has participated in numerous group exhibitions since 2000. In addition to painting, Mara is engaged in curating and designing exhibitions, and is actively involved in curating and organising the programme of the Evald Okas Museum. In 2019 she received the Galerii-G art award. In 2020 she was a nominee for the Konrad Mägi Prize. Mara has three children (b. 2009/2012/2015) and lives and works in Tallinn.

artists.b: Ma olen sündinud 09.1974.a Kiviõlis, Eestis. Lõpetasin Tallinna Ülikooli kunstiosakonna. Praegu töötan Kohtla-Järve Kunstide Koolis kunstiõpetajana, õpetan ka kunsti teraapiat Kohtla-Järve puuetega inimeste sotsiaalmajas. Olen Vene muuseumi virtualfiliaali juht Põlevkivi muuseumi Valges saalis. Sain „Aasta õpetaja“ ja „Aasta lemmik õpetaja“ auhindu. Aastast 2009 olen Kohtla-Järve kunstnikke liidu liige, aastast 2012 Eesti vene kunstnikke liidu liige. Aastast 2008 kuni 2020 osalesin rohkem kui 70 näitustel, neist 10 olid personaalsed näitused. Minu poolt joonistatud pildid on Pushkini muuseumi kollektsioonis, ka erakollektsioonides Soomes, Venemaal, Ameerikas, Saksamaal ja Eestis.
artists.ben: I was born in 09.1974 in Kiviõli, Estonia. I graduated from the art department of Tallinn University. I currently work as an art teacher at the Kohtla-Järve School of Arts, and I also teach art therapy at the Kohtla-Järve social home for people with disabilities. I am the head of the virtual branch of the Russian Museum in the White Hall of the Oil Shale Museum. I received the "Teacher of the Year" and "Favourite Teacher of the Year" awards. Since 2009 I have been a member of the Kohtla-Järve Union of Artists, since 2012 a member of the Union of Russian Artists of Estonia. From 2008 to 2020 I participated in more than 70 exhibitions, of which 10 were solo exhibitions. Pictures drawn by me are in the collection of the Pushkin Museum, as well as in private collections in Finland, Russia, America, Germany and Estonia.

artists.b: Aksel Haagensen (sünd. 1993) on Tallinna kunstnik. Ta lõpetas Eesti Kunstiakadeemia installatsiooni ja skulptuuri eriala bakalaureuseõppe. Kunstis tegeleb ta fotograafia ning dokumentatsiooni teooria küsimustega. Teda ei huvita niivõrd fotode sisu, kuivõrd see, mis jääb raamist või kaadrist nii füüsiliselt kui ka teoreetiliselt välja. Messil esitatud valguskastide seeriaga uurib ta fotodele suunatava tähelepanu kapriissust ning fotode ja kaastekstide seoste haprust. Teos kutsub vaatajat osalema vaatamisprotsessis.
artists.ben: Aksel Haagensen (b. 1993) is a Tallinn-based artist. He completed his bachelor's studies in installation and sculpture at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his art he engages with questions of photography and documentation theory. He is not so much interested in the content of photographs as in what remains outside the frame or the shot, both physically and theoretically. With the series of light boxes presented at the fair, he explores the capriciousness of the attention directed at photographs and the fragility of the connections between photographs and accompanying texts. The work invites the viewer to take part in the process of viewing.

artists.b: Robert Brok (s. 1991) elab ja töötab Tartus. Ta on lõpetanud Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli skulptuuri eriala BA (2015) ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemia kaasaaegse kunsti eriala MA (2019). Hetkel töötab Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas õppejõuna.
artists.ben: Robert Brok (b. 1991) lives and works in Tartu. He has graduated from Tartu Art College with a BA in sculpture (2015) and from the Estonian Academy of Arts with an MA in contemporary art (2019). He currently works as a lecturer at the Pallas Higher Art School.

artists.b: Silvia Sosaar (b. 1979) is an artist living and working in Tallinn. She has an MA from Contemporary Art Dept. of Estonian Academy of Arts. She uses a contemporary work of art to be a so-called (user) interface between the creator, context of creation and the audience. Her activity as an artist is based on mutual creative cooperation and adventures with people that I have chosen. Sosaar has experimented with the analysis of femininity from the neo-pop viewpoint; street-level action; performances at rock concerts; a video production on the topics of mental health based on a literary work; an anthropological study of a profession; including amateurs, etc She is the co-founder and general manager of the publishing house ‘;paranoia’ and has participated at numerous performances of the presentations of publication. Sosaar is a founder of publishing house ‘skaala publishing’. She is also a member of the artists’ performative musical group ‘Karamell’.
artists.ben: Silvia Sosaar (b. 1979) is an artist living and working in Tallinn. She has an MA from Contemporary Art Dept. of Estonian Academy of Arts. She uses a contemporary work of art to be a so-called (user) interface between the creator, context of creation and the audience. Her activity as an artist is based on mutual creative cooperation and adventures with people that I have chosen. Sosaar has experimented with the analysis of femininity from the neo-pop viewpoint; street-level action; performances at rock concerts; a video production on the topics of mental health based on a literary work; an anthropological study of a profession; including amateurs, etc She is the co-founder and general manager of the publishing house ';paranoia' and has participated at numerous performances of the presentations of publication. Sosaar is a founder of publishing house 'skaala publishing'. She is also a member of the artists' performative musical group 'Karamell'.

artists.b: Laura Berta Vahtra (s. 1993) on maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinas. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide osakonna maali erialal BA(2017). Lisaks on ta täiendanud ennast Prantsusmaal Haute École des arts du Rhin’is välisõpingutel (2016-2017). Ta on osalenud mitmetel ühisnäitustel Eestis ja ka Saksamaal. Laura Berta looming on enesereflektsioonil põhinev ning seotud keha, mälu ja ümbruse tunnetuslike teemadega.
artists.ben: Laura Berta Vahtra (b. 1993) is a painter who lives and works in Tallinn. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, majoring in painting, with a BA (2017). She has also furthered her studies abroad at the Haute École des arts du Rhin in France (2016-2017). She has participated in several joint exhibitions in Estonia and also in Germany. Laura Berta's work is based on self-reflection and is connected to perceptual themes of the body, memory and environment.

artists.b: Sündinud (1951) Jõgevamaal, kasvanud Ida-Virumaal. 1980. aastal asus õppima Moskva Kunstiülikooli kujutava kunsti erialal ning lõpetas kiitusega 1985. aastal. Esimese personaalnäitus toimus Kohtla-Järve Põlevkivimuuseumis 1981, altes sellest osalenud igal aastal grupinäitustel (kevad ja sügisnäitused) PKM Valges Saalis ja endises Jõhvi “Oktoobri” kultuuripalees, mille näitusesaal oli Eesti Riikliku Muuseumi filiaal. Enam kui 40 isikunäitust ning osalenud ligi sajal grupi- ja ühisnäitusel.
artists.ben: Born (1951) in Jõgeva County, grew up in Ida-Viru County. In 1980 he began studying fine art at the Moscow Art University and graduated with honours in 1985. His first solo exhibition took place at the Kohtla-Järve Oil Shale Museum in 1981, and since then he has participated every year in group exhibitions (spring and autumn exhibitions) in the White Hall of the PKM and in the former Jõhvi "Oktoober" cultural palace, whose exhibition hall was a branch of the Estonian State Museum. He has had more than 40 solo exhibitions and has participated in nearly a hundred group and joint exhibitions.

artists.b: Born in 1992 in Kurgan, Russia, based in Tallinn, Estonia. 12 years of photography experience. Game of Similarities Telegram channel.
artists.ben: Born in 1992 in Kurgan, Russia, based in Tallinn, Estonia. 12 years of photography experience. Game of Similarities Telegram channel.

artists.b: Dalia Juodakytė omandas magistrikraadi graafika ja trükikunsti erialal Vilniuse Kunstiakadeemias 2016. aastal.
artists.ben: Dalia Juodakytė obtained a master's degree in graphic art and printmaking at the Vilnius Academy of Arts in 2016.

artists.b: Tiiu Rebane (s. 1970) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maaliosakonna 1999. a. maali 2013-2015 TEK, Restaureerimine 2016-2019 EKA, Kunstiteadus ja visuaalkultuuri uuringud, MA 1999. Vabakutseline kunstnik, näitustega esinenud aastast 1994, alustades foto- ja installatsioonikunstnikuna. Edasised maaliõpingud EKAs ning lisastuudium EHI Kultuuriteooria magistratuuris kinnistasid aluse eksistentsiaalse maali viljelemisele ning realismitaotlusele kunstis. Peamine meetod Tiiu Rebase kunstis on olnud dokumentalismi ja eriilmelise manerismi süntees, teemadeks ruum, inimene ja aeg. Töötab maali, foto, kollazi ja videoga. Alates aastast 2013 tegeleb sõltumatute kunstiürituste kureerimisega.
artists.ben: Tiiu Rebane (b. 1970) graduated from the painting department of the Estonian Academy of Arts in 1999. Painting 2013-2015 TEK, Restoration 2016-2019 EKA, Art History and Visual Culture Studies, MA 1999. Freelance artist, exhibiting since 1994, starting out as a photo and installation artist. Further painting studies at EKA and additional studies in the master's programme of Cultural Theory at EHI reinforced the basis for cultivating existential painting and a striving for realism in art. The main method in Tiiu Rebane's art has been a synthesis of documentalism and distinctive mannerism, with themes of space, human being and time. Works with painting, photography, collage and video. Since 2013 she has been engaged in curating independent art events.

artists.b: Kaarel Kütas (s.1981) on mitmekülgne noor kunstnik, kelle käekirja on kujundanud õpingud Academia Non Gratas ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemias, samuti vahetusõpingud Ungari ja Leedu kunstiakadeemiates.
artists.ben: Kaarel Kütas (b.1981) is a versatile young artist whose style has been shaped by studies at Academia Non Grata and the Estonian Academy of Arts, as well as exchange studies at the art academies of Hungary and Lithuania.

artists.b: Helena Lepik, (s. 1994) on vabakutseline maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonna, BA maali õppetoolis (2017). Tema looming on suunatud psühholoogilise eneseotsingu, seksuaalsuse ja identiteedi määratlemise problemaatikale ning surmast tuleneva hingerännakuga seotud teemadele. Ta eelistab töötada suure tasapinnalise maali formaadiga, pöörab tähelepanu jõulisele vormi ning koloriidi tunnetamislaadile.
artists.ben: Helena Lepik, (b. 1994) is a freelance painter who lives and works in Tallinn. She studied at the Estonian Academy of Arts, Faculty of Fine Arts, BA in Painting (2017). Her work is directed towards the problematics of psychological self-search, sexuality and the determination of identity, as well as themes related to the soul's journey arising from death. She prefers to work in the format of large flat painting, paying attention to a forceful sense of form and colour.

artists.b: Kairo on iseõppija, kes peab oma kunstnikutee alguseks 2009. aastat. Paralleelselt lõuendile maalimisega on ta tegutsenud ka tänavatel, signeerides varajaseid šabloonitöid tollase varjunimega Sorro. Kunstnikuna kasutab ta enese kohta meelsasti terminit naivist, kirjeldamaks loomingu värvikirevust, detailirohkust ja teatavat ükskõiksust anatoomia, ruumi ja muu sellise realistliku kujutamise suhtes. Alates 2018. aastast Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Kairo is a self-taught artist who considers 2009 to be the beginning of his artistic career. Alongside painting on canvas, he has also been active on the streets, signing his early stencil works under the pseudonym Sorro at the time. As an artist he readily uses the term naivist to describe himself, in order to characterize the colourfulness and richness of detail of his work, and a certain indifference towards realistic depiction of anatomy, space and the like. Member of the Tartu Artists' Union since 2018.

artists.b: Kalevi Tamm (s. 1965 Tallinnas) võttis peale seiklusi ja raskeid katsumusi ettevõtlusega Kuubal “aja maha“ ja leidis kutsumuse tegeleda fotograafiaga, seda tõsisemalt alates aastast 2008. Oma nõrkuseks ja tugevuseks peab iseõppimist. Peamisteks meelisteemadeks on saanud arhitektuur ja tänavaelu ning mäng varjude ja siluettidega, samas pole välistatud ka kõik muu, mis teele ette jääb. Stiilina eelistab must-valget geomeetrilist korrapärasust. Märkimist väärivad võit ajakirja LIFE rahvusvahelise fotograafia võistlusel aastal 2011 ning osalemine SOHO Arthouse graafika- ja fotonäitusel New Yorgis aastal 2014.
artists.ben: Kalevi Tamm (b. 1965 in Tallinn), after adventures and hard trials in entrepreneurship in Cuba, took a "time out" and found his calling in photography, more seriously so from 2008 onward. He considers self-education both his weakness and his strength. His main favourite themes have become architecture and street life and playing with shadows and silhouettes, while nothing else that crosses his path is excluded either. As a style, he prefers black-and-white geometric regularity. Worth mentioning are his win at the LIFE magazine international photography competition in 2011 and his participation in the SOHO Arthouse graphic and photo exhibition in New York in 2014.

artists.b: Danel Kahar (s.1990) on kunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide osakonna maali erialal BA(2016). Tema esimene isikunäitus toimus aastal 2017 Draakoni galeriis, samal aastal oli tal ka mastaapne näitus koos Grisli Soppe-Kahariga Tartu Kunstimaja suures saalis. 2018 aasta suvel viibis ta koos Grisli Soppe-Kahariga residentuuris Itaalias (Mazzano Romanos). Tema viimane isikunäitus toimus aastal 2021 galerii Metropolis, kus esitles objekte, milles maalikunst seguneb assamblaaži ja skulptuuriga.
artists.ben: Danel Kahar (b.1990) is an artist who lives and works in Tallinn. He graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Fine Arts, majoring in painting, BA (2016). His first solo exhibition took place in 2017 at Draakoni Gallery; the same year he also had a large-scale exhibition together with Grisli Soppe-Kahar in the great hall of the Tartu Art House. In the summer of 2018 he was in residence together with Grisli Soppe-Kahar in Italy (Mazzano Romano). His most recent solo exhibition took place in 2021 at Gallery Metropolis, where he presented objects in which painting is blended with assemblage and sculpture.

artists.b: Jaanus Eensalu on maalikunstnik, graafiline disainer ja õppejõud. Oma loomingulise haridusteekonna on ta läbinud Tartu Ülikoolis ja Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis Pallas, kus toimetab nii osakonnajuhatajana kui kaasprofessorina. Juba aastaid arendab ja juhib ta Pallases meediadisaini osakonda ning tegeleb meedia- ja reklaamidisaini küsimustega. Kunsti- ja disainiharidus on täna eriti oluline ja tähtis, sest meie maailm muutub iga hetk ja väga kiiresti. Eensalu on Eesti Kujundusgraafikute Liidu ja Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige. Näitustel on ta esinenud juba alates 1971. aastast, lisaks on ta loonud mitmeid näitusekujundusi. Ta on hinnatud kujundus- ja meediakunstnik. Õnnelik kunst! Indiviidi loomuses on tahe olla õnnelik ning pühendada ennast lemmiktegevusele. Töö, mida me austame, armastame, oskame ning mille kaudu suudame luua nii vaimset kui ka füüsilist väärtust, annab meile võimaluse olla protsessis osaleja ‒ kunstnik, looja. Mis on õnnelik kunst? Õnneliku kunsti nägemine eeldab hetkeks paigalpüsimist, vaimset ja füüsilist iseseisvust ning avatud tunnetuslikku positiivsust, st peatust. Õnneliku kunsti omandamise põhiprintsiibi aluseks on eratulme* retrospektiivne legend, omandajale vaimse.
artists.ben: Jaanus Eensalu is a painter, graphic designer and lecturer. He completed his creative educational journey at the University of Tartu and at the Tartu Art College Pallas, where he works as both head of department and associate professor. For years he has been developing and heading the media design department at Pallas, and dealing with issues of media and advertising design. Art and design education is especially important and significant today, because our world is changing at every moment and very quickly. Eensalu is a member of the Estonian Association of Graphic Designers and the Tartu Artists' Union. He has exhibited since 1971, and has also created a number of exhibition designs. He is a highly regarded design and media artist. Happy art! It is in the nature of the individual to wish to be happy and to devote oneself to one's favourite activity. Work that we respect, love, are skilled at, and through which we are able to create both spiritual and physical value, gives us the opportunity to be a participant in the process – an artist, a creator. What is happy art? Perceiving happy art requires, for a moment, standing still, mental and physical independence and an open, positively receptive attitude, i.e. a pause. The basic principle of acquiring happy art is founded on a retrospective legend of private income*, giving the acquirer a spiritual.

artists.b: Mirja-Mari Smidt (s.1977)tegutseb põhiliselt vabagraafika ja maali (akvarell, õli, autoritehnika) vallas. Ta on lõpetanud EKA graafika eriala 1999 ja sealsamas õppis ka interdistsiplinaarseid kunste (m.a 2002). Tänu seal õpitule sugenesid vahepeal loomingusse tants, laul ja kehakultus, mis hiljem asendusid sissepoole pööratusega. Tema viimane suurem ülesastumine oli Muhu Print 2017 ülevaatenäitusel Kuku klubis. Mirja-Mari teostes käib kõrvuti autobiograafiline liin (sünd, surm, loodusega kooskõlas olek, täiuseihalus) mõtisklustega usu, ajaloo ja keskkonna teemadel.
artists.ben: Mirja-Mari Smidt (b. 1977) works mainly in the field of free graphic art and painting (watercolour, oil, author's technique). She graduated from the graphic art department of EKA in 1999 and also studied interdisciplinary arts there (M.A. 2002). Thanks to what she learned there, dance, singing and body culture temporarily entered her work, which were later replaced by an inward turn. Her last major appearance was at the Muhu Print 2017 overview exhibition at the Kuku Club. In Mirja-Mari's works, an autobiographical thread (birth, death, being in harmony with nature, longing for perfection) runs alongside reflections on the themes of faith, history and the environment.

artists.b: Riina Kivirüüt (s. 1980 Tallinnas) on õppinud Euroülikoolis sisekujundust, Eesti Kunstiakadeemias stsenograafiat, maali (bakalaureusekraad) ja kunstipedagoogikat (magistrikraad). Näitustel esineb alates 1996. aastast, on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Maalikunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Riina Kivirüüt (b. 1980 in Tallinn) has studied interior design at Euroülikool, and scenography, painting (bachelor's degree) and art pedagogy (master's degree) at the Estonian Academy of Arts. She has been participating in exhibitions since 1996, is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Painters' Union.

artists.b: Karl-Erik Talvet (s. 1991. aastal Pariisis) elab ja töötab Tallinnas. 2018. aastal lõpetas ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemias magistriõpingud maali erialal, samuti on ta viibinud välisõpingute raames 2016/2017 õppeaastal Brera Kunstiakadeemias, Milanos. 2019. aastal käis Talvet sõjalisel missioonil Mali Vabariigis, kus täitis tõlgi ülesandeid, ning on seal saadud kogemust kasutanud oma selle järel tehtud teostes ja näituses. Peamiselt tegeleb Talvet maalimise ja koomiksitega ning on osa võtnud arvukatest näitustest. Ta kuulub nii Eesti Maalikunstnike Liitu ja Eesti koomiksiseltsi.
artists.ben: Karl-Erik Talvet (b. 1991 in Paris) lives and works in Tallinn. In 2018 he completed his master's studies in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and has also spent time abroad during the 2016/2017 academic year at the Brera Academy of Fine Arts in Milan. In 2019 Talvet went on a military mission to the Republic of Mali, where he served as an interpreter, and has used the experience gained there in his subsequent works and exhibition. Talvet mainly works with painting and comics and has participated in numerous exhibitions. He is a member of both the Estonian Painters' Association and the Estonian Comics Society.

artists.b: Britta Paemurru (s. 1992) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maaliosakonna bakalaureusekraadiga. Ta on osalenud grupinäitustel, nende seas TASE18.
artists.ben: Britta Paemurru (b. 1992) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Painting Department, with a Bachelor's degree. She has taken part in group exhibitions, among them TASE18.

artists.b: Jaanika Arum graduated from the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre in 2014 as an actress. She has varied experience acting in both film and theatre. For a wider audience she is mostly known for her work in the following films: Free Range by Veiko Õunpuu, The Days That Confused by Triin Ruumet, The Polar boy by Anu Aun, and Purge by Antti J.Jokinen.
artists.ben: Jaanika Arum graduated from the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre in 2014 as an actress. She has varied experience acting in both film and theatre. For a wider audience she is mostly known for her work in the following films: Free Range by Veiko Õunpuu, The Days That Confused by Triin Ruumet, The Polar Boy by Anu Aun, and Purge by Antti J. Jokinen.

artists.b: Anna Trell on feministlik kunstnik, keda huvitab teoste loomisel kollektiivsus, performatiivsus, kehalisus, käsitöötehnikad ja töötamine materjalidega. Trelli käsitleb loomingus naise rolli puudutavaid teemasid ühiskonnas, kritiseerib patriarhaalseid tööstruktuure ja geeniusekultust.
artists.ben: Anna Trell is a feminist artist who, in creating her works, is interested in collectivity, performativity, corporeality, craft techniques and working with materials. In her work Trell addresses themes concerning the role of women in society, criticizing patriarchal work structures and the cult of genius.

artists.b: Jila Svicevic (born 1991) is an intermedia artist. He was born in Novi Sad, Yugoslavia, but currently lives and works in Tallinn, Estonia. He has studied art in Estonian Academy of Arts (New Media, Design), University of Nova Gorcia (Media Arts and Practises; MA) and Hungarian University of Fine Arts (Master of Fine Arts in Intermedia). He has had many exhibitions in Hungary and Russia.
artists.ben: Jila Svicevic (born 1991) is an intermedia artist. He was born in Novi Sad, Yugoslavia, but currently lives and works in Tallinn, Estonia. He has studied art in Estonian Academy of Arts (New Media, Design), University of Nova Gorcia (Media Arts and Practises; MA) and Hungarian University of Fine Arts (Master of Fine Arts in Intermedia). He has had many exhibitions in Hungary and Russia.

artists.b: Elo Strauss (s. 1986) õppis Balti Filmi- ja Meediakoolis helirežissööri eriala. Ta lõpetas 2018. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemia fotograafia eriala bakalaureusekraadiga. Siiani on ta osalenud kolmel grupinäitusel.
artists.ben: Elo Strauss (b. 1986) studied sound directing at the Baltic Film and Media School. She graduated in 2018 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a bachelor's degree in photography. She has so far participated in three group exhibitions.

artists.b: Paco Ulman (s. 1980) on Tallinna arhitekt ja fotokunstnik, kes on tuntust kogunud eelkõige oma metafüüsiliste vaikeludega nüüdisaja linnaruumis. 2008. aastast on ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemia arhitektuurimagister. Fotokunstnikuna tegeleb Ulman enamasti urbaanse ruumi problemaatikaga, millega puutub kokku oma igapäevatöös arhitektina, nihestades omavahel aja ja ruumi mõisteid ning ruumi ja ruumi representatsiooni kategooriaid. Praeguse seisuga kuuluvad tema olulisemate isikunäituste hulka „Tallinnas” Hobusepea galeriis 2009. aastal, „Tallinn-Helsinki-Stockholm” Tallinna Linnagaleriis 2011. aastal ning „mememe” Hobusepea galeriis 2014. aastal. 2012. aastal pälvis Ulman Sadolini nüüdiskunstipreemia.
artists.ben: Paco Ulman (b. 1980) is a Tallinn architect and photographic artist, who has gained recognition primarily for his metaphysical still lifes in the contemporary urban environment. Since 2008 he has held a Master's degree in Architecture from the Estonian Academy of Arts. As a photographic artist, Ulman deals mostly with the problems of urban space, which he encounters in his everyday work as an architect, dislocating the concepts of time and space as well as the categories of space and the representation of space. Currently, his most important solo exhibitions include "Tallinnas" at Hobusepea Gallery in 2009, "Tallinn-Helsinki-Stockholm" at Tallinn City Gallery in 2011, and "mememe" at Hobusepea Gallery in 2014. In 2012 Ulman received the Sadolin Contemporary Art Prize.

artists.b: Johan Huimerind (s 1991) on lõpetanud Tartu kõrgema kunstikooli fotoosakonna. Oma loomingut mängulisuse ja varjatusega kirjeldavale kunstnikule on omane eri tehnikate kombineerimine ning mitmekülgne aines.
artists.ben: Johan Huimerind (b 1991) has graduated from the photography department of the Tartu Art College. Characteristic of the artist, who describes his work as playful and hidden, is the combining of various techniques and versatile subject matter.

artists.b: Katarina Meister (1990) lõpetas 2016. a. Eesti Kunstiakadeemia magistrikraadiga maali erialal, olles varasemalt omandanud samas valdkonnas ka bakalaureusekraadi. Viimase õppeaasta veetis ta Helsinki Kunstiakadeemias, kus valmistas ette oma magistritööd. 2011-2012 õppis Meister Londonis Central Saint Martinsi Kunsti- ja Disainiülikoolis. Kunstnikul on seni olnud neli isiknäitust ning ta on osalenud mitmetel rühmanäitustel Eestis, Ühendkuningriikides, Hispaanias ja Leedus.
artists.ben: Katarina Meister (1990) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in painting, having previously obtained a bachelor's degree in the same field there. She spent her final academic year at the Helsinki Academy of Fine Arts, where she prepared her master's thesis. In 2011-2012 Meister studied at Central Saint Martins College of Art and Design in London. The artist has so far had four solo exhibitions and has participated in several group exhibitions in Estonia, the United Kingdom, Spain and Lithuania.

artists.b: Tanel Tolsting (s. 1987) on lõpetanud Tartu Ülikooli kunstide magistrina ning õppinud ka Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis ja Porto Ülikoolis. Tegutseb vabakutselise kunstnikuna alates 2013.
artists.ben: Tanel Tolsting (b. 1987) has graduated from the University of Tartu with a master's degree in art, and has also studied at the Tartu Art College and the University of Porto. He has been working as a freelance artist since 2013.

artists.b: Karola Kaugema on Eesti Kunstiakadeemia teise kursuse maalitudeng. Kunstiga on süvitsi tegelenud juba kuuendast eluaastast alates, mil asus õppima a tunnustatud eesti maali- ja klaasikunstniku käe all – seal omandas endale erilise maalikäekirja ja kogemused 12 aasta jooksul. Samuti õppis Kaugema Pelgulinna gümnaasiumis kunsti süvaõppega klassis.
artists.ben: Karola Kaugema is a second-year painting student at the Estonian Academy of Arts. She has been deeply engaged with art since the age of six, when she began studying under the guidance of a recognised Estonian painter and glass artist – there she gained a distinctive painterly style and experience over 12 years. Kaugema also studied in the art-focused advanced-study class at Pelgulinna Gymnasium.

artists.b: Hanna Piksarv (s. 1989) on skulptor ja visuaalkunstnik, kes on on omandanud magistrikraadi skulptuuri erialal 2015. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Alates 2009. aastast on Hanna Piksarv osalenud grupinäitustel Eestis ja Austrias, viimastel aastatel on põhirõhk koostööprojektidel ja isikunäitustel. Nende seas keha, aja ja töö teemat käsitlev isikunäitus “Hea ja halg” Tartu Kunstimajas 2014. aastal ning käsitöö väärtusi kaaluv projekt “Excellence in Ebensee” Festival of Regions-i programmi raames Austrias. Hetkel töös olev mõtlemise ja näputöö sünergiat käsitlev projekt jõuab samuti nii Tallinna kui Viini publikuni.
artists.ben: Hanna Piksarv (b. 1989) is a sculptor and visual artist, who obtained a master's degree in sculpture in 2015 at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Since 2009, Hanna Piksarv has participated in group exhibitions in Estonia and Austria; in recent years the main focus has been on collaborative projects and solo exhibitions. Among them the solo exhibition "Hea ja halg", dealing with the theme of body, time and work, at the Tartu Art House in 2014, and the project "Excellence in Ebensee", weighing the values of craft, within the framework of the Festival of Regions programme in Austria. A currently ongoing project dealing with the synergy of thinking and handiwork will likewise reach audiences in both Tallinn and Vienna.

artists.b: Henri Hütt (1985) on omandanud bakalaureusekraadi Tartu Ülikooli Viljandi Kultuuriakadeemia etenduskunstide osakonnas ning magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonnas tegevuskunsti erialal. Hütt väärtustab loomingulisi hübriidvorme, kuhu kuuluvad nii tehnoloogilise dominandiga etenduskunsti vormid, performatiivsed installatsioonid, helietendused, lavastatud näituse kontseptsioon ning palju muud tabamatut. Henri Hütt on ka rühmituse MIMproject liige.
artists.ben: Henri Hütt (1985) has obtained a bachelor's degree from the Department of Performing Arts of the Viljandi Culture Academy of the University of Tartu, and a master's degree in performance art from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Hütt values creative hybrid forms, which include performance art forms with a technological dominant, performative installations, sound performances, the concept of the staged exhibition, and much more that is elusive. Henri Hütt is also a member of the group MIMproject.

artists.b: Esti Kittus (sündinud 7. aprillil 1948 Tartus) on eesti teatrikunstnik ja kunstiõpetaja. Ta õppis aastatel 1963–1966 Tartu Kunstikoolis ning lõpetas 1966. aastal Tartu õhtukeskkooli ja 1972. aastal teatrikunstnik-pedagoogi erialal Eesti NSV Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi (juhendaja Mari-Liis Küla).Kittus töötas aastatel 1972–2003 Vanemuise teatris kunstnikuna. Ta on kujundanud ka Tartu laulu- ja tantsupidusid. 2004. aastal rajas ta Puka kunstikooli ning töötas seal 2021. aastani. Ta on Eesti Teatriliidu (1974), Eesti Lavastuskunstnike Liidu (1993; auliige) ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige (1995). Samuti kuulub ta Tartu Kunstnike Liitu.
artists.ben: Esti Kittus (born 7 April 1948 in Tartu) is an Estonian theatre artist and art teacher. She studied in 1963–1966 at the Tartu Art School and graduated in 1966 from the Tartu Evening Secondary School and in 1972 in the speciality of theatre artist-pedagogue from the Estonian SSR State Art Institute (supervisor Mari-Liis Küla). Kittus worked from 1972 to 2003 as an artist at the Vanemuine Theatre. She has also designed the Tartu song and dance festivals. In 2004 she founded the Puka Art School and worked there until 2021.
