She is a member of the Estonian Theatre Union (1974), the Estonian Association of Stage Designers (1993; honorary member) and the Estonian Artists' Association (1995). She also belongs to the Tartu Artists' Union.

artists.b: Benjamin Vassermann (s. 1949 Kirovi oblastis Venemaal) on lõpetanud Eesti Riikliku Kunstiinstituudi graafika erialal (1979) ning on osalenud näitustel alates 1978. a. Vassermann on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige 1989. aastast ning Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse liige 1992. aastast. Viljeleb sügavtrükitehnikas (ofort, akvatinta) ja digitaaltrükis vabagraafikat. Loonud ka akvarelle, plakateid, raamatukujundusi ning kujundanud katalooge ja heliplaadiümbriseid.
artists.ben: Benjamin Vassermann (b. 1949 in Kirov Oblast, Russia) graduated from the Estonian State Art Institute in graphic art (1979) and has participated in exhibitions since 1978. Vassermann has been a member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 1989 and a member of the Estonian Association of Printmakers since 1992. He practises free graphic art in intaglio printing techniques (etching, aquatint) and digital printing. He has also created watercolours, posters, book designs and has designed catalogues and record covers.

artists.b: Maarja Nõmmik (snd 1991) on omandanud Tartu ülikoolis bakalaureuse- ja magistrikraadi maalikunsti erialal. Lisaks täiendas ta end maalikunsti, multimeedia ja kontseptuaalse tekstiili vallas Strzemiński kunstiakadeemias Łódźis Poolas.
artists.ben: Maarja Nõmmik (b. 1991) has obtained a bachelor's and master's degree in painting at the University of Tartu. In addition, she furthered her studies in painting, multimedia and conceptual textile at the Strzemiński Academy of Fine Arts in Łódź, Poland.

artists.b: Cristo Madissoo (s. 1996) õpib Eesti Kunstiakadeemias animatsiooni erialal.
artists.ben: Cristo Madissoo (b. 1996) is studying animation at the Estonian Academy of Arts.

artists.b: Merit Paenurm (s. 1995) on noor kunstnik kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias maali erialal, ning tema peamiseks väljendusmeetodiks on maalikunst. Lisaks klassikalisele maalile, on kunstnik tegelenud ka installatsioonikunstiga. Oma töödes proovib Merit avaldada iseenese mõttemaailma, enda nägemust elust ja füüsiliselt kujutada vormituid ilminguid.
artists.ben: Merit Paenurm (b. 1995) is a young artist who lives and works in Tallinn. She has studied painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and her main means of expression is painting. In addition to classical painting, the artist has also engaged in installation art. In her works Merit tries to express her own world of thought, her own vision of life, and to physically depict formless phenomena.

artists.b: Kaili-Angela Konno (s. 1970 Valga linnas) on maalikunstnikuna osalenud arvukatel näitustel alates aastast 1997. Konno on omandanud maalikunsti eriala bakalaureusekraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias (1999). “Olen otsinud sisemist ja välist nihet ruumis ja inimeses. See laseb asjadel tavatust vaatepunktist paista, mille tõttu tekivad seosed ja kokkujooksmised uues plaanis. Mis lõpptulemusena tasakaalustub tervikuks,” ütleb kunstnik ise oma loomingu seletuseks praegusele Eesti Kunstnike Liidu presidendile Vano Allsalule antud intervjuus.
artists.ben: Kaili-Angela Konno (b. 1970 in the town of Valga) has participated as a painter in numerous exhibitions since 1997. Konno holds a bachelor's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts (1999). "I have sought internal and external shifts in space and in the person. This lets things appear from an unusual viewpoint, which creates connections and convergences on a new plane, which ultimately balances into a whole," the artist herself says in explanation of her work, in an interview given to Vano Allsalu, the current president of the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Annabel Janke (s. 1994) on maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Peale Tallinna Kunstikooli lõpetamist alustas ta Eesti Kunstiakadeemias õpinguid graafilise disaini erialal kuid hetkel on käsil maaliosakonna lõpetamine. Oma maalide puhul huvitab teda eelkõige inimese kujutamine, tema karakteri tabamine ning ka abstraktsus. Viimasel ajal on teda huvitama hakanud enam op-kunst, kusjuures oma stiiliga on ta alati kaldunud pop-kunstiliku plakatlikkuse poole. Lisaks sellele tegeleb kunstnik ka karikatuuride joonistamisega.
artists.ben: Annabel Janke (b. 1994) is a painter who lives and works in Tallinn. After graduating from the Tallinn Art School, she began studies in graphic design at the Estonian Academy of Arts, but is currently completing her studies in the Painting Department. In her paintings she is primarily interested in depicting the human being, capturing character, as well as abstraction. Lately she has become more interested in op-art, while her style has always tended toward pop-art-like poster-like quality. In addition, the artist also draws caricatures.

artists.b: Mari-Liis Rebane ​(s. 1988) on tegutsenud audiovisuaalse kultuuri sfääris kaasamõtleja, ideekäivitaja, kuraatori ning kriitikuna. Aastatel 2013‒2015 juhtis ta Baltimaade suurimat rahvusvahelist animatsioonfilmide festivali, pidades oma peamiseks eesmärgiks animatsiooni mõiste laiendamist ja ümber defineerimist ning sidudes animatsiooni teiste kunstivaldkondadega. Ta on osalenud audiovisuaalse valdkonna festivalidel väliseksperdina (Ars Electronica 2016 žüriiliige, Festivali «Radical Atoms» The Prix Forums paneeldiskussiooni moderaator). Aastal 2015 alustas ta õpinguid Eesti Kunstiakadeemia uue meedia osakonnas, keskendudes helikunstile (juhendaja Raul Keller).
artists.ben: Mari-Liis Rebane (b. 1988) has worked in the sphere of audiovisual culture as a thinker, idea initiator, curator and critic. From 2013 to 2015 she headed the largest international animated film festival in the Baltic countries, considering her main goal to be expanding and redefining the concept of animation and linking animation with other fields of art. She has taken part in audiovisual field festivals as a foreign expert (jury member of Ars Electronica 2016, moderator of the Prix Forums panel discussion of the «Radical Atoms» festival). In 2015 she began studies at the Estonian Academy of Arts' department of new media, focusing on sound art (supervisor Raul Keller).

artists.b: Peeter Krosmann (snd 1971 Pärnus) on Kaunases elav ja töötav maalikunstnik. Ta on õppinud Konrad Mägi Ateljees ning lõpetas 2005. aastal Tartu Ülikooli maaliosakonna. Alates 1999. aastast on ta õpetanud joonistamist, illustratsiooni, koomiksikujundust ja teisi õppeaineid Tartu Kunstikoolis ja Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikooli. 2015. aastal määrati talle Ado Vabbe preemia. Kuigi enamik tema isikunäituseid on toimunud Tartus, on tema töid näidatud ka Leedus, Lätis, Prantsusmaal ja Norras. Tema stiil sulatab ühte traditsioonilise maalilise lähenemise ja kaasaegse arusaama autorit ümbritsevast maailmast. Teda tuntakse eelkõige linnavaadete maalijana ning ta on ka hinnatud portretist. Muuhulgas on Krosmann ka mitmete sgrafiito tehnikas seinamaalingute autor.
artists.ben: Peeter Krosmann (b. 1971 in Pärnu) is a painter living and working in Kaunas. He studied at the Konrad Mägi Studio and graduated from the painting department of the University of Tartu in 2005. Since 1999 he has taught drawing, illustration, comic design and other subjects at the Tartu Art School and the Tartu Art College. In 2015 he was awarded the Ado Vabbe Prize. Although most of his solo exhibitions have taken place in Tartu, his works have also been shown in Lithuania, Latvia, France and Norway. His style fuses the traditional painterly approach with a contemporary understanding of the world surrounding the author. He is known primarily as a painter of cityscapes and is also a highly regarded portraitist. Among other things, Krosmann is also the author of several sgraffito-technique wall paintings.

artists.b: Leena Kuutma (1974) loominguline käekiri on tihti hüb- riidne ning seotud peamiselt skulptuurile omase ruumiko- gemuse ja keraamikale iseloomulike materjaliteadmiste ühendamisega. Ta on varasemalt kasutanud joonistusteh- nikaid keraamikas ning teda kõnetavad ka avaliku ruumi ja monumentaalkunsti teemad. Kuutma on lõpetanud EKA skulptuuri eriala (1996), osalenud arvukatel näitustel nii Eestis kui ka mujal ning alates 1994. aastast kokku enam kui viiekümnel workshop’il, sümpoosionil ja kon- kursil, töötades puidu, kivi, betooni, lume ja jääga. Tema töid on paljudes era- ja muuseumikogudes ning avalikus ruumis Eestis, Saksamaal, Austrias, Türgis, Taanis, Lätis ja Leedus. Kuutma on Eesti Keraamikute Liidu, Eesti Kujurite Ühenduse ja Eesti Kunstnike Liidu liige.
artists.ben: Leena Kuutma's (1974) creative style is often hybrid and mainly connected with combining the spatial experience characteristic of sculpture with the material knowledge characteristic of ceramics. She has previously used drawing techniques in ceramics and is also drawn to themes of public space and monumental art. Kuutma graduated from the sculpture department of the Estonian Academy of Arts (1996), has participated in numerous exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad, and since 1994 has taken part in more than fifty workshops, symposia and competitions, working with wood, stone, concrete, snow and ice. Her works are held in many private and museum collections and in public space in Estonia, Germany, Austria, Turkey, Denmark, Latvia and Lithuania. Kuutma is a member of the Estonian Ceramists' Union, the Estonian Sculptors' Association and the Estonian Artists' Association.

artists.b: Loora Kaubi (1998) tööd uurivad une, isikliku ja kollektiivse mälu ning väsimuse.
artists.ben: Loora Kaubi's (1998) works explore sleep, personal and collective memory and fatigue.

artists.b: Dagne Aaremäe (s. 1996) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonna graafika erialal bakalauerusekraadiga. 2017. aasta augutis oli kunstnikul esimene isikunäitus „Splendid loneliness: Benita Labi” Tartu rahvusarhiivi hoones Noora. Lisaks on kunstnik osalenud erinevatel grupinäitustel.
artists.ben: Dagne Aaremäe (b. 1996) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Faculty of Fine Arts, with a bachelor's degree in graphic art. In August 2017 the artist had her first solo exhibition "Splendid loneliness: Benita Labi" in the building of the Tartu Noora National Archives. In addition, the artist has taken part in various group exhibitions.

artists.b: Laura Liventaal (snd 1988) on kunstnik ja režissöör, kes tegutseb põhiliselt skulptuuri, installatsiooni, performance’i, fotograafia, video ja dokumentaalfilmi vallas. Ta õppis 2007-2016 Tallinna Ülikoolis filosoofia bakalaureuse- ja magistriõppes, 2020 lõpetas Balti Filmi- ja Meediakooli eksperimentaalse lühidokumentaalfilmiga “Kuidas olla alasti”, mis esilinastus Pimedate Ööde Filmifestivalil Tallinnas. Alates 2021 õpib Eesti Kunstiakadeemias kaasaegse kunsti magistriõppes ning 2022-2023 täiendas end Pariisis ENSAD-i art-espace osakonnas. Liventaal on osalenud näitustel ja festivalidel Eestis, Soomes, Rootsis ja Prantsusmaal. Tema kesksed teemad on kehataju, taktiilsus, intiimsus ja naise roll kaasaegses komplekssuses, samuti käsitleb ta vaimse tervisega seotud probleeme psühhoanalüütilise prisma kaudu.
artists.ben: Laura Liventaal (b. 1988) is an artist and director who works mainly in the fields of sculpture, installation, performance, photography, video and documentary film. In 2007-2016 she studied philosophy at Tallinn University at Bachelor's and Master's level, and in 2020 she graduated from the Baltic Film and Media School with the experimental short documentary "Kuidas olla alasti" ("How to Be Naked"), which premiered at the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival. Since 2021 she has been studying in the Master's programme in contemporary art at the Estonian Academy of Arts, and in 2022-2023 she furthered her studies in the art-espace department of ENSAD in Paris. Liventaal has taken part in exhibitions and festivals in Estonia, Finland, Sweden and France. Her central themes are body awareness, tactility, intimacy and the role of women in contemporary complexity, and she also deals with issues related to mental health through a psychoanalytic prism.

artists.b: Pille Johanson (s. 1962 Pärnus) on maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tartus. Ta on lõpetanud Tartu Ülikooli maalikunsti eriala BA (2010) ja MA cum laude (2012) ning töötab Tartu Kõrgemas Kunstikoolis maali ja maalingute restaureerimise osakonnas osakonnajuhataja abi ja õppejõuna,.
artists.ben: Pille Johanson (b. 1962 in Pärnu) is a painter who lives and works in Tartu. She graduated from the University of Tartu with a BA (2010) and an MA cum laude (2012) in painting, and works at the Tartu Art College in the department of painting and mural restoration as assistant to the head of department and as a lecturer,.

artists.b: Nelly Drelli (s.1979 Tallinnas) looming paistab silma julge ja realistliku käsitluse ning figuraalkompositsioonide rohkuse poolest. Ta ei karda erinevate kunstistiilidega eksperimenteerida – nii võib tema maalide hulgast leida hüperrealistlikke linnavaateid, rahvusromantilisi pidulisi kui ka kõikvõimalikke teisi stiile, barokist klassitsismini. Sama mitmekülgne on kunstnik oma teemade valikult, tööde seas on ühtviisi nii värvikaid spordisündmusi, dramaatilisi stseene ajaloost, vallatuid akte, ilmekaid portreid ja loodusvaateid. Vormikäsitlus ja motiivide valikud vahelduvad, kuid põhitähelepanu all olev – harmoonilisena kujutatud inimesed – jäävad.
artists.ben: Nelly Drelli's (b. 1979 in Tallinn) work stands out for its bold and realistic treatment and abundance of figural compositions. She is not afraid to experiment with different art styles – so among her paintings one can find hyperrealistic cityscapes, national-romantic festive scenes, as well as all manner of other styles, from baroque to classicism. The artist is equally versatile in her choice of themes; her works include colourful sporting events, dramatic scenes from history, playful nudes, expressive portraits and landscapes in equal measure. The treatment of form and choice of motifs vary, but the main focus – people depicted harmoniously – remains.

artists.b: Õppinud Pelgulinna Gümnaasiumi kunsti süvaõppe koolis 1992 – 2006 ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemias etenduskunstid (lõpetamata) 2008 – … On läbinud bakalaureuse programmi täies mahus, lisaks osalenud enesearengu eesmärgil suures mahus teiste ülikoolide õppeprogrammides. Eesti Muusika- ja Teatriakadeemia kaheaastane õpe külalisüliõpilasena. Balti Filmi- ja Meediakooli kaheaastane täismahus õpe režii erialal külalisüliõpilasena. Central Saint Martins London kunstiülikooli ühe semestri õpe vahetusüliõpilasena.
artists.ben: Studied at the art specialisation school of Pelgulinna Gümnaasium 1992 - 2006 and performing arts at the Estonian Academy of Arts (unfinished) 2008 - ... Has completed the bachelor's programme in full, and in addition, for the purpose of self-development, has participated extensively in the study programmes of other universities. Two-year study at the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre as a guest student. Two-year full-time study in directing at the Baltic Film and Media School as a guest student. One-semester study at Central Saint Martins London art university as an exchange student.

artists.b: Tarmo Puudist (s 1968 Tallinnas) on vabakutseline kunstnik, viljelenud vabagraafikat ja kujundanud arvukalt raamatuid.
artists.ben: Tarmo Puudist (b. 1968 in Tallinn) is a freelance artist who has worked in printmaking and designed numerous books.

artists.b: LAURi käsitleb oma loomingus inimhinge valupunkte, manipuleerides ja nihestades reaalsust. LAURi on osalenud ühisnäitustel, viimati Haapsalus toimunud näitusel “Kui ma elust peaks ärkama” sai tema teos “100” meedia tähelepanu.
artists.ben: In his work LAURi deals with the pain points of the human soul, manipulating and dislocating reality. LAURi has taken part in group exhibitions, most recently at the exhibition "Kui ma elust peaks ärkama" held in Haapsalu, where his work "100" received media attention.

artists.b: Kristel on lõpetanud Toila Gümnaasiumi kunstikooli, võtnud Tartu Ülikoolis lisaainena maali reproduktsiooni. Armastab joonistada ja maalida inimesi, teeb katsetusi ka loomaportreedega. Joonistab iga päev ja katsetab enda jaoks uusi tehnikaid ja võimalusi. Maalimise kõrvalt käib Vanemuise teatris tööl, kus ametiks on ooperikoori laulja.
artists.ben: Kristel has graduated from the art school of Toila Gymnasium, and taken painting reproduction as an additional subject at the University of Tartu. She loves to draw and paint people, and also experiments with animal portraits. She draws every day and tries out new techniques and possibilities for herself. Alongside painting she works at the Vanemuine theatre, where her occupation is as a singer in the opera choir.

artists.b: Anna Lihodedova (s. 1989) lõpetas 2016. a. Eesti Kunstiakadeemia magistrikraadiga graafika erialal, olles eelnevalt omandanus sealsamas ka bakalaureusekraadi (2012). 2013-2015 osales ta Tallinna Ülikooli Noored Kooli programmis. Anna on alates 2009. a. osalenud arvukatel grupinäitustel nii Eestis kui ka Lätis, Soomes ja Venemaal ning 2011. a sai tema töid näha isikunäitusel “10:10“ Patarei Merekindluses.
artists.ben: Anna Lihodedova (b. 1989) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in graphic art, having previously earned her bachelor's degree there as well (2012). In 2013-2015 she took part in Tallinn University's Noored Kooli (Teach for Estonia) programme. Since 2009 Anna has taken part in numerous group exhibitions in Estonia as well as in Latvia, Finland and Russia, and in 2011 her works were on view at the solo exhibition "10:10" at the Patarei Sea Fortress.

artists.b: Eldar Jakubov (s. 1987 Tallinnas) on noor kunstnik, kes lõpetas 2015. a. Eesti Kunstiakadeemia installatsiooni ja skulptuuri eriala magistriõppe. Kunstnik oma loomingust: „Ma eemaldan mittetähtsad objektid ja kontsentreerin oma pilgu inimkehal, tema karakteril, meeleolul ja kõige pealt inimvahelistel suhetel. Mind huvitab ühiskond ning protsessid, mis panevad selle tööle ja illusioonid, mis annavad meile tunde, et me seda süsteemi mõistame. Iga sotsiaalset probleemi ja illusiooni, nii nagu ka füüsilist, on võimalik üksipulgi läbi arutada.“.
artists.ben: Eldar Jakubov (b. 1987 in Tallinn) is a young artist who graduated in 2015 with a master's degree in installation and sculpture from the Estonian Academy of Arts. The artist on his work: "I remove unimportant objects and concentrate my gaze on the human body, on its character, mood, and above all on relationships between people. I am interested in society and the processes that make it work, and the illusions that give us the feeling that we understand this system. Every social problem and illusion, as well as physical ones, can be discussed piece by piece."

artists.b: Olesya Mündi haridus ja looming on pidevalt seotud interdistsiplinaarsete otsingutega. Tal on hariduslikku ja töö kogemust kaunite kunstide, muuseumi pedagoogika ja konserveerimise valdkondades. See on andnud kunstnikule võimaluse tunda kunsti esinemist. Mündil on bakalaureusekraad kaunites kunstides Tartu Ülikoolist ning magistrikraad kunstipedagoogikas Eesti Kunstiakadeemiast. Hetkel õpib konserveerimist ja restaureerimist Peterburis Riiklikus I.Repini nimelises Kunstiakadeemias.
artists.ben: Olesya Münd's education and creative work are continuously connected with interdisciplinary pursuits. She has educational and work experience in the fields of fine arts, museum pedagogy and conservation. This has given the artist the opportunity to know the presence of art. Münd holds a bachelor's degree in fine arts from the University of Tartu and a master's degree in art pedagogy from the Estonian Academy of Arts. She is currently studying conservation and restoration in St. Petersburg at the Repin State Academy of Arts.

artists.b: Rein Tääker on lõpetanud Tallinna Pedagoogilise Instituudi (1992) joonistamise, joonestamise, tööõpetuse erialal. Teostes kasutab Tääker leidmaterjale, assamblaažina teostatud tööd mõjuvad ruumilistena.
artists.ben: Rein Tääker graduated from the Tallinn Pedagogical Institute (1992) in drawing, technical drawing, and craft studies. In his works Tääker uses found materials, works made as assemblages appear spatial.

artists.b: Metallikunstnik, lõpetanud ERKI 1986. Õppejõuna töötanud 1991-2015, sellest 18 aastat Dotsendi ametis. Põhiline materjal raud ja põhiline tehnoloogia sepis. Valminud on töid ehetest skulptuurideni. Näitustel esinenud suhteliselt vähe, põhirõhk on olnud tellimustöödel nii ajaloolises keskkonnas kui kaasaegse arhitektuuriga seonduvalt. Mõnel viimasel aastal on skulptuur varasemast rohkem huvi pakkunud, aga ka skulptorina pigem materjalikeskne kui ruumi organiseerimisele või vormiotsingutele keskendunud.
artists.ben: A metal artist, graduated from ERKI in 1986. Worked as a lecturer from 1991 to 2015, of which 18 years in the position of Associate Professor. His main material is iron and his main technology is forging. His works range from jewellery to sculptures. He has exhibited relatively rarely, the main emphasis having been on commissioned works, both in historical settings and in connection with contemporary architecture. In the last few years sculpture has interested him more than before, but as a sculptor too he is more material-focused than concerned with organising space or searching for form.

artists.b: Kaija Kesa (snd 1978) on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafikat ja interdistsiplinaarseid kunste, lõpetanud magistrikraadiga. Tema looming on enamasti inspireeritud loodusest ning ökoloogilis-eetilisest mõtteviisist. Graafika kui rikkalike tehniliste võimalustega kunstiliik on kunstniku peamine väljendusvahend. Töötab (alates 2009) graafika.ee stuudios, osaleb nii kohalikel kui rahvusvahelistel näitustel ja projektides (alates 2000). Viib läbi nii graafika kui joonistamise töötubasid ja kursuseid. On pälvinud Network Baltic noore graafiku laureaadi tiitli (2003). Kaija Kesa on Eesti Kunstnike Liidu ja Eesti Vabagraafikute Ühenduse liige. 2018. aasta lõppes graafikanäitusega “Tondi lood” Tallinnas Vabaduse galeriis ja 2019. aasta algas isiknäitusega Eesti Draamateatris.
artists.ben: Kaija Kesa (b. 1978) studied graphic art and interdisciplinary arts at the Estonian Academy of Arts, graduating with a master's degree. Her work is mostly inspired by nature and an ecological-ethical way of thinking. Printmaking, as an art form with rich technical possibilities, is the artist's main means of expression. She has worked (since 2009) at the graafika.ee studio, and participates in both local and international exhibitions and projects (since 2000). She conducts workshops and courses in both printmaking and drawing. She was awarded the title of Network Baltic Young Printmaker laureate (2003). Kaija Kesa is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Association of Independent Graphic Artists. The year 2018 ended with the print exhibition "Tondi lood" at Vabaduse Gallery in Tallinn, and 2019 began with a solo exhibition at the Estonian Drama Theatre.

artists.b: Mark Antonius Puhkan (s. 1994) on Eesti vabakutseline kunstnik, graafik, illustraator ja õppejõud. Ta on omandanud Graafika bakalaureusekraadi ja Kaasaegse kunsti magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias. Vaba loominguga on ta esinenud galeriides peamiselt joonistuste ja graafiliste tõmmiste meediumis nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. Illustraatorina on ta aktiivne nii ilukirjanduse, ajakirjanduse kui ka teadusliku illustratsiooni valdkonnas. On Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika ja joonistamise ainete õppejõud. Tema kunstnikupositsioonis on olulisel kohal inimeseks olemise jälgimine ning inimese ja metsiku looduse vaheliste füüsiliste ja vaimsete sildade taasloomine.
artists.ben: Mark Antonius Puhkan (b. 1994) is an Estonian freelance artist, graphic artist, illustrator and lecturer. He has obtained a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Art and a Master's degree in Contemporary Art from the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his free artistic practice he has exhibited in galleries mainly in the mediums of drawing and printmaking, both in Estonia and abroad. As an illustrator he is active in the fields of fiction, journalism and scientific illustration alike. He is a lecturer of graphic art and drawing subjects at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In his artistic position, an important place is held by the observation of being human and the recreation of physical and mental bridges between man and wild nature.

artists.b: Helen Prozes (1984) elab ja töötab Eestis ja Norras. Ta on lõpetanud Oslo Fotokunstikooli (Oslo Fotokunstskole). Enamasti kasutab ta meediumina analoogfotograafiat, tema tööde kontseptsiooniks on sageli aja, koha või vormi abstraktsioon. Fotode/visuaalmaastike loomine on kunstniku jaoks pidev protsess ja teekond, mis küsitleb meie taju ja kohalolekut.
artists.ben: Helen Prozes (1984) lives and works in Estonia and Norway. She has graduated from the Oslo School of Photography (Oslo Fotokunstskole). She mostly uses analogue photography as her medium; the concept of her works is often the abstraction of time, place or form. The creation of photographs/visual landscapes is, for the artist, a continuous process and journey that questions our perception and presence.

artists.b: Nele Tiidelepp(1998) on Eesti Kunstiakadeemia installatsiooni- ja skulptuuriosakonna lõpetanud multidistsiplinaarne kunstnik ja kirjanik, kelle kunstipraktika on ajendatud spontaansetest reaktsioonidest keskkonnale ja materjalidele. Teostes esineb tihti poeetilisi ja kirjanduslikke elemente ning narratiive. Tiidelepp tegutseb väljamõeldud ja reaalsete ruumide, inimeste ja hetkede piiril, kusjuures esineb tihti kollektiivsust, seda nii otseses kui kaudses mõttes: alates teiste inimeste juhuslike lausekatkete kasutamisest oma tekstides, lõpetades kollektiivselt loodud performance’itega, kus iga osaleja on võrdselt tähtis autor. Tema teosed paikneval teljel, mille kummaski otsas vastuolulise loomuga meediumid: skulptuur ja tekst. Neist esimene on staatiline, praktilise maailma poolt dikteeritud ja piiratud inimkeha võimete poolt. Teine aga igal hetkel kättesaadav, kiire, kerge, kaalutu ja piiratud vaid kujutlusvõimega. Kuskil seal vahepeal asuvad eri kontekstides avalduvad performatiivsed sekkumised, mis tihti sisaldavad teksti ning heli.
artists.ben: Nele Tiidelepp (1998) is a multidisciplinary artist and writer who graduated from the Department of Installation and Sculpture at the Estonian Academy of Arts, whose artistic practice is driven by spontaneous reactions to the environment and materials. Poetic and literary elements and narratives often appear in her works. Tiidelepp operates on the border of fictional and real spaces, people and moments, whereby collectivity often appears, both in a direct and an indirect sense: from the use of random fragments of sentences by other people in her texts, to collectively created performances in which every participant is an equally important author. Her works are located on an axis at either end of which stand media of contradictory nature: sculpture and text. The first of these is static, dictated by the practical world and limited by the capabilities of the human body. The second, however, is available at any moment, quick, light, weightless and limited only by the imagination. Somewhere in between are located performative interventions manifesting themselves in different contexts, which often contain text and sound.

artists.b: Evelyn Müürsepp (eku) on Kagu-Eestis elutsev kunstnik ja kultuurikoordinaator. Pärast Tartu Ülikooli maaliosakonna lõpetamist on toimetanud vabakutselise kunstnikuna. Olles külastanud Soomes ja Islandil loomemajasid inspireerituna sellest pani 2001.a  aluse Mooste KülalisStuudiole (MoKS).  MoKSi multifunktsionaalse eestvedajana (koordinaator, koristaja, finantside leidja, jne) on ta samal ajal jätkanud tegutsemist kunstnikuna, teinud koostöid performance ja helikunstnikega Eestist ja välismaalt.
artists.ben: Evelyn Müürsepp (eku) is an artist and cultural coordinator living in South-East Estonia. After graduating from the painting department of the University of Tartu, she has worked as a freelance artist. Having visited artists' residencies in Finland and Iceland, inspired by this, she founded the Mooste Guest Studio (MoKS) in 2001. As the multifunctional leader of MoKS (coordinator, cleaner, fundraiser, etc.), she has at the same time continued to work as an artist, collaborating with performance and sound artists from Estonia and abroad.

artists.b: Sven Grünberg on elektroonilise muusika teerajaja Eestis. On töötanud peamiselt stuudiomuusikuna, esitades enamasti oma loomingut ise – käsitsedes kõiki instrumente, lauldes, olles helirežissöör ja produtsent. Oma muusikutegevust alustas ta 1970ndate aastate algul klahvpillimängija ja lauljana ansamblites Mikronid ja Ornament, misjärel juhtis progressiivse roki ansamblit Mess (1974–1976), mis oli esimene omalaadne nii Eestis kui ka NSVLis.
artists.ben: Sven Grünberg is a pioneer of electronic music in Estonia. He has worked mainly as a studio musician, mostly performing his own works himself – handling all the instruments, singing, being the sound director and producer. He began his musical activity in the early 1970s as a keyboard player and singer in the bands Mikronid and Ornament, after which he led the progressive rock band Mess (1974–1976), which was the first of its kind both in Estonia and in the USSR.

artists.b: Katrin Kabun (s.1966) on tekstiilidisainer, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Tallinna Ülikooli Haapsalu Kolledži BA (2013, cum laude) ja Eesti Kunstiakadeemia MA (2017, cum laude) ning jätkab õpinguid Eesti Kunstiakadeemias doktoriõppel. Magistritöö eest pälvis Katrin EKA Noore Tarbekunstniku preemia ja EKA rakenduslike teadus- ja arendustööde konkursi preemia ühiskondlikku heaolu ja/või elukeskkonda parendava töö katergoorias. Oma disainiuurimuses tegeleb Katrin lambavilla kui väärtusliku taastuva ressursi rakendusküsimustega kaasaeges tootedisainis. Uurimustöö aluse moodustab teatav näiline vastandumine – lambavilla kui arhailise materjali omaduste ülekandmine tänapäeva disaini keelde, disaini kaudu vahendite otsimine villa emotsianaalsete ja esteetiliste väärtuste rakendamiseks ja aktuaalsena hoidmiseks tänapäeva jätkusuutliku disaini ja elukeskkonna kontekstis.
artists.ben: Katrin Kabun (b. 1966) is a textile designer who lives and works in Tallinn. She graduated from Tallinn University Haapsalu College with a BA (2013, cum laude) and from the Estonian Academy of Arts with an MA (2017, cum laude), and continues her studies as a doctoral student at the Estonian Academy of Arts. For her master's thesis Katrin received the EKA Young Applied Artist Award and the award of the EKA competition for applied research and development works in the category of works improving societal well-being and/or the living environment. In her design research Katrin deals with questions of applying sheep's wool, as a valuable renewable resource, in contemporary product design. Her research is based on a certain apparent opposition — transferring the properties of sheep's wool, as an archaic material, into the language of contemporary design, and seeking, through design, means of applying the emotional and aesthetic values of wool and keeping them relevant in the context of today's sustainable design and living environment.

artists.b: Liisi Tani (s. 1988) on õppinud Tartu Kõrgem Kunstikooli maali ja seinamaalingute restaureerimise erialal (2008-2012). Aktiivset näitustel osalemist alustas ta juba õpingute ajal ja on oma taieseid eksponeerinud mitmetel näitustel nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. Tani on entusiastlik maalija, kes teostab end peamiselt õli- ja akvarellmaalis ning segatehnikas. Peamiselt viljeleb ta figuraalset kompositsiooni õlitehnikas ja abtrsaktset käsitlust akvarellis. Avastaja hing paneb teda pidevalt proovile ja kutsub esile uusi väljakutseid. Tani on Eesti Akvarellistide Ühenduse liige.
artists.ben: Liisi Tani (b. 1988) has studied painting and mural restoration at the Tartu Art College (2008-2012). She began actively participating in exhibitions already during her studies and has exhibited her works at numerous exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad. Tani is an enthusiastic painter who mainly expresses herself in oil and watercolour painting and mixed media. She mainly cultivates figurative composition in oil technique and abstract treatment in watercolour. Her explorer's spirit constantly puts her to the test and invites new challenges. Tani is a member of the Estonian Watercolourists' Association.

artists.b: Denisa Štefanigová (b. 1995) is fresh graduates of the Estonian Academy of Arts in the Contemporary Art Department. With her last project, the Master thesis titled “Violet, show me how tender you can be? (Shades of Love & Desire & Infidelity & Truth)” she reflected on the topic of the sexual life of colors, of brushstrokes, through paintings, videos, puppets – a topic she keeps researching and working on. She previously graduated with a Bachelor degree from the University of Technology, Faculty of Fine Arts (FaVU) in Brno Czechia in 2019. Denisa has also studied in Facultad de Bellas Artes in Bilbao in 2017, and has been on artistic residency in Stuttgart in GEDOK Gallery on 2018. She is currently attending the Artist Residency Programme at Easttopics in Budapest, Hungary.
artists.ben: Denisa Štefanigová (b. 1995) is fresh graduates of the Estonian Academy of Arts in the Contemporary Art Department. With her last project, the Master thesis titled “Violet, show me how tender you can be? (Shades of Love & Desire & Infidelity & Truth)” she reflected on the topic of the sexual life of colors, of brushstrokes, through paintings, videos, puppets – a topic she keeps researching and working on. She previously graduated with a Bachelor degree from the University of Technology, Faculty of Fine Arts (FaVU) in Brno Czechia in 2019. Denisa has also studied in Facultad de Bellas Artes in Bilbao in 2017, and has been on artistic residency in Stuttgart in GEDOK Gallery on 2018. She is currently attending the Artist Residency Programme at Easttopics in Budapest, Hungary.

artists.b: Rao Heidmets (s. 1956 Pärnus) lõpetas 1981. a. Tallinna Tehnikaülikooli elektroenergeetika teaduskonna. Ülikoolipäevil osales Kunstiinstituudi rühmituses “PÄRATRUST FILM”
artists.ben: Rao Heidmets (b. 1956 in Pärnu) graduated in 1981 from the Faculty of Electrical Power Engineering of Tallinn Technical University. During his university years he took part in the Art Institute group "PÄRATRUST FILM"

artists.b: Viktor Gurov (s. 1989) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia graafilise disaini osakonna 2014. aastal bakalaureusekraadiga ja vabade kunstide teaduskonna (fotograafia) 2018. aastal magristrikraadiga (cum laude). Ta on vahetusüliõpilasena õppinud Aalto Ülikoolis Helsingis. Alates 2012. aastast on Gurov töötanud vabakutselise graafilise disainerina. Ta kujundab näituseid ning näituste katalooge. Aeg-ajalt õpetab Viktor Gurov Kunstiakadeemias külalisõppejõuna. 2018. aastal alustas ta tööd Eesti Rahvusraamatukogu näitusteosakonna graafilise disainerina. Gurov on osalenud rühmanäitustel nii Eestis kui ka välismaal, ta on kunstnike rühmituse Neandertali Koobaskooli liige, MTÜ Uus Materjal (kunstiprojekt-ajakiri) kolleegiumis ning grafitirühmituse ja tänavariiete brändi Multistab asutaja.
artists.ben: Viktor Gurov (b. 1989) graduated from the graphic design department of the Estonian Academy of Arts with a bachelor's degree in 2014 and from the Faculty of Fine Arts (photography) with a master's degree (cum laude) in 2018. He studied as an exchange student at Aalto University in Helsinki. Since 2012 Gurov has worked as a freelance graphic designer. He designs exhibitions and exhibition catalogues. Viktor Gurov occasionally teaches as a guest lecturer at the Academy of Arts. In 2018 he began working as a graphic designer in the exhibitions department of the National Library of Estonia. Gurov has participated in group exhibitions both in Estonia and abroad; he is a member of the artists' group Neandertali Koobaskool, on the board of the NGO Uus Materjal (an art project-magazine), and a founder of the graffiti group and streetwear brand Multistab.

artists.b: Ann Mirjam Vaikla (1990) on Eesti kunstnik, stsenograaf ja kuraator. Õppinud Norra Teatriakadeemias stsenograafiat ja omandanud 2020. aastal magistrikraadi kunsti ja kultuuri erialal Novia Rakendusteaduste Ülikoolis Soomes. Osaleb Triangle Arts Associationi residentuuriprogrammis New Yorgis. Tema teoseid eksponeeriti 2020. aastal Kai Kunstikeskuses VII Artishoki biennaalil ja Black Boxi teatris Oslos.
artists.ben: Ann Mirjam Vaikla (1990) is an Estonian artist, scenographer and curator. She studied scenography at the Norwegian Theatre Academy and in 2020 earned a master's degree in art and culture at the Novia University of Applied Sciences in Finland. She takes part in the Triangle Arts Association's residency programme in New York. Her works were exhibited in 2020 at the VII Artishok Biennial at the Kai Art Centre and at the Black Box theatre in Oslo.

artists.b: Anu Lehis (s. 1993) on kunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali eriala bakalaureuseõppe (2017) ning hetkel õpib Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maalikunsti eriala magistrantuuris. Lisaks on ta viibinud välisõpingutel Haagi Kuninglikus Kunstiakadeemias (Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten, Den Haag) vabade kunstide erialal (2015-2016). Anu on osalenud näitustel alates 2014. aastast.
artists.ben: Anu Lehis (b. 1993) is an artist who lives and works in Tallinn. She has completed the bachelor's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts (2017) and is currently studying in the master's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In addition, she has studied abroad at the Royal Academy of Art in The Hague (Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten, Den Haag) in the fine arts speciality (2015-2016). Anu has participated in exhibitions since 2014.

artists.b: Tiiu Lausmaa (s. 1989) on Tallinnas elav kunstnik ja illustraator kes on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia 2018 aastal bakalaureusekraadiga vabade kunstide õppetoolis. Tema peamised meediumid on maalimine ja joonistamine. Tema tööd hõlmavad laia huvide sfääri, nagu näiteks inimese ja mitteinimestest loomade ning looduse omavaheline suhe, keskkonnaprobleemid ning masstootmise ja informatsiooniajastu mõju inimmeelele. Suur osa tema elu-ja tööfilosoofiast on inspireeritud taoistlikest tekstidest, mida ta on varasemate õpingute jooksul uurinud. Tema viimane isikunäitus toimus Staapli 3 galeriis 2020 aasta juunis.
artists.ben: Tiiu Lausmaa (b. 1989) is an artist and illustrator living in Tallinn who graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2018 with a bachelor's degree from the Department of Fine Arts. Her main media are painting and drawing. Her works cover a wide range of interests, such as the relationship between humans and non-human animals and nature, environmental problems, and the effects of mass production and the information age on the human mind. A large part of her life and work philosophy is inspired by Taoist texts, which she studied during her earlier studies. Her most recent solo exhibition took place at Staapli 3 gallery in June 2020.

artists.b: Silvi Lepparu (sünd 1962) on lõpetanud EKA maali eriala 1990. Näitustel osalenud alates 1985. Viljeleb abstraktset akrüülmaali, monotüüpiat ja portreed. Viimased isikunäitused toimusid 2017.aastal Jõhvi Linnagaleriis ja Kuressaare Raegaleriis.
artists.ben: Silvi Lepparu (b. 1962) graduated in painting from EKA in 1990. She has taken part in exhibitions since 1985. She practices abstract acrylic painting, monotype and portraiture. Her most recent solo exhibitions took place in 2017 at the Jõhvi Linnagalerii and the Kuressaare Raegalerii.

artists.b: Emilia Furs õpib hetkel Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal (BA). Enda loomingus töötab kõige rohkem graafika tehnikaga ja digitaalse meediaga, tihti neid kombineerides, uurides nende meediumite eripärasi ja võimalusi.
artists.ben: Emilia Furs is currently studying printmaking (BA) at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In her work she mostly employs printmaking techniques and digital media, often combining them, exploring the particularities and possibilities of these media.

artists.b: Hanna Samoson (s.1987) on õppinud foto- ja videokunsti Nõmme Fotoklubis, Balti Filmi- ja Meediakoolis, Eesti Kunstiakadeemias ja isesesisvalt.
artists.ben: Hanna Samoson (b. 1987) has studied photo and video art at the Nõmme Photo Club, the Baltic Film and Media School, the Estonian Academy of Arts, and independently.

artists.b: Alissa Nirgi (s. 1993) on foto- ja videokunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas, õppides praegu Eesti Kunstiakadeemia vabade kunstide teaduskonnas fotograafia bakalaureuseõppe viimasel kursusel. Nirgi esimene isiknäitus “Uus maa minu akna taga” EKA Galeriis toimus 2015. aastal ning rändas sealt Helsingisse Kallio galeriisse. Antud projekt osaleb 2016 aprillis Riia Fotograafia Biennaalil. Nirgi pälvis 2015. aastal Eduard Wiiralti nimelise stipendiumi. Hetkel valmistub ta ü̈hisnäituseks Haapsalu Linnagaleriis.
artists.ben: Alissa Nirgi (b. 1993) is a photo and video artist who lives and works in Tallinn, currently studying in the final year of the bachelor's programme in photography at the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts. Nirgi's first solo exhibition "Uus maa minu akna taga" was held at the EKA Gallery in 2015, and travelled from there to the Kallio gallery in Helsinki. This project participates in the Riga Photography Biennial in April 2016. Nirgi was awarded the Eduard Wiiralt scholarship in 2015. She is currently preparing for a joint exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii.

artists.b: Kadi-Maarja Võsu (s. 1992 Jõgeval) on noor kunstnik, kelle tegevusvaldkonnaks on peamiselt installatsioonikunst, kuid ta kaasab oma loomingusse ka maale, videokunsti, fotograafiat, performance-it, lisaks ka luulet ning teisi tekstipõhiseid projekte ja muusikat. Omades selget visiooni sellest, mida tahab teha, ei piiritle ta end vaid ühe meediumiga.
artists.ben: Kadi-Maarja Võsu (b. 1992 in Jõgeva) is a young artist whose field of activity is mainly installation art, but she also incorporates painting, video art, photography, performance, as well as poetry and other text-based projects and music into her work. Having a clear vision of what she wants to do, she does not limit herself to just one medium.

artists.b: Anne Rudanovski on Eesti skulptor ja kunstiõppejõud, kes on hariduse omandanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias 1984–1990. Tema loomingut iseloomustab süvenemine inimtekkelise materjali paberi kui kultuuri sümbolisse. 2019. aastal viibis pooleaastasel ümbermaailmareisil, et dokumenteerida ja uurida kadumisohus käsitsi paberivalmistamist traditsioonilistes „pabeririikides” nagu näiteks Hiina, Jaapan, Korea. Viimastel aastatel on Anne Rudanovskil sündinud raamatu formaadi tähendusi uurivate ja küsimusi püstitavate näituste seeria. Esimene väljapanek „Hinnatud ja hüljatud raamatud I. Varamu“, kus fookuses oli teatmeteoste saatus, toimus 2017 Kondase keskuses. Järgnesid „HH II. Aja kadumine“ (2018), „HH III. Unustamise vajadus“ (2018) ja „HH IV. Lugemine I-II“ (2021). Tema teoste mõtestatud materjalikäsitlus ning meisterlikkus tõukub (seondub) Idamaisest mõttelaadist. Professor Kõrgema Kunstikooli Pallas skulptuuriosakonnas alates aastast 2014. Paberimuuseumi asutaja 2010. Guinnessi rekordi omanik, koos üliõpilastega valmis maailma suurim kasutatud patareidest mosaiik, 2017. Eesti Origami Keskus SATORI asutaja 2020.
artists.ben: Anne Rudanovski is an Estonian sculptor and art lecturer who received her education at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 1984–1990. Her work is characterised by an engagement with paper, a man-made material, as a symbol of culture. In 2019, she went on a six-month round-the-world trip to document and study endangered handmade paper-making traditions in traditional “paper countries” such as China, Japan and Korea. In recent years, Anne Rudanovski has created a series of exhibitions that explore and raise questions about the meaning of the book format. The first exhibition, “Valued and Abandoned Books I. Repository”, which focused on the fate of reference works, took place in 2017 at the Kondas Centre. It was followed by “HH II. The Disappearance of Time” (2018), “HH III. The Need to Forget” (2018) and “HH IV. Reading I–II” (2021). Her thoughtful treatment of materials and mastery stem from (are connected to) Eastern modes of thought. She has been professor at the sculpture department of the Pallas University of Applied Sciences since 2014. Founder of the Paper Museum in 2010. Holder of a Guinness World Record: together with her students she created the world's largest mosaic made of used batteries, 2017. Founder of the Estonian Origami Centre SATORI, 2020.

artists.b: Erki Kannus lõpetas ERKI 1981 aastal klaasikunsti erialal. Näitustel esinenud juba 1976. aastast. Loonud mitmeid monumentaalikunsti teoseid avalikku ruumi. Aastatel 1989-2000 resideerunud Saksamaal,USAs ja Rootsis. 2000. aastast aktiivselt osalenud Eesti kunstis nii isik- kui ka grupinäitustel, samuti näitustel Lätis, Leedus, Rootsis, Poolas, Ukrainas, Prantsusmaal, Bulgaarias. Loomingus ühendab erinevaid tehnikaid(maal, graafika, skulptuur) ja materjale(klaas, puit, metall) ning heli ja videot.
artists.ben: Erki Kannus graduated from ERKI in 1981 in the field of glass art. He has been exhibiting since 1976. He has created several works of monumental art for public spaces. From 1989 to 2000 he resided in Germany, the USA and Sweden. Since 2000 he has actively participated in Estonian art, both in solo and group exhibitions, as well as exhibitions in Latvia, Lithuania, Sweden, Poland, Ukraine, France and Bulgaria. In his work he combines various techniques (painting, printmaking, sculpture) and materials (glass, wood, metal) with sound and video.

artists.b: Karl Joonas Alamaa on rätsepa taustaga kunstnik ja moelooja, kes on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias moodi ja kostüümikunsti Antwerpeni Kuninglikus Kunstiakadeemias. Ta on Eduard Wiiralti preemia laureaat, Hõbenõel 2021 nominent, osalenud multimeedia teosega ONLY BASIC ja autorikollektsioonidega Tallinn Fashion Weekil. 2022. aasta suvel oli Alamaal näitus HOP galeriis, Tallinnas. Ühtlasi on Alamaa oma töid esitlenud ERKI moeshowl. Lisaks on ta esinenud performance’itega Zuidpooli teatris Antwerpenis, Sõltumatu Tantsu Laval ning koos Lisette Sivardiga korraldanud aktsiooni hiiglasliku Vikerkaare lipuga Tallinnas Teatri väljakul. Tema tööd on olnud näitustel nii Eestis, Soomes kui ka Belgias. Alamaa looming kätkeb endas inimeseks olemise argisust ja ühiskondlike konstruktsioonide lahkamist ning vaidlustamist, tegeledes sh soo, moe ja keha omavaheliste suhetega. Oma loomingus tegeleb Alamaa mitmete meediumitega, installatsioonist ja performance’ist kuni kostüümide ja kollektsioonide loomiseni, interpreteerides neid läbi moe. Tihti on talle omane läheneda teemadele läbi lähiajaloo tundlike ja vastuoluliste punktide, puudutades nendega Eesti ja Ida-Euroopa mineviku kompleksidest ja.
artists.ben: Karl Joonas Alamaa is an artist and fashion designer with a background as a tailor, who has studied fashion and costume design at the Estonian Academy of Arts and at the Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp. He is a laureate of the Eduard Wiiralt Prize, a nominee for Hõbenõel 2021, has participated with the multimedia work ONLY BASIC and with author collections at Tallinn Fashion Week. In the summer of 2022 Alamaa had an exhibition at HOP gallery, Tallinn. Alamaa has also presented his work at the ERKI fashion show. In addition, he has performed with performances at the Zuidpool theatre in Antwerp, at the Sõltumatu Tantsu Laud, and together with Lisette Sivard organized an action with a giant Rainbow flag at Teatri väljak in Tallinn. His works have been shown at exhibitions in Estonia, Finland and Belgium. Alamaa's work encompasses the everydayness of being human and the dissection and questioning of social constructs, dealing among other things with the relationships between gender, fashion and the body. In his work Alamaa deals with several mediums, from installation and performance to the creation of costumes and collections, interpreting them through fashion. He often tends to approach topics through sensitive and contradictory points of recent history, thereby touching on the complexes of Estonia's and Eastern Europe's past and.

artists.b: Henrik Rakitin (s. 1993) on multidistsiplinaarne kunstnik, kelle looming on tihedalt seotud kaasaegse kapitalistliku kultuuri vaatluse ja kommentaariga, seda kultuuri kirjeldades ja sellega mängides. Ta ise kasutab enda loodud teoseid vaadeldes tihti “Stockholmi sündroomi” mõistet – esmalt hakkab mõnus ja suhkur stimuleerib aju, teisalt lisandub agooniline aspekt, vangistus ja nihilism, mille tulemiks võib olla tähenduste ja ideede kompulsiivne üledoos.
artists.ben: Henrik Rakitin (b. 1993) is a multidisciplinary artist whose work is closely tied to the observation of and commentary on contemporary capitalist culture, describing this culture and playing with it. When viewing his own created works, he himself often uses the concept of the "Stockholm syndrome" – at first it feels pleasant and the sugar stimulates the brain, but on the other hand an agonising aspect is added, imprisonment and nihilism, which can result in a compulsive overdose of meanings and ideas.

artists.b: Joanna Hoffmann (s. 1990) lõpetas 2016. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemia maali eriala magistriõppe, olles eelnevalt omandanud sealsamas bakalaureusekraadi tekstiilidisaini valdkonnas. Hoffmann töötab Tartu Kunstimuuseumis näituste osakonna juhatajana, tegutseb kuraatori ning kunstikriitikuna.
artists.ben: Joanna Hoffmann (b. 1990) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in painting, having previously obtained a bachelor's degree there in textile design. Hoffmann works at the Tartu Art Museum as head of the exhibitions department and works as a curator and art critic.

artists.b: Art ja Helena ehk Helena Keskküla ja Art Nõukas (mõlemad sündinud 1992 Kuressaares) on õppinud Eesti Kunstiakadeemias skulptuuri ja installatsiooni osakonnas. Koos töötavad nad alates 2015 aastast.
artists.ben: Art ja Helena, i.e. Helena Keskküla and Art Nõukas (both born 1992 in Kuressaare) have studied in the Department of Sculpture and Installation at the Estonian Academy of Arts. They have been working together since 2015.

artists.b: Alina Orav (sünd. 1989 Tallinnas) on Eestist pärit maali- ja maalinstallatsioonikunstnik kes elab ja töötab Eestis ning Kanadas. Ta on Eesti Kunstnike ja Eesti Maalikunstnike Liidu liige. Omandanud maali erialal magistrikraadi Eesti Kunstiakadeemias 2017. aastal, on Alina ennast täiendanud ka vahetusõpingutel Firenzes (2011-2012 ABAF ülikoolis, IT) ja Vancouveris (2015 ECUAD ülikoolis, CA) ning kunstipraktikatel Londonis (UK), Amsterdamis (NL) ning Voldas (NO). Kunstnik on teinud kokku üle 20 isikunäituse: Eestis, Vancouveris (CA), Helsinkis (FI), Isafjörduris (IS) ning osalenud grupinäitustel Brandes (DK), Berliinis (DE), Firenzes (IT), Helsinkis (FI), Moskvas (RU), Stockholmis (SE), Vancouveris (CA), Watfordis (UK), Venice’is (USA) Jaapanis ja Eestis. Ta on kureerinud grupinäituseid Vancouveris (CA, 2015) ja Helsinkis (FI, 2018).
artists.ben: Alina Orav (b. 1989 in Tallinn) is a painting and painting-installation artist from Estonia who lives and works in Estonia and Canada. She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Painters' Association. She obtained a master's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2017, and Alina has also furthered her studies on exchange programmes in Florence (2011–2012 at ABAF University, IT) and Vancouver (2015 at ECUAD University, CA) as well as in art practices in London (UK), Amsterdam (NL) and Volda (NO). The artist has held over 20 solo exhibitions in total: in Estonia, Vancouver (CA), Helsinki (FI), Ísafjörður (IS), and has taken part in group exhibitions in Brande (DK), Berlin (DE), Florence (IT), Helsinki (FI), Moscow (RU), Stockholm (SE), Vancouver (CA), Watford (UK), Venice (USA), Japan and Estonia. She has curated group exhibitions in Vancouver (CA, 2015) and Helsinki (FI, 2018).

artists.b: Anna Kaarma graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in graphic design and contemporary art. Her most used media are spatial installation, photography and video, book design and graphic design. Through her personal experience, Kaarma explores the Lasnamäe district in Tallinn, highlighting its different layers of meaning.
artists.ben: Anna Kaarma graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in graphic design and contemporary art. Her most used media are spatial installation, photography and video, book design and graphic design. Through her personal experience, Kaarma explores the Lasnamäe district in Tallinn, highlighting its different layers of meaning.

artists.b: Paavo Käämbre (s. 1984) on maalikunstnik, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Tartu Kõrgema Kunstikooli maali ja maalingute restaureerimise erialal (2010) ja kaitsnud magistrikraadi Tartu Ülikoolis maalikunsti erialal (2012). Alates 2012. aastast töötab Käämbre Eesti Päevalehes. Tal on olnud isikunäitused Draakoni galeriis („Jäänud“, 2014), Pärnu Linnagaleriis („Sõnad on tuhk mu suus“, 2013), Tartu Teaduspargis („Tähtvere“, 2012) ja Aatriumi galeriis („Mustamäe“, 2012). Samuti on Käämbre osalenud arvukatel rühmanäitustel, näiteks “ ”Noor Eesti Kunst” Estnische Kunst zu Gast in Fürtsnewalde” Saksamaal Fürtsnewaldes (2015) ja Young Painter Price finalistide näitusel Vilniuse kaasaegse kunsti keskuses (2013). Peamiselt viljeleb Käämbre ekspressiivset abstraktset maalistiili.
artists.ben: Paavo Käämbre (b. 1984) is a painter who lives and works in Tallinn. He graduated from the Tartu Art College in painting and the restoration of murals (2010) and defended his master's degree in painting at the University of Tartu (2012). Since 2012 Käämbre has worked at Eesti Päevaleht. He has had solo exhibitions at Draakoni Gallery ("Jäänud", 2014), the Pärnu Town Gallery ("Sõnad on tuhk mu suus", 2013), the Tartu Science Park ("Tähtvere", 2012), and the Aatrium Gallery ("Mustamäe", 2012). Käämbre has also participated in numerous group exhibitions, such as "Noor Eesti Kunst" "Estnische Kunst zu Gast in Fürtsnewalde" in Fürstenwalde, Germany (2015), and the exhibition of Young Painter Price finalists at the Contemporary Art Centre in Vilnius (2013). Käämbre mainly cultivates an expressive abstract painting style.

artists.b: Hando Tamm (s. 1980) lõpetas Tartu Ülikooli maaliosakonna 2004. aastal. Tamm alustas näitustel esinemist 1999. aastal, esimene isikunäitus toimus 2000. aastal Tartus Sebra galeriis. Juba õpingute ajal alustas ta tegevust performance`i kunstnikuna, esinedes siis ja hiljem nii rühmitustes kui sooloesinejana. Maaliloomingut iseloomustab ekspressiivne, kuid tundlik värvikäsitlus nii figuratiivses kui abstraktses vormis. Iseloomulik on humoorikas või ka kergelt irooniline lähenemine valitud objektidele. Tartu Kunstnike Liidu liige alates 2013. Maalikunstnikuna on Tammel seni olnud 12 isiknäitust ning ta on osa võtnud arvukatest ühisnäitustest nii Eestis kui mujal.
artists.ben: Hando Tamm (b. 1980) graduated from the painting department of the University of Tartu in 2004. Tamm began exhibiting in 1999, his first solo exhibition took place in 2000 in Tartu at the Sebra gallery. Already during his studies he began working as a performance artist, appearing then and later both in groups and as a solo performer. His painting is characterised by an expressive yet sensitive treatment of colour, in both figurative and abstract forms. Characteristic is a humorous or slightly ironic approach to chosen objects. Member of the Tartu Artists' Union since 2013. As a painter Tamm has so far had 12 solo exhibitions and has taken part in numerous joint exhibitions both in Estonia and elsewhere.

artists.b: Indrek Aavik s. 1990, Tartus. Õppinud TÜ Maaliosakonnas (BA), Eesti Kunstiakadeemias (MA) ning Porto Ülikoolis, Portugalis. Osalenud mitmetel näitustel üle Eesti.
artists.ben: Indrek Aavik b. 1990, in Tartu. Studied in the Painting Department of the University of Tartu (BA), the Estonian Academy of Arts (MA) and the University of Porto, Portugal. Has participated in several exhibitions across Estonia.

artists.b: Sohvi Viik (s. 1991) lõpetas 2016. a. Eesti Kunstiakadeemia magistrikraadiga skulptuuri ja installatsiooni erialal. Varasemad õpingud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia fotograafia oskaonnas andsid tugeva aluse kaasaegse kunsti ja fotografia vallas, vahetusõpingud Norras, Bergeni kunstiülikoolis 2013. lisasid sügavama kokkupuute videoprojektsiooni ning heli ja ruumi teemadega. Sohvi Viik on osalenud mitmetel ühisnäitustel ning korraldanud ka kaks isiknäitust. Peamisteks meediumiteks on video, foto, heli ja installatsioon. Inspiratsiooni kunstis pakuvad Janet Cardiffi ja George Bures Milleri teosed.
artists.ben: Sohvi Viik (b. 1991) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in sculpture and installation. Earlier studies in the photography department of the Estonian Academy of Arts gave her a strong foundation in contemporary art and photography, and an exchange period in 2013 at the Bergen Academy of Art and Design in Norway added a deeper engagement with the themes of video projection, sound and space. Sohvi Viik has taken part in numerous joint exhibitions and has also organised two solo exhibitions. Her main media are video, photo, sound and installation. She finds inspiration in art from the works of Janet Cardiff and George Bures Miller.

artists.b: Allan Roosileht on legendaarne Eesti muusik, diskor ja melomaan, kelle üheks hobiks on helisalvestiste kollektsioneerimine. Lisaks muusikaarmastusele on Allan ka suur kunstihuviline. “Arvan, et minu esimene kunstihuvi seostub minu emaga. Ema ostis ja kinkis kunsti lähedastele ning ilmselt just tema soovitusel sain oma esimese suure kunstielamuse Kunstihoone näitusel „Ruum ja vorm“ 1976. aastal. Sealtpeale olen olnud kunstiga sina peal. Kõrgkooli ajal oli mul au osa saada Kaalu Kirme võrratutest kunstiajaloo loengutest. Need imeliselt soojad ja põnevad õpetussõnad aitasid kunstiilmas toimuvast laiemat pilti luua. Oma suureks lemmikuks ja innustajaks olen pidanud Leonhard Lapinit, sealtkaudu ka Kandinskyt. Muusika, eriti pop- ja rockmuusika on olnud alati seoses kunstiga. Salvador Dali lõi kampa Alice Cooperiga, Andy Warhol „Rolling Stonesiga“. „Metsatöllu“ plaate on kujundanud Jüri Arrak ja Kalev Mark Kostabi on teinud kõrvalepõikeid muusikasse. Maailmas on rida kunstnikke ja disainereid, kelle loomingut tuntaksegi heliplaadikaante järgi,” räägib Allan Roosileht.
artists.ben: Allan Roosileht is a legendary Estonian musician, DJ and music lover, one of whose hobbies is collecting sound recordings. In addition to his love of music, Allan is also a great enthusiast of art. "I think my first interest in art is connected with my mother. My mother bought and gave art to loved ones, and it was probably on her recommendation that I had my first great art experience at the Kunstihoone exhibition "Ruum ja vorm" ("Space and Form") in 1976. Since then I have been on familiar terms with art. During my time at university I had the honour of attending Kaalu Kirme's wonderful lectures on art history. Those wonderfully warm and exciting teachings helped me form a broader picture of what was happening in the art world. I have considered Leonhard Lapin my great favourite and inspiration, and through him also Kandinsky. Music, especially pop and rock music, has always been connected with art. Salvador Dalí teamed up with Alice Cooper, Andy Warhol with "The Rolling Stones". Jüri Arrak has designed the album covers of "Metsatöll", and Kalev Mark Kostabi has made forays into music. In the world there is a range of artists and designers whose work is known precisely through record covers," says Allan Roosileht.

artists.b: Maxim Mjödov (1983) on Tallinna fotokunstnik. Lummatuna emulsioonil põhinevast analoogfotograafiast pühendus ta 2003. aastal sellega katsetamisele – otsides narratiivseid ja poeetilisi vorme, võimalusi teadmiste kogumiseks ning teda huvitavate teemade analüüsimiseks. Ta käsitleb inimsuhteid tänapäeva ühiskonnas, maastike muutumist ja mõjujõudu, aja tajumist.
artists.ben: Maxim Mjödov (1983) is a Tallinn-based photographic artist. Fascinated by emulsion-based analogue photography, he dedicated himself in 2003 to experimenting with it – seeking narrative and poetic forms, opportunities for gathering knowledge and analysing topics that interest him. He addresses human relationships in contemporary society, the transformation and influence of landscapes, and the perception of time.

artists.b: Keiu Koppel (sünd 1988) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia Ehte- ja sepakunsti eriala (BA) ning on täiendanud ennast ka Barcelona disainikoolis Escola Massana. Keiu Koppeli väljendusvahendiks on metall, kuid oma ehetes kasutab ta veel tervet rida muid materjale, klassikalistest fassettlihviga kalliskividest kuni arvuti emaplaatideni välja. Koppeli töödes väljenduvad tuleviku utoopiad, füüsilise, vaimse ja virtuaalse reaalsuse sõlmpunktid ning inimese koht nendes. 2017. aastal toimus tema seni suurim isikunäitus ‘Lost in Details’ Berliinis galeriis Trofejas ning 2018. aastal sama näitus ka Tallinnas HOP galeriis. ‘Lost in Details’ vaatleb nii väikseid kui ka suuri objekte ja isegi terveid maailmu kui analoogiaid ja mustreid, mis moodustavad kaosest korrapärase ja loogilise terviku.
artists.ben: Keiu Koppel (b. 1988) has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in Jewellery and Blacksmithing (BA) and has also furthered her studies at the Escola Massana design school in Barcelona. Keiu Koppel's medium of expression is metal, but in her jewellery she also uses a whole range of other materials, from classic facet-cut precious stones to computer motherboards. Koppel's works express utopias of the future, the nodal points of physical, spiritual and virtual reality, and the place of the human being within them. In 2017 her largest solo exhibition to date, 'Lost in Details', took place at the Trofeja gallery in Berlin, and in 2018 the same exhibition was shown at the HOP gallery in Tallinn. 'Lost in Details' looks at both small and large objects, and even entire worlds, as analogies and patterns that form an orderly and logical whole out of chaos.

artists.b: Olesja Semenkova (1992) lives and works in Tallinn, Estonia. Her works were exhibited in Tallinn, Estonia and in Brussels, Belgium. Olesja experiments with and includes different mediums into one artwork. Her practice can also be called installation art as she enjoys questioning and playing with the spectator’s role in the exhibition space. Finished Tallinn University in 2015 as Bachelor of Arts in Humanities, from 2017 studying in Estonian Academy of Arts, Contemporary Arts, MA, improved her skills at LUCA school of Arts, Fine Art department, Brussels.
artists.ben: Olesja Semenkova (1992) lives and works in Tallinn, Estonia. Her works were exhibited in Tallinn, Estonia and in Brussels, Belgium. Olesja experiments with and includes different mediums into one artwork. Her practice can also be called installation art as she enjoys questioning and playing with the spectator's role in the exhibition space. Finished Tallinn University in 2015 as Bachelor of Arts in Humanities, from 2017 studying in Estonian Academy of Arts, Contemporary Arts, MA, improved her skills at LUCA school of Arts, Fine Art department, Brussels.

artists.b: Martin Rästa (s. 1980) on graafiline disainer, interdistsiplinaarne kunstnik ja muusik, kes keskendub enda töödes heli ja visuaalse kunsti sünteesile ja integratsioonile, kasutades selleks erinevaid eksperimentaalseid vorme ja meediume. Tema tegevus toetub kognitiivsetele protsessidele ja empiirilisele tajule, mida saadab huvi eksistentsiaalsete küsimuste ja tehnoloogia vastu.
artists.ben: Martin Rästa (b. 1980) is a graphic designer, interdisciplinary artist and musician, who in his works focuses on the synthesis and integration of sound and visual art, using various experimental forms and media for this purpose. His activity is based on cognitive processes and empirical perception, accompanied by an interest in existential questions and technology.

artists.b: Mari Haavel (s. 1970) on tekstiilikunstnik ja tekstiilidisainer, kes elab ja töötab Tallinnas. Ta on lõpetanud Tallinna Kunstiülikooli tekstiili eriala BA (1996). Mari Haavel on töötanud galeristina ja ka erinevates tekstiilidega tegelevates Eesti firmades kodutekstiilide disainerina ja tegutseb sellel alal ka praegu. Selle kõrvalt on Mari pidevalt tegelenud ka nö oma asjaga – osalenud ja osaleb erinevatel tekstiilinäitustel sh rahvusvahelistel ja isikunäitustel. Meelistehnikateks siiditrükk ja gobelään. Samuti on teda köitnud erinevate tekstiilitoodete disainimine ja valmistamine, millest tänaseks on saanud Semimari Tekstiilid – väikene stuudio, kus sünnivad väiketiraazidena sisustustekstiilid ja aksessuaarid, mis on peamiselt käsitsi, siiditrüki tehnikas teostatud ja suures osas on materjalideks Eesti tootjate tootmisjäägid.
artists.ben: Mari Haavel (b. 1970) is a textile artist and textile designer who lives and works in Tallinn. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts' textile programme with a BA (1996). Mari Haavel has worked as a gallerist and also as a home textile designer at various Estonian companies dealing with textiles, and she continues to work in this field today. Alongside this, Mari has continuously pursued her own work as well – she has taken part and continues to take part in various textile exhibitions, including international ones, and in solo exhibitions. Her favourite techniques are silk-screen printing and tapestry. She has also been drawn to designing and making various textile products, which have today become Semimari Tekstiilid – a small studio where interior textiles and accessories are made in small editions, mostly by hand, using silk-screen printing technique, and largely from materials that are production leftovers from Estonian manufacturers.

artists.b: Kristiina Laurits (s. 1975) on lõpetanud Eesti Kunstiakadeemia ehte- ja sepakunsti osakonnas magistriõppe 2003. a ning täiendanud ennast ehekunsti erialal Escola Massanas Barcelonas. Alates 1995. aastast on Laurits esinenud enam kui 70 ehtenäitusel nii Eestis kui mujal maailmas. Tema töid on erinevates ehtekogudes ja -galeriides Eestis, Soomes, Saksamaal, Hollandis ja USA-s. Kristiina Laurits on ehtekunstirühmituse õhuLoss liige.
artists.ben: Kristiina Laurits (b. 1975) completed her master's studies in the Department of Jewellery and Blacksmithing at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2003 and furthered her studies in jewellery art at Escola Massana in Barcelona. Since 1995, Laurits has taken part in more than 70 jewellery exhibitions both in Estonia and elsewhere in the world. Her works are held in various jewellery collections and galleries in Estonia, Finland, Germany, the Netherlands and the USA. Kristiina Laurits is a member of the jewellery art group õhuLoss.

Artist Marco Laimre, who is a member of the EKKM management board, has declared that all his works that are not part of another collection belong to the EKKM collection. Therefore, during the last few decades that Laimre has worked as an artist, quite a large number of works have accumulated despite the fact that a large part of his work is in some other collection. Therefore, at this show, we are exhibiting only a list of the works so that we – the artist included – can get an idea of the scale of EKKM’s Laimre collection.

Artist Marco Laimre, who is a member of the EKKM management board, has declared that all his works that are not part of another collection belong to the EKKM collection. Therefore, during the last few decades that Laimre has worked as an artist, quite a large number of works have accumulated despite the fact that a large part of his work is in some other collection. Therefore, at this show, we are exhibiting only a list of the works so that we – the artist included – can get an idea of the scale of EKKM’s Laimre collection.

Salome, pasunad ja Ristija Johannese pea
Sügislehed tänaval, koolitüdrukud ja Jaani kirik
Mul ei ole midagi jalga panna

Tõllu viimane teekond. Mapist Suur Tõll
Loomade jootmine mapist Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus.

Skulptor Lagle Israeli portree. II pool Lenini portree
Setulaat mapist Lõuna-Eesti inimene ja loodus
Hea on olla vaba aga keha on ka vaja
Punaste silmadega draakon. Muinasjutus on kõik võimalik
Otepää maastik. Ees Juusa järv taga Pühajärv
Ajad muutuvad ütles karu ja tõi kase otsast uue banaani
Mida silm ei näe, seda kõht ei põe
Enne mina, siis maailm. August Macke portree

adb.en: Offered at €6,391 (100,000 kroons); nobody bid. The €26,000 the house prints as the hammer price is the sum the same painting made at Haus in 2019, so the 1999 lot is recorded as unsold.
